#!/usr/bin/env python3
r"""nulltex_probe.py - prove who passes a null texture to GUI.DrawTexture
(WORLD_NULLTEX_FLOOD_HUNT_STACKLESS_SO_FAR).

Player.log carries "null texture passed to GUI.DrawTexture" with no stack. The JawaBench tool
`jawa/nulltex_probe` (JawaBenchNullTextureProbe.cs) records the managed stack of every such call.

  --offline   no game needed. Decompiles the INSTALLED binaries with ilspycmd.exe and checks:
              O1 Unity's internal 12-arg GUI.DrawTexture holds the warning, under Repaint + image==null,
                 and the probe's TargetArgs name exactly that signature, with the parameter 'image';
              O2 the probe is wired: Install() called from JawaBenchInit, tool jawa/nulltex_probe declared;
              O3 the offline suspect still stands: RimThemes' UI_BackgroundMain_Patch draws
                 VideoPlayer.texture with no null check, and VBE's DrawBG reads texture.width first
                 (a null there throws, it cannot log this warning).
  --live A1   game up, bridge reachable: the probe is installed and has recorded >=1 null call with a
              managed caller. 0 calls is INCONCLUSIVE (exit 1): this session drew no null texture yet.
  --live A2   the most frequent caller is in aRandomKiwi.RimThemes (the offline prediction). Prints the
              real caller either way, so a refutation names its replacement.

FINDINGS SO FAR (offline, 2026-11-02; decompiled copies in D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\scratch\nulltex):
- Vanilla UIRoot_Entry.DoMainMenu calls UIMenuBackgroundManager.background.BackgroundOnGUI() on EVERY
  Entry-state OnGUI, long events included, so a world load or quicktest started from the menu keeps
  drawing the menu background under the loading screen.
- RimThemes (aRandomKiwi.RimThemes, workshop 1668983184) prefixes UI_BackgroundMain.BackgroundOnGUI and,
  once its VideoPlayer is "playing", draws Utils.CurrentMainAnimatedBg.texture unguarded; LoaderGM does
  the same with its own loader VideoPlayer. VideoPlayer.texture is null until a frame is decoded.
- The active theme is ours: Config/Mod_1668983184_RimThemes.xml curTheme = "mandrake.rut.shell§Utinni
  Shell" (MenuShell), which ships animated UI_BackgroundMain.BGPlanet*.webm, enabling that video path.
- VBE (2775017012) also draws VideoPlayer textures, but DrawBG reads texture.width first: excluded.
- The load-to-load spread (19,519 vs 77) is UNEXPLAINED offline; the probe's byProgramState and
  duringLongEvent split says when the nulls land.

Exit 0 = the clause holds, 1 = it does not (or cannot be shown), 2 = usage/instrument error.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
PROBE_CS = ROOT / "src/RimMandrake/bridgetools/JawaBench.BridgeTools/JawaBenchNullTextureProbe.cs"
INIT_CS = ROOT / "src/RimMandrake/bridgetools/JawaBench.BridgeTools/JawaBenchInit.cs"

STEAM = Path("/mnt/c/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps")
IMGUI = STEAM / "common/RimWorld/RimWorldWin64_Data/Managed/UnityEngine.IMGUIModule.dll"
RIMTHEMES = STEAM / "workshop/content/294100/1668983184/1.6/Assemblies/RimThemes.dll"
VBE = STEAM / "workshop/content/294100/2775017012/1.6/Assemblies/VBE.dll"
ILSPY = Path("/mnt/c/Users/Mandrake/.dotnet/tools/ilspycmd.exe")

WARNING = "null texture passed to GUI.DrawTexture"
SIG12 = ("Rect position, Texture image, ScaleMode scaleMode, bool alphaBlend, float imageAspect, "
         "Color leftColor, Color topColor, Color rightColor, Color bottomColor, Vector4 borderWidths, "
         "Vector4 borderRadiuses, bool drawSmoothCorners")
TYPES12 = ["Rect", "Texture", "ScaleMode", "bool", "float", "Color", "Color", "Color", "Color",
           "Vector4", "Vector4", "bool"]


def winpath(p: Path) -> str:
    return subprocess.run(["wslpath", "-w", str(p)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip()


def decompile_type(dll: Path, type_name: str) -> str:
    if not dll.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(dll)
    r = subprocess.run([str(ILSPY), "-t", type_name, winpath(dll)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                       timeout=300)
    if r.returncode != 0 or f"class {type_name.rsplit('.', 1)[-1]}" not in r.stdout:
        raise RuntimeError(f"ilspycmd could not decompile {type_name} from {dll}: {r.stderr.strip()[:300]}")
    return r.stdout


def method_body(src: str, header_re: str) -> str:
    """Text of the first method whose header matches, up to its balanced closing brace."""
    m = re.search(header_re, src)
    if not m:
        return ""
    i = src.index("{", m.end())
    depth = 0
    for j in range(i, len(src)):
        depth += {"{": 1, "}": -1}.get(src[j], 0)
        if depth == 0:
            return src[m.start():j + 1]
    return ""


def offline() -> int:
    fails = []

    def check(ok: bool, label: str, detail: str = "") -> None:
        print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + label + (f"  ({detail})" if detail else ""))
        if not ok:
            fails.append(label)

    gui = decompile_type(IMGUI, "UnityEngine.GUI")
    body = method_body(gui, r"internal static void DrawTexture\(" + re.escape(SIG12) + r"\)")
    check(bool(body), "O1a Unity has the internal 12-arg GUI.DrawTexture", SIG12[:60] + "...")
    check(WARNING in body and "image == null" in body and "EventType.Repaint" in body,
          "O1b it alone writes the warning, under Repaint and image == null")
    check(gui.count(WARNING) == 1, "O1c the warning text occurs once in UnityEngine.GUI",
          f"{gui.count(WARNING)} occurrence(s)")
    probe = PROBE_CS.read_text()
    m = re.search(r"TargetArgs\s*=\s*\{(.*?)\};", probe, re.S)
    got = re.findall(r"typeof\((\w+)\)", m.group(1)) if m else []
    check(got == TYPES12, "O1d the probe's TargetArgs are that signature", " ".join(got))
    check(re.search(r"static void Prefix\(Texture image\)", probe) is not None,
          "O1e the prefix binds Harmony parameter 'image'")
    check("JawaBenchNullTextureProbe.Install()" in INIT_CS.read_text(), "O2a Install() is called from JawaBenchInit")
    check('"jawa/nulltex_probe"' in probe, "O2b the tool jawa/nulltex_probe is declared")

    rt = decompile_type(RIMTHEMES, "aRandomKiwi.RimThemes.UI_BackgroundMain_Patch")
    unguarded = re.search(r"GUI\.DrawTexture\(\w+, Utils\.CurrentMainAnimatedBg\.texture,", rt)
    check(unguarded is not None and "CurrentMainAnimatedBg.texture != null" not in rt
          and "(Object)(object)Utils.CurrentMainAnimatedBg.texture" not in rt,
          "O3a RimThemes UI_BackgroundMain_Patch draws VideoPlayer.texture with no null check")
    vbe = decompile_type(VBE, "VBE.Utils")
    draw = method_body(vbe, r"public static void DrawBG\(Texture texture\)")
    rect = method_body(vbe, r"public static Rect GetBGRect\(Texture texture\)")
    check("GetBGRect(texture)" in draw and "texture.width" in rect,
          "O3b VBE.DrawBG dereferences texture.width first (a null throws, never this warning)")
    print("OFFLINE " + ("PASS" if not fails else f"FAIL: {len(fails)} check(s)"))
    return 0 if not fails else 1


def live(clause: str) -> int:
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src/RimMandrake/Utils"))
    import rimbridge_client as rb  # noqa: E402
    host, port, token = rb.resolve_endpoint()
    s = rb.RimBridge(host=host, port=port, token=token, timeout=45.0)
    s.connect()
    r = s.call("jawa/nulltex_probe", {"action": "get", "top": 5}) or {}
    if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("content"):
        r = json.loads(r["content"][0]["text"])
    out = Path(os.environ.get("NULLTEX_OUT", tempfile.gettempdir())) / "nulltex_probe_live.json"
    out.write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=1))
    print(f"probe reading -> {out}")
    if not r.get("installed"):
        print(f"FAIL {clause}: probe NOT installed ({r.get('installError') or r.get('error') or r})")
        return 1
    n = int(r.get("nullCalls") or 0)
    callers = r.get("byCaller") or []
    for c in callers[:5]:
        print(f"  {c['count']:>7}  {c['caller']}")
    if n == 0 or not callers:
        print(f"INCONCLUSIVE {clause}: installed, armed={r.get('armed')}, 0 null calls since install "
              "- this session drew no null texture after the first jawa/ call (load a save or a quicktest "
              "from the main menu with RimThemes + MenuShell active, then re-read)")
        return 1
    top = callers[0]["caller"]
    if clause == "A1":
        ok = not top.startswith("<no managed caller")
        print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL") + f" A1: {n} null call(s); top caller {top}")
        return 0 if ok else 1
    ok = top.startswith("aRandomKiwi.RimThemes.")
    print(("PASS" if ok else "FAIL") + f" A2: top caller {top} ({callers[0]['count']} of {n})"
          + ("" if ok else " - the RimThemes prediction is REFUTED; the line above names the real caller"))
    return 0 if ok else 1


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
    g = ap.add_mutually_exclusive_group(required=True)
    g.add_argument("--offline", action="store_true")
    g.add_argument("--live", choices=["A1", "A2"])
    a = ap.parse_args()
    try:
        return offline() if a.offline else live(a.live)
    except (FileNotFoundError, RuntimeError, subprocess.SubprocessError, OSError) as e:
        print(f"INSTRUMENT ERROR: {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
        return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""What do the four heavy visual mods really cost in memory? Item HEAVY_TEXTURES_MEASURE_REAL_VRAM, owner card C18
(design/RimMandrake/mod_audit/OWNER_RULINGS.md): "Measure real memory cost first", then decide one by one.

  offline              the header estimate per mod (memory_attribution.collect: loose Textures/ by the 1.6 loader rule)
                       plus each mod's AssetBundle files, which no header read can size. Exits 1 on a blind census.
  live --clause A1|A2  one reading of the RUNNING game:
                         A1  jawa/texture_memory for the four mods: every Texture object Unity holds, sized from its live
                             format, mips and layers, a readable texture's CPU copy beside it, owned by loose content or by
                             a name match to the mod's own AssetBundle assets
                         A2  the process figures, each its own number: private bytes, working set, GPU dedicated and
                             shared (Windows GPU Process Memory counters), Unity native allocated/reserved, Mono heap;
                             a reading that is missing is UNKNOWN, never 0
                       Both write the report (JSON and Markdown) under <agent storage>/rimmandrake/heavy_textures_vram/
                       and append one row to samples.jsonl there. Exit 0 the clause holds, 1 the instrument is blind or a
                       figure is absent that should be there, 2 not measurable on this load (no game, bridge unreachable,
                       or one of the four mods not in the running load: stage it with
                       `python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/modlist_swap.py --enable <the four packageIds> --apply`).

What "real" means here: the bytes the running game's Texture objects occupy as Unity created them. That is not the
marginal cost of a mod (a launch without it), which planet_atmosphere_cost.py's A/B measures for Planet Atmosphere:
textures a mod's code builds at runtime with generic names (render targets, LUTs) fall in the `other` bucket, named,
and are read off it by name. Meshes, shaders and audio are not counted.
"""
import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(HERE, "modaudit"))

MODS = {
    "rwnodetree.rwplanetatmosphere": ("Planet Atmosphere", "3272330410"),
    "vesper.egihologramsandprojectors": ("EGI Holograms and Projectors", "2979598490"),
    "zacharyfoster.mineralsrock": ("Minerals Rock shapes", "3562391080"),
    "fourtoo.glowingbush": ("Glowing Bush", "3425062214"),
}
WORKSHOP = "/mnt/c/Program Files (x86)/Steam/steamapps/workshop/content/294100"
MB = 1048576.0
UNMEASURABLE = 2


def storage_dir():
    import planet_atmosphere_cost as pac
    d = os.path.join(pac.storage_root(), "rimmandrake", "heavy_textures_vram")
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
    return d


def mb(b):
    return None if b is None else round(b / MB, 1)


def fmt(v, unit="MB"):
    return "UNKNOWN" if v is None else "%.1f %s" % (v, unit)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- reply shapes (pure)

def unwrap(reply):
    """A bridge reply -> the tool's own dict, or None. Accepts the bare dict, {"result": ...}, and the GABP content
    envelope {"content": [{"text": "<json>"}]}."""
    for _ in range(3):
        if not isinstance(reply, dict):
            return None
        if "success" in reply:
            return reply
        if isinstance(reply.get("result"), dict):
            reply = reply["result"]
            continue
        c = reply.get("content")
        if isinstance(c, list) and c and isinstance(c[0], dict) and isinstance(c[0].get("text"), str):
            try:
                reply = json.loads(c[0]["text"])
            except ValueError:
                return None
            continue
        return None
    return reply if isinstance(reply, dict) and "success" in reply else None


def judge_textures(res, wanted, textureless=()):
    """jawa/texture_memory's result -> (exit code, rows, why[]). rows: one per wanted mod with MB figures.
    2: a wanted mod is not running (this load cannot answer). 1: the instrument cannot see (no textures, no bytes, or a
    running mod with neither a measured texture nor a bundle asset, unless the offline census found it ships no texture
    file at all: `textureless`, whose zero is the measurement). Pure; selftested."""
    why = []
    if not res or res.get("success") is not True:
        return UNMEASURABLE, [], ["jawa/texture_memory gave no successful answer: %s" % str(res)[:200]]
    by = {(m.get("packageId") or "").lower(): m for m in res.get("mods") or []}
    missing = sorted(set(wanted) - set(by)) or sorted(res.get("missing") or [])
    if missing:
        return UNMEASURABLE, [], ["not in the running load: %s" % ", ".join(missing)]
    totals = res.get("totals") or {}
    if not res.get("textures") or not totals.get("gpuBytes"):
        why.append("blind: the census saw %s textures and %s GPU bytes" % (res.get("textures"), totals.get("gpuBytes")))
    rows = []
    for pid in wanted:
        m = by[pid]
        if not m.get("count") and not m.get("bundleAssets") and pid not in textureless:
            why.append("blind for %s: no measured texture and no bundle asset" % pid)
        rows.append({"packageId": pid, "label": MODS.get(pid, (pid,))[0], "textures": m.get("count", 0),
                     "fromContent": m.get("fromContent", 0), "fromBundle": m.get("fromBundle", 0),
                     "bundleAssets": m.get("bundleAssets", 0), "readable": m.get("readable", 0),
                     "gpuMB": mb(m.get("gpuBytes") or 0), "cpuMB": mb(m.get("cpuBytes") or 0),
                     "profilerMB": mb(m.get("profilerBytes")),
                     "top": [(r.get("name"), r.get("w"), r.get("h"), r.get("format"), mb(r.get("gpuBytes") or 0))
                             for r in (m.get("top") or [])[:5]]})
    return (1 if why else 0), rows, why


def judge_process(proc, health):
    """The PowerShell process sample and the tool's processHealth JSON -> (exit code, figures, why[]). Each figure is MB
    or None (UNKNOWN). 2: no game process. 1: private bytes unread (the one figure every launch must give). Pure."""
    if not proc or proc.get("error") or not proc.get("running"):
        return UNMEASURABLE, {}, ["no RimWorld process sample: %s" % (proc or {}).get("error", "not running")]
    h = health if isinstance(health, dict) else {}

    def pos(v):
        return v if isinstance(v, (int, float)) and v > 0 else None
    fig = {
        "privateMB": mb(pos(proc.get("private"))),
        "workingSetMB": mb(pos(proc.get("working"))),
        "gpuDedicatedMB": mb(proc.get("gpu_dedicated")) if proc.get("gpu_counters") else None,
        "gpuSharedMB": mb(proc.get("gpu_shared")) if proc.get("gpu_counters") else None,
        "unityAllocMB": pos(h.get("unityAllocMB")), "unityReservedMB": pos(h.get("unityReservedMB")),
        "monoUsedMB": pos(h.get("monoUsedMB")), "monoHeapMB": pos(h.get("monoHeapMB")),
        "gfxDriverMB": pos(h.get("gfxMB")),
    }
    why = [] if fig["privateMB"] else ["private bytes unread"]
    return (1 if why else 0), fig, why


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- offline estimate

def offline_rows(active=None, compression=True):
    import memory_attribution as ma
    active = set(active or []) | set(MODS) | {"brrainz.harmony", "zacharyfoster.mineralsframework"}
    rows = []
    for pid, (label, wid) in MODS.items():
        folder = os.path.join(WORKSHOP, wid)
        rec = ma.collect(folder, active, compression) if os.path.isdir(folder) else {"error": "no folder " + folder}
        bundles = []
        for dp, _dn, fn in os.walk(folder):
            if os.path.basename(dp).lower() == "assetbundles" or "assetbundles" in dp.lower().split(os.sep):
                bundles += [os.path.getsize(os.path.join(dp, f)) for f in fn if not f.endswith((".manifest", ".meta"))]
        rows.append({"packageId": pid, "label": label, "folder": folder, "error": rec.get("error"),
                     "texFiles": rec.get("tex_files", 0), "texMB": rec.get("tex_mb", 0.0),
                     "bundleFiles": len(bundles), "bundleMB": round(sum(bundles) / MB, 1),
                     "largest": rec.get("largest", [])[:3]})
    return rows


def textureless(rows):
    """The mods the offline census read without error and found to ship no loose texture and no AssetBundle."""
    return {r["packageId"] for r in rows or [] if not r["error"] and not r["texFiles"] and not r["bundleFiles"]}


def offline(args):
    rows = offline_rows()
    blind = [r["packageId"] for r in rows if r["error"]]
    if not any(r["texFiles"] or r["bundleFiles"] for r in rows):
        blind.append("every mod read 0 texture files")
    for r in rows:
        print("%-34s loose %4d files %8.1f MB est | bundles %d files %7.1f MB on disk%s" % (
            r["packageId"], r["texFiles"], r["texMB"], r["bundleFiles"], r["bundleMB"],
            ("  ERROR " + r["error"]) if r["error"] else
            ("  (ships no texture file: its texture memory of its own is 0)" if r["packageId"] in textureless(rows) else "")))
    if blind:
        print("BLIND: %s" % ", ".join(blind))
        return 1
    return 0


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- live

def markdown(stamp, tex_rows, procfig, res, est):
    est_by = {r["packageId"]: r for r in est or []}
    out = ["# Heavy visual mods: real texture memory (%s)" % stamp, "",
           "Item `HEAVY_TEXTURES_MEASURE_REAL_VRAM`, owner card C18. Tool `jawa/texture_memory` on the running game; "
           "the estimate column is the offline header estimate (loose files only).", "",
           "| mod | textures (loose/bundle) | GPU MB | CPU copy MB | profiler MB | header estimate MB | bundle assets |",
           "|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|"]
    for r in tex_rows:
        e = est_by.get(r["packageId"])
        out.append("| %s `%s` | %d (%d/%d) | %.1f | %.1f | %s | %s | %d |" % (
            r["label"], r["packageId"], r["textures"], r["fromContent"], r["fromBundle"], r["gpuMB"], r["cpuMB"],
            fmt(r["profilerMB"], "").strip(), ("%.1f" % e["texMB"]) if e else "UNMEASURED", r["bundleAssets"]))
    out += ["", "Largest textures per mod:"]
    for r in tex_rows:
        out.append("- %s: %s" % (r["label"], "; ".join("%s %sx%s %s %.1f MB" % t for t in r["top"]) or "none"))
    t = (res or {}).get("totals") or {}
    out += ["", "Whole game: %s textures, %s GPU, %s CPU copies; buckets %s." % (
        (res or {}).get("textures"), fmt(mb(t.get("gpuBytes"))), fmt(mb(t.get("cpuBytes"))),
        {k: mb(v) for k, v in ((res or {}).get("buckets") or {}).items()}), "",
        "Process: " + ", ".join("%s %s" % (k, fmt(v)) for k, v in procfig.items()), "",
        "Largest unowned textures (vanilla, DLC, runtime-made; a mod's render targets show here by name):"]
    for r in ((res or {}).get("other") or [])[:15]:
        out.append("- `%s` %s %sx%s %s %.1f MB" % (r.get("name"), r.get("kind"), r.get("w"), r.get("h"), r.get("format"),
                                                 mb(r.get("gpuBytes") or 0)))
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def live(args):
    import live_def_check
    import planet_atmosphere_cost as pac
    wanted = list(MODS)
    reply, err = live_def_check._bridge("jawa/texture_memory", {"packageIds": ",".join(wanted), "limit": 25}, 300)
    res = unwrap(reply)
    if res is None:
        print("UNMEASURED: %s" % (err or "jawa/texture_memory answered no result (is the companion deployed?)"))
        return UNMEASURABLE
    est = None
    try:
        est = offline_rows(compression=pac.prefs_compression() is not False)
    except Exception as e:     # the estimate is context; without it no mod is excused a zero
        print("offline estimate unavailable: %s" % e)
    tcode, rows, twhy = judge_textures(res, wanted, textureless(est))
    health = None
    try:
        health = json.loads(res.get("processHealth") or "null")
    except ValueError:
        pass
    pcode, fig, pwhy = judge_process(pac.sample_process(), health)
    stamp = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    d = storage_dir()
    row = {"at": stamp, "clause": args.clause, "programState": res.get("programState"), "upS": res.get("upS"),
           "mods": rows, "process": fig, "totals": res.get("totals"), "buckets": res.get("buckets"),
           "textureCompression": res.get("textureCompression"), "why": twhy + pwhy, "estimate": est}
    with open(os.path.join(d, "report_%s.json" % stamp), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump({"row": row, "raw": res}, f, indent=1)
    if tcode != UNMEASURABLE:
        with open(os.path.join(d, "report_%s.md" % stamp), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(markdown(stamp, rows, fig, res, est))
    with open(os.path.join(d, "samples.jsonl"), "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    for r in rows:
        print("%-34s %4d textures  GPU %7.1f MB  CPU %6.1f MB  profiler %s" % (
            r["packageId"], r["textures"], r["gpuMB"], r["cpuMB"], fmt(r["profilerMB"])))
    print("process: " + ", ".join("%s %s" % (k, fmt(v)) for k, v in fig.items()))
    print("report: %s" % os.path.join(d, "report_%s.json" % stamp))
    code = tcode if args.clause == "A1" else pcode
    for w in (twhy if args.clause == "A1" else pwhy):
        print(("UNMEASURED: " if code == UNMEASURABLE else "FAIL: ") + w)
    print("%s %s" % (args.clause, {0: "PASS", 1: "FAIL", 2: "UNMEASURED"}[code]))
    return code


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)
    sub.add_parser("offline")
    p = sub.add_parser("live")
    p.add_argument("--clause", choices=["A1", "A2"], required=True)
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    return offline(args) if args.cmd == "offline" else live(args)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Live proofs of WARSCAR_HOSPICE_DESERTERS_1, one clause per call: exit 0 when it holds, 1 when it does not, 2 when
the instrument cannot see (no bridge, no map, the hook type absent: never a verdict).

    python3 src/RimMandrake/Scarlands/hospice_live_proof.py A1|A2|A3|A4

Each clause is one jawa/static_call into RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_HospiceProof (Source/RM_HospiceProof.cs) on the
CURRENT map of a quicktest colony with Warscar loaded (standalone or inside the Baroque Biomes composite):
  A1 Rings      RM_Warscar runs RM_KneelingRings live; the genstep lays rings facing their centre with 0..cap intact
                chassis, each holding a history that is in its save XML.
  A2 Revival    an intact chassis the haul workgiver offers is fed to a cradle with each stage's input and passes the
                five stages (stage time skipped by DebugCompleteStage); it wakes a colony mech with no mechanitor,
                its history's modification hediffs present, the cradle lights dark at diagnosis and lit after lights.
  A3 Failure    a forced failure at the lights stage leaves RM_FailedChassis labelled with the machine's name.
  A4 WalkIn     the walk-in incident fired with forced parms (pursuer held off), then real ticks through
                jawa/safe_advance until the servitor knelt within 6 cells of the cradle as an intact chassis.
It writes to the quicktest map only (every save but the canonical world saves is disposable) and never the world.
"""
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(HERE, "..", "Utils"))
import rimbridge_client as rb  # noqa: E402

TYPE = "RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_HospiceProof"
METHOD = {"A1": "Rings", "A2": "Revival", "A3": "Failure"}
ADVANCE_STEP, ADVANCE_MAX = 2500, 12


def hook(c, method, args="current"):
    r = c.call("jawa/static_call", {"type": TYPE, "method": method, "args": args})
    if not isinstance(r, dict) or r.get("success") is False:
        raise RuntimeError("static_call %s refused: %r" % (method, r))
    return str(r.get("result", ""))


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) != 2 or argv[1] not in ("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4"):
        print(__doc__)
        return 2
    clause = argv[1]
    try:
        h, p, tok = rb.resolve_endpoint()
        c = rb.RimBridge(host=h, port=p, token=tok, timeout=120.0)
        c.connect()
        if clause in METHOD:
            line = hook(c, METHOD[clause])
        else:
            fired = hook(c, "WalkInFire")
            if not fired.startswith("PASS fired: "):
                print("A4 " + fired)
                return 1
            unit = fired[len("PASS fired: "):].strip()
            line = "FAIL never read"
            for i in range(ADVANCE_MAX):
                adv = c.call("jawa/safe_advance", {"ticks": ADVANCE_STEP, "stopOn": "default"})
                line = hook(c, "WalkInRead", "current|" + unit)
                print("  +%d ticks: %s (advance: %s)" % ((i + 1) * ADVANCE_STEP, line,
                                                         (adv or {}).get("state") if isinstance(adv, dict) else adv), flush=True)
                if line.startswith("PASS") or "is gone" in line:
                    break
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 -- any bridge failure is an instrument error, never a verdict
        print("%s UNMEASURED: %s: %s" % (clause, type(e).__name__, e))
        return 2
    print("%s %s" % (clause, line))
    return 0 if line.startswith("PASS") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""live_log_check.py -- does the RUNNING game's Player.log name a token in an error line? Read-only, no bridge call.

    python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/live_log_check.py --absent RUT_ExplosiveGrowthRoster --absent RUT_PaleMoss [--warnings]

For criteria worded "Player.log carries no error naming X" (RA_S09_LIVE_WIRE_ONE_REAL_LEAF). A line is an error line when
it matches ERROR_RE (with --warnings, WARN_RE too); a token is matched as a literal substring of such a line.

--never TOKEN fails on ANY line naming the token, error word or not. Player.log carries no level marker: a Log.Warning
is bare text (stack traces are off), so a warning without the word "warn" in it is invisible to --warnings. Name such a
message by its own text with --never ("[RM Minerals] quarry", "name only disabled mineables").

Exit 0 no error line names any token, 1 one does (a real FAIL; the lines are printed), 2 UNMEASURED: no running game,
a log older than the running game (it belongs to an earlier session), or a log without the anchor (default
"Bridge token:", printed once the load finished and RimBridge came up: a log before that has not seen the load's
errors yet). Pair it with live_def_check.py when the criterion also needs the mod to be loaded: an absent token in a
load that never had the mod is not a pass, and this file cannot tell.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
PASS, FAIL, UNMEASURED = 0, 1, 2
# Word-ended so an identifier is not an error: RUT_ErrorPlant and "0 errors" are not error lines, NullReferenceException,
# "2 errors" and "Config error in" are. The tokens and every underscore identifier are blanked out first (MASK_RE).
ERROR_RE = re.compile(r"errors?\b|exceptions?\b|\bfailed\b|\bcould not\b|\bcouldn't\b", re.I)
WARN_RE = re.compile(r"warn(ing)?s?\b", re.I)
NONE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(0|no|zero|without)\s+(errors?|exceptions?|warnings?)\b", re.I)
IDENT_RE = re.compile(r"\w*_\w*")
# A line that continues the record above it (a stack trace, an inner exception, a [Ref] stub), not a message of its
# own. Blank lines never split a record: "Exception:\n\n  defName: X" is one record. A failed patch prints its file on
# the next line, unindented ("file: C:\\...\\Patches\\X.xml"): without `file: ` a token naming the patch file was missed.
CONT_RE = re.compile(r"^(\s|at |file: |\(Filename|--- |Rethrow|\[0x|\[Ref |(Verse|RimWorld|UnityEngine|System|HarmonyLib|Mono)\.\S*[:(])")
ANCHOR = "Bridge token:"


def records(text):
    """-> [(first line number, [lines])]: a message line plus the continuation lines under it."""
    out = []
    for n, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        if out and CONT_RE.match(line):
            out[-1][1].append(line)
        else:
            out.append((n, [line]))
    return out


def judge(text, tokens, warnings=False, anchor=ANCHOR, never=()):
    """-> (exit code, lines). Pure: `text` is the whole Player.log. A record (a message and its stack trace) fails when
    any of its lines is an error line (with `warnings`, a warning line too) and any of its lines names a token, as a
    literal substring: RUT_PaleMoss also hits RUT_PaleMossLarge, a false FAIL at worst, never a false PASS."""
    if anchor and anchor not in text:
        return UNMEASURED, ["UNMEASURED: the log has no %r yet: the load has not finished" % anchor]
    hits, recs = [], records(text)
    for n, lines in recs:
        named = [t for t in never if any(t in x for x in lines)]
        if named:
            hits.append("FAIL line %d names %s, which may never appear: %s" % (n, ", ".join(named),
                                                                              " | ".join(x.strip() for x in lines)[:240]))
    mask = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(t) for t in sorted(tokens, key=len, reverse=True)))

    def bad(line):
        line = NONE_RE.sub(" ", IDENT_RE.sub(" ", mask.sub(" ", line)))
        return ERROR_RE.search(line) or (warnings and WARN_RE.search(line))

    for n, lines in recs if tokens else ():
        named = [t for t in tokens if any(t in x for x in lines)]
        if named and any(bad(x) for x in lines):
            hits.append("FAIL line %d names %s: %s" % (n, ", ".join(named), " | ".join(x.strip() for x in lines)[:240]))
    if hits:
        return FAIL, hits[:40] + (["... %d more" % (len(hits) - 40)] if len(hits) > 40 else [])
    return PASS, (["PASS no %s line names %s" % ("error or warning" if warnings else "error", ", ".join(tokens))] if tokens
                  else []) + (["PASS no line names %s" % ", ".join(never)] if never else [])


def game_started():
    """The running RimWorld's start, epoch seconds to the millisecond; None when none or two run, or it cannot be read."""
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command",
                            "Get-Process RimWorldWin64 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object "
                            "{ $_.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ') }"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        lines = [x.strip() for x in r.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
        if len(lines) != 1:
            return None
        return datetime.datetime.strptime(lines[0], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(
            tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp()
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--absent", action="append", default=[], metavar="TOKEN")
    ap.add_argument("--never", action="append", default=[], metavar="TOKEN",
                    help="any line naming this fails, error word or not (a Log.Warning has no marker in Player.log)")
    ap.add_argument("--warnings", action="store_true", help="a warning line naming a token fails too")
    ap.add_argument("--log", default=None, help="another log (default: game_paths.PLAYER_LOG); skips the game check")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    tokens = [t for t in (x.strip() for x in a.absent) if t]
    never = [t for t in (x.strip() for x in a.never) if t]
    if not tokens and not never:
        print("UNMEASURED: no token to look for")
        return UNMEASURED
    path = a.log
    if path is None:
        sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
        from game_paths import PLAYER_LOG as path
        started = game_started()
        if started is None:
            print("UNMEASURED: no running game")
            return UNMEASURED
        try:
            if os.path.getmtime(path) <= started:
                print("UNMEASURED: %s was last written before the running game started" % path)
                return UNMEASURED
        except OSError as e:
            print("UNMEASURED: %s" % e)
            return UNMEASURED
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            text = f.read()
    except OSError as e:
        print("UNMEASURED: %s" % e)
        return UNMEASURED
    if a.log is None and game_started() != started:
        print("UNMEASURED: the running game changed while the log was read")
        return UNMEASURED
    code, lines = judge(text, tokens, a.warnings, never=never)
    print("\n".join(lines))
    print({PASS: "VERDICT PASS", FAIL: "VERDICT FAIL", UNMEASURED: "VERDICT UNMEASURED"}[code])
    return code


def safe_main(argv=None):
    """main(), where nothing may escape: an uncaught exception exits 1, which the runner would record as a FAIL."""
    try:
        return main(argv)
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except BaseException as e:
        sys.stdout.write("UNMEASURED: " + ascii("%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, str(e)[:200])) + "\n")
        return UNMEASURED


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(safe_main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""env_verify_check.py -- did `modcheck run <Mod>` record a real verdict for the mod as it stands now? Read-only.

    python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/env_verify_check.py Armoury

For MODCHECK_DONOR_ENVIRONMENTS_1's live clauses ("the suite produces a real verify event on a list that loaded
clean"); the load half is live_def_check.py / live_log_check.py on the same line. Reads
infrastructure/state/modcheck_status.json, the registry `status.record_run` writes once per run.

Exit 0: the mod's entry carries the mod's CURRENT hash, a verdict that came from running chains (GREEN, RED,
DRAFT-CHECKLIST, PENDING-OWNER-REVIEW; RED counts, it is a real verdict), and a timestamp after the last commit to the
mod's modcheck_env.py (so it ran on the composed environment). 1: the run was REFUSED. 2 (UNMEASURED): no entry, a
stale hash, or an entry older than the environment.
"""
import os
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
import runner  # noqa: E402
import status  # noqa: E402

PASS, FAIL, UNMEASURED = 0, 1, 2
REAL = {"GREEN", "RED", "DRAFT-CHECKLIST", "PENDING-OWNER-REVIEW"}


def env_commit_time(mod_dir):
    env = os.path.join(mod_dir, "modcheck_env.py")
    out = subprocess.run(["git", "log", "-1", "--format=%ct", "--", env], cwd=runner.ROOT,
                         capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30).stdout.strip()
    return int(out) if out else None


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) != 1:
        print(__doc__)
        return UNMEASURED
    mod = argv[0]
    mod_dir = runner.find_mod_dir(mod)
    entry = status.load().get(mod)
    if not entry:
        print("UNMEASURED %s: no modcheck_status entry" % mod)
        return UNMEASURED
    now_hash = status.mod_hash(mod_dir)
    if entry.get("hash") != now_hash:
        print("UNMEASURED %s: entry hash %s is not the mod's current %s" % (mod, entry.get("hash"), now_hash))
        return UNMEASURED
    since = env_commit_time(mod_dir)
    if since is None or (entry.get("ts") or 0) <= since:
        print("UNMEASURED %s: entry (ts %s) does not postdate modcheck_env.py's commit (%s)" % (mod, entry.get("ts"), since))
        return UNMEASURED
    if entry.get("status") not in REAL:
        print("FAIL %s: run %s recorded %s (%s)" % (mod, entry.get("run_id"), entry.get("status"), entry.get("refused")))
        return FAIL
    print("PASS %s: run %s recorded %s at the current hash" % (mod, entry.get("run_id"), entry.get("status")))
    return PASS


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

IDENT_RE = re.compile(r"\w*_\w*")
# A line that continues the record above it (a stack trace, an inner exception, a [Ref] stub), not a message of its
# own. Blank lines never split a record: "Exception:\n\n  defName: X" is one record. A failed patch prints its file on
# the next line, unindented ("file: C:\\...\\Patches\\X.xml"): without `file: ` a token naming the patch file was missed.
CONT_RE = re.compile(r"^(\s|at |file: |\(Filename|--- |Rethrow|\[0x|\[Ref |(Verse|RimWorld|UnityEngine|System|HarmonyLib|Mono)\.\S*[:(])")
ANCHOR = "Bridge token:"


def records(text):
    """-> [(first line number, [lines])]: a message line plus the continuation lines under it."""
    out = []
    for n, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        if out and CONT_RE.match(line):
            out[-1][1].append(line)
        else:
            out.append((n, [line]))
    return out


def judge(text, tokens, warnings=False, anchor=ANCHOR, never=()):
    """-> (exit code, lines). Pure: `text` is the whole Player.log. A record (a message and its stack trace) fails when
    any of its lines is an error line (with `warnings`, a warning line too) and any of its lines names a token, as a
    literal substring: RUT_PaleMoss also hits RUT_PaleMossLarge, a false FAIL at worst, never a false PASS."""
    if anchor and anchor not in text:
        return UNMEASURED, ["UNMEASURED: the log has no %r yet: the load has not finished" % anchor]
    hits, recs = [], records(text)
    for n, lines in recs:
        named = [t for t in never if any(t in x for x in lines)]
        if named:
            hits.append("FAIL line %d names %s, which may never appear: %s" % (n, ", ".join(named),
                                                                              " | ".join(x.strip() for x in lines)[:240]))
    mask = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(t) for t in sorted(tokens, key=len, reverse=True)))

    def bad(line):
        line = NONE_RE.sub(" ", IDENT_RE.sub(" ", mask.sub(" ", line)))
        return ERROR_RE.search(line) or (warnings and WARN_RE.search(line))

    for n, lines in recs if tokens else ():
        named = [t for t in tokens if any(t in x for x in lines)]
        if named and any(bad(x) for x in lines):
            hits.append("FAIL line %d names %s: %s" % (n, ", ".join(named), " | ".join(x.strip() for x in lines)[:240]))
    if hits:
        return FAIL, hits[:40] + (["... %d more" % (len(hits) - 40)] if len(hits) > 40 else [])
    return PASS, (["PASS no %s line names %s" % ("error or warning" if warnings else "error", ", ".join(tokens))] if tokens
                  else []) + (["PASS no line names %s" % ", ".join(never)] if never else [])


def game_started():
    """The running RimWorld's start, epoch seconds to the millisecond; None when none or two run, or it cannot be read."""
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command",
                            "Get-Process RimWorldWin64 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object "
                            "{ $_.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ') }"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        lines = [x.strip() for x in r.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
        if len(lines) != 1:
            return None
        return datetime.datetime.strptime(lines[0], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(
            tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp()
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--absent", action="append", default=[], metavar="TOKEN")
    ap.add_argument("--never", action="append", default=[], metavar="TOKEN",
                    help="any line naming this fails, error word or not (a Log.Warning has no marker in Player.log)")
    ap.add_argument("--warnings", action="store_true", help="a warning line naming a token fails too")
    ap.add_argument("--log", default=None, help="another log (default: game_paths.PLAYER_LOG); skips the game check")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    tokens = [t for t in (x.strip() for x in a.absent) if t]
    never = [t for t in (x.strip() for x in a.never) if t]
    if not tokens and not never:
        print("UNMEASURED: no token to look for")
        return UNMEASURED
    path = a.log
    if path is None:
        sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
        from game_paths import PLAYER_LOG as path
        started = game_started()
        if started is None:
            print("UNMEASURED: no running game")
            return UNMEASURED
        try:
            if os.path.getmtime(path) <= started:
                print("UNMEASURED: %s was last written before the running game started" % path)
                return UNMEASURED
        except OSError as e:
            print("UNMEASURED: %s" % e)
            return UNMEASURED
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            text = f.read()
    except OSError as e:
        print("UNMEASURED: %s" % e)
        return UNMEASURED
    if a.log is None and game_started() != started:
        print("UNMEASURED: the running game changed while the log was read")
        return UNMEASURED
    code, lines = judge(text, tokens, a.warnings, never=never)
    print("\n".join(lines))
    print({PASS: "VERDICT PASS", FAIL: "VERDICT FAIL", UNMEASURED: "VERDICT UNMEASURED"}[code])
    return code


def safe_main(argv=None):
    """main(), where nothing may escape: an uncaught exception exits 1, which the runner would record as a FAIL."""
    try:
        return main(argv)
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except BaseException as e:
        sys.stdout.write("UNMEASURED: " + ascii("%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, str(e)[:200])) + "\n")
        return UNMEASURED


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(safe_main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""HORRORS_RAIDING_FACTION_1 live proof: the Assailant horrors reach the nightside and nowhere else.

    python.exe src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/prove_night_horrors_live.py A2 < /dev/null
    python.exe src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/prove_night_horrors_live.py A3 < /dev/null

Runs under WINDOWS python: RimBridge binds Windows loopback. Needs a loaded game whose world has land on both sides of
the terminator (the Ash'karr world does; a low-coverage quicktest world may not, and then the clause FAILS, saying so).

  A2  on a freshly generated NIGHTSIDE player map (tile arc from the substellar point > nightsideBandMinArc + 5):
      at least one RUT_HorrorHive lair is on the map (the self-gating GenStep ran), and RUT_HorrorRaid, forced, fires
      and leaves pawns of the RUT_Horrors faction on the map.
  A3  on a freshly generated DAYSIDE player map (arc < terminatorBandMinArc - 5): no lair structure or crysalis of
      ours is on the map, and RUT_HorrorRaid, forced, reports canFireNow=false (dry run, nothing fires).

The arc uses the shipped geometry def (WeatherGeometryDefs_Ashkarr.xml) and the same formula as
RM_WeatherKernel.ArcDegrees, over the live world's own tile table (jawa/world_tile_export: tile indices belong to the
world that wrote them). Each run founds one player settlement, generates its map, and drops the map again at the end.
Exit 0 = the clause holds, 1 = it does not (or could not be measured)."""
import csv
import json
import math
import os
import random
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPO = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "..", ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, "src", "RimMandrake", "Utils"))
GEOM = os.path.join(REPO, "src", "RimUtinni", "AshkarrWeatherSuite", "Defs", "WeatherGeometryDefs", "WeatherGeometryDefs_Ashkarr.xml")
LAIR = ["RUT_HorrorHive", "RUT_HorrorDen", "RUT_HorrorBurrow", "RUT_HorrorSinkhole", "RUT_HorrorMiteLarder",
        "RUT_HorrorCrysalis_Visceral", "RUT_HorrorCrysalis_Prowler", "RUT_HorrorCrysalis_Harvester", "RUT_HorrorCrysalis_Bulwark"]
FORMS = ["RM_Visceral", "RUT_HorrorBulwark", "RUT_HorrorHarvester", "RUT_HorrorProwler", "RUT_HorrorBroodLord"]
WATER = ("ocean", "lake", "sea", "water", "ice sheet")


class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        import rimbridge_client as rb
        host, port, token = rb.resolve_endpoint()
        self.s = rb.RimBridge(host=host, port=port, token=token, timeout=280.0)
        self.s.connect()

    def call(self, t, **p):
        r = self.s.call(t, p) or {}
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("content"):
            try:
                r = json.loads(r["content"][0]["text"])
            except ValueError:
                pass
        return r


def geometry():
    g = ET.parse(GEOM).getroot().find(".//*[substellarLat]")
    return {k: float(g.findtext(k)) for k in ("substellarLat", "substellarLon", "terminatorBandMinArc", "nightsideBandMinArc")}


def arc(lat, lon, lat0, lon0):
    r = math.radians
    c = math.sin(r(lat0)) * math.sin(r(lat)) + math.cos(r(lat0)) * math.cos(r(lat)) * math.cos(r(lon - lon0))
    return math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, c))))


def candidates(g, geo, night):
    exp = g.call("jawa/world_tile_export")
    path = exp.get("path") or exp.get("pathWritten") or ""
    if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
        return None, "world_tile_export wrote no readable file: %s" % str(exp)[:300]
    out = []
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
            b = (row.get("biome") or "").lower()
            if not b or any(w in b for w in WATER):
                continue
            a = arc(float(row["lat"]), float(row["long"]), geo["substellarLat"], geo["substellarLon"])
            if (night and a > geo["nightsideBandMinArc"] + 5) or (not night and a < geo["terminatorBandMinArc"] - 5):
                out.append((int(row["tile"]), round(a, 1), row.get("biome")))
    random.shuffle(out)
    return out, "%d %s land tiles in %s" % (len(out), "nightside" if night else "dayside", path)


def make_map(g, tiles):
    for tile, a, biome in tiles[:25]:
        f = g.call("jawa/colony_found", tile=tile, name="HorrorProbe")
        if not f.get("success"):
            continue
        m = g.call("jawa/world_tile_map_generate", tile=tile)
        if m.get("success") and m.get("mapId") is not None:
            g.call("jawa/set_current_map", mapId=m["mapId"])
            return {"tile": tile, "arc": a, "biome": biome, "mapId": m["mapId"], "mapIndex": m.get("mapIndex")}
    return None


def count(g, defs, pawns=False):
    r = g.call("jawa/list_things", defName=",".join(defs), includePawns=pawns, limit=500)
    things = r.get("things") or r.get("results") or []
    return things


def drop(g, m):
    info = g.call("jawa/map_info")
    if m and info.get("tile") == m["tile"] and m.get("mapIndex") is not None:
        g.call("jawa/map_drop", mapIndex=m["mapIndex"], notifyPlayer=False)


def run(clause):
    geo = geometry()
    g = Game()
    if g.call("rimworld/get_game_info").get("status") != "game_loaded":
        print("FAIL %s: no game loaded" % clause)
        return 1
    night = clause == "A2"
    tiles, note = candidates(g, geo, night)
    print(note)
    if not tiles:
        print("FAIL %s: no candidate tile on this world" % clause)
        return 1
    m = make_map(g, tiles)
    if not m:
        print("FAIL %s: could not found+generate a map on any of %d candidate tiles" % (clause, min(25, len(tiles))))
        return 1
    print("map:", m)
    ok = False
    try:
        lair = count(g, LAIR)
        hives = [t for t in lair if t.get("def") == "RUT_HorrorHive"]
        if night:
            fire = g.call("jawa/fire_incident", incidentDef="RUT_HorrorRaid", forced=True)
            time.sleep(1)
            facs = g.call("jawa/list_factions", includeHidden=True, defName="RUT_Horrors")
            forms = [t for t in count(g, FORMS, pawns=True) if "Horror" in str(t.get("faction", "")) or "Assailant" in str(t.get("faction", ""))]
            print("lair things %d (hives %d); raid fired=%s canFireNow=%s blockedByDialog=%s; faction rows %s; Horror-faction forms on map %d"
                  % (len(lair), len(hives), fire.get("fired"), fire.get("canFireNow"), fire.get("blockedByDialog"), str(facs)[:200], len(forms)))
            ok = len(hives) >= 1 and fire.get("canFireNow") is True and fire.get("success") is True and len(forms) >= 1
        else:
            dry = g.call("jawa/fire_incident", incidentDef="RUT_HorrorRaid", forced=True, dryRun=True)
            print("lair things %d; dry-run canFireNow=%s" % (len(lair), dry.get("canFireNow")))
            ok = len(lair) == 0 and dry.get("canFireNow") is False
    finally:
        drop(g, m)
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + clause)
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in ("A2", "A3"):
        print(__doc__)
        sys.exit(1)
    sys.exit(run(sys.argv[1]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""RAIL_WALK live proof: the guardrail's walked-step door has a live control (RAIL_WALK_PROVE_NOBODY_WALKS_OFF_ANYWAY,
FALL_GUARDRAILS_BUILD_REAL_OBJECT A3).

  python.exe src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/northstar/rail_walk_live.py [out.json] [--origin X,Z] [--fresh-map]

Why a hook: the A3 run of 2026-10-18 ordered a Pirate at a 7 m pit's centre and it never stepped off the UNRAILED lip either
(with the cliff masks on, A* and the per-move floor refuse every walked step past a pawn's climb), so "the railed one did not
fall" proved nothing about the rail. RM_FallRails.ProofWalkedStep asks the REAL per-move floor (the Harmony prefix on
Pawn_PathFollower.TryEnterNextPathCell) which door refuses the step, then, with "force", makes the step the floor refused,
marked WALKED, so the descent detector judges a stale walked arrival on its next pass.

Scene (plot from --origin, default 120,200; 9 x 9 cleared + read back): a 7 m pit x = 2..6, z = 2..6 (14 notches);
RM_PitGuardrail (steel) on the west lip (1, 3); the west lip (1, 5) left bare. One hostile Pirate per lip, stepping east.
EXPECT  W1 railed lip: rail=True, door=rail, prefixPass=False (the rail door refuses first)
        W2 unrailed lip: rail=False, door=floor, prefixPass=False (nobody walks off anyway: the floor holds it)
        W3 railed, forced walked step: expect=putback; 3 ticks later the Pirate is on the lip, no new descent
        W4 unrailed, forced walked step (the control): expect=fell; 3 ticks later a new descent and the Pirate in the pit
LIES    a W3 pass with a W4 that does not fall would be the old A3 again (no control): W4 must FALL for W3 to mean anything.
Exit 0 = every row PASS; 1 = a row FAIL; 2 = UNMEASURED (no game, site, harness).
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if HERE not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
NSP = "RimMandrake.FlowWorks.RM_NorthstarProofs"
RAILS = "RimMandrake.FlowWorks.RM_FallRails"
ITEM = "RAIL_WALK_PROVE_NOBODY_WALKS_OFF_ANYWAY"


def parse_kv(s):
    """'WALK rail=True door=rail ...' -> {'rail': 'True', 'door': 'rail', ...}."""
    return dict(re.findall(r"(\w+)=(\S+)", s or ""))


def judge_floor(kv, railed):
    """W1/W2: which door refuses the walked step, railed vs unrailed."""
    if not kv:
        return False
    want_door = "rail" if railed else "floor"
    return kv.get("rail") == str(railed) and kv.get("door") == want_door and kv.get("prefixPass") == "False"


def judge_forced(kv, before, after, lip, railed):
    """W3/W4: the detector's verdict on a forced walked arrival. before/after: ProofTrap key/values."""
    if not kv or not before or not after:
        return False
    try:
        d0, d1 = int(before.get("descents")), int(after.get("descents"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
    on_lip = after.get("pos") == "%d,%d" % lip
    if railed:
        return kv.get("expect") == "putback" and on_lip and d1 == d0
    return kv.get("expect") == "fell" and not on_lip and d1 == d0 + 1


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("out", nargs="?", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--origin", default="120,200")
    ap.add_argument("--fresh-map", action="store_true")
    a = ap.parse_args()
    import proof_hose as PH  # noqa: E402
    V = PH.V
    B = PH.PB()
    out = a.out or os.path.join(HERE, "rail_walk_result_%s.json" % time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"))
    rows = []
    res = {"script": "rail_walk_live.py", "started": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "rows": rows, "args": vars(a)}

    def save():
        with open(out + ".tmp", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(res, f, indent=1, default=str)
        os.replace(out + ".tmp", out)

    def row(rid, st, cls, det):
        rows.append({"id": rid, "status": st, "class": cls, "item": ITEM, "detail": det})
        print("%-22s %-10s %-6s %s" % (rid, st, cls, json.dumps(det, default=str)[:700]), flush=True)
        save()

    def call(ty, m, arg):
        r = B.call("jawa/static_call", type=ty, method=m, args=arg, _answer=True) or {}
        return str(r.get("result") or r.get("message") or "")

    def ticks(n):
        return (B.call("rimworld/step_game_ticks", ticks=n, pauseFirst=True, timeoutMs=60000) or {}).get("success") is not False

    ox, oz = (int(v) for v in a.origin.split(","))
    P = lambda dx, dz: (ox + dx, oz + dz)  # noqa: E731
    xz = lambda c: "%d,%d" % c  # noqa: E731
    if a.fresh_map:
        B.call("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
        B.call("rimworld/start_debug_game_ready", readiness="mapData", pauseIfNeeded=True, timeoutMs=280000)
    ok, _ = V._wait_playing(B, leave_s=0)
    if not ok:
        row("W0_site", "UNMEASURED", "HARNESS", {"why": "no game in Playing"})
        return 2
    res["site_calm"] = V.site_calm(B)
    rect = (ox, oz, 9, 9)
    B.call("jawa/static_call", type=NSP, method="ProofResetRect", args="%d;%d;%d;%d" % rect)
    site_rows = []
    V.prepare_site(B, rect, site_rows, "rail_walk_site")
    if [r for r in site_rows if r.get("status") not in (None, "PASS")]:
        row("W0_site", "UNMEASURED", "SITE", {"why": "site not prepared", "site": site_rows[:2]})
        return 2
    for x in range(2, 7):
        for z in range(2, 7):
            c = P(x, z)
            B.call("jawa/flowworks_excavation_drive", x=c[0], z=c[1], deepenLevels=14, setFill=-1)
    railed_lip, bare_lip = P(1, 3), P(1, 5)
    railed_drop, bare_drop = P(2, 3), P(2, 5)
    B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="RM_PitGuardrail:%s" % xz(railed_lip), stuff="Steel", faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
    ticks(5)
    pre = {}
    lt = B.call("jawa/list_things", defName="RM_PitGuardrail", rect="%d,%d,1,1" % railed_lip, limit=2, _answer=True) or {}
    pre["guardrail"] = str(lt)[:200]

    def spawn(c):
        r = B.call("jawa/spawn_pawn", kindDef="Pirate", x=c[0], z=c[1], faction="hostile", count=1) or {}
        return ((r.get("pawns") or [{}])[0]).get("id")

    pr, pb = spawn(railed_lip), spawn(bare_lip)
    if not pr or not pb:
        row("W0_site", "UNMEASURED", "HARNESS", dict(pre, why="a Pirate did not spawn", railed=pr, bare=pb))
        return 2
    ticks(2)
    # W1 / W2: the real per-move floor's verdict, no step taken
    w1 = call(RAILS, "ProofWalkedStep", "%s;%s;%s" % (pr, xz(railed_lip), xz(railed_drop)))
    w2 = call(RAILS, "ProofWalkedStep", "%s;%s;%s" % (pb, xz(bare_lip), xz(bare_drop)))
    for rid, s, railed in (("W1_railed_door", w1, True), ("W2_unrailed_floor", w2, False)):
        kv = parse_kv(s)
        if not s.startswith("WALK"):
            row(rid, "UNMEASURED", "HARNESS", dict(pre, answer=s))
        else:
            row(rid, "PASS" if judge_floor(kv, railed) else "FAIL", "MOD", dict(pre, answer=s))
    # W3 then W4: a forced walked step each, judged by the detector on its next pass
    for rid, pid, lip, drop, railed in (("W3_railed_putback", pr, railed_lip, railed_drop, True),
                                        ("W4_unrailed_falls", pb, bare_lip, bare_drop, False)):
        before = parse_kv(call(NSP, "ProofTrap", str(pid)))
        s = call(RAILS, "ProofWalkedStep", "%s;%s;%s;force" % (pid, xz(lip), xz(drop)))
        ticks(3)
        after = parse_kv(call(NSP, "ProofTrap", str(pid)))
        det = {"answer": s, "before": before, "after": after}
        if not s.startswith("WALK") or not before or not after:
            row(rid, "UNMEASURED", "HARNESS", det)
        else:
            row(rid, "PASS" if judge_forced(parse_kv(s), before, after, lip, railed) else "FAIL", "MOD", det)
    for pid in (pr, pb):
        B.call("jawa/pawn_force_incapacitate", pawn=pid, action="vanish", _answer=True)
    res["finished"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    save()
    st = [r["status"] for r in rows]
    if "FAIL" in st:
        return 1
    return 0 if st and all(s == "PASS" for s in st) and len(st) == 4 else 2


if __name__ == "__main__":

def _canvas_for(rel):
    n = rel.split("/")[-1]
    if n.startswith("Strand") or n in ("SpanShadow", "SpanWire"):
        return (128, 32)
    if n == "TapClamp":

    if n in ("EndFrayed_Dead", "EndFrayed_Live", "SparkGlow"):
        return (64, 64)
    if n == "PowerStrip":
        return (64, 32)
    if n in ("AerialMast", "AerialLampMast"):
        return (128, 256)
    return (128, 128)


def png_sanity(rel):
    """None if the PNG is sane, else why: RGBA, exact canvas, real transparency, not empty, not magenta; a strip
    (Strand*, SpanShadow) must tile: edge-column diff <= max(1.5 x mean adjacent diff, +4)."""
    from PIL import Image
    import numpy as np
    p = os.path.join(HERE, "Textures", "RimMandrake", "GimmeSomeSlack", rel + ".png")
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        return "missing"
    im = Image.open(p)
    if im.mode != "RGBA":
        return "mode %s" % im.mode
    want = _canvas_for(rel)
    if im.size != want:
        return "size %s != %s" % (im.size, want)
    a = np.asarray(im).astype(np.float32)
    al = a[:, :, 3]
    if (al > 8).mean() < 0.01:
        return "empty"
    if (al < 8).mean() < 0.02 and not rel.split("/")[-1].startswith("Strand"):
        return "no transparency"
    vis = a[al > 128][:, :3]
    if len(vis) and ((vis[:, 0] > 200) & (vis[:, 1] < 60) & (vis[:, 2] > 200)).mean() > 0.2:
        return "magenta"
    n = rel.split("/")[-1]
    if n.startswith("Strand") or n == "SpanShadow":
        pm = np.concatenate([a[:, :, :3] * (a[:, :, 3:4] / 255.0), a[:, :, 3:4]], axis=2)
        edge = float(np.abs(pm[:, 0] - pm[:, -1]).mean())
        adj = float(np.abs(np.diff(pm, axis=1)).mean())
        if edge > max(1.5 * adj, adj + 4.0):
            return "seam %.1f vs adjacent %.1f" % (edge, adj)
    return None

def visible_fire_hose(paths):
    """Case-insensitive 'fire hose' / 'firehose' / 'fire-hose' hits in player- or reviewer-visible text (B20): every line
    of the given files except C#/Python identifiers. Returns [(path, line_no, text)]."""
    import re
    rx = re.compile(r"fire[\s_-]?hoses?", re.I)
    hits = []
    for p in paths:
        try:
            lines = open(p, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            continue
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines, 1):
            if any(q in ln for q in OWNER_WORDS):
                continue                         # the owner's verbatim words are quoted, never reworded
            for m in rx.finditer(ln):
                pre, post = ln[m.start() - 1:m.start()], ln[m.end():m.end() + 1]
                if "_" in m.group(0) or (pre and (pre.isalnum() or pre == "_")) or (post and (post.isalnum() or post == "_")):
                    continue                     # an identifier (FireHosesMod, fire_hose_x), not text
                hits.append((os.path.relpath(p, REPO), i, ln.strip()[:120]))
    return hits

def tap_letter_problems(anchors_xml, theft_cs):
    """GPT pre-release C5: the theft letter may only offer what the clamp has. 'switch off' needs a CompFlickable on
    RM_PowerTapClamp."""
    import re
    import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
    clamp = next((d for d in ET.parse(anchors_xml).getroot() if d.findtext("defName") == "RM_PowerTapClamp"), None)
    if clamp is None:
        return ["RM_PowerTapClamp not found in %s" % os.path.basename(anchors_xml)]
    flick = any(li.get("Class") == "CompProperties_Flickable" for li in clamp.iter("li"))
    body = open(theft_cs, encoding="utf-8").read()
    advice = re.search(r'StopAdvice\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"', body)
    if not advice:
        return ["PowerTheftConsequences.StopAdvice not found"]
    if "switch" in advice.group(1).lower() and not flick:
        return ["C5: the theft letter says %r but the clamp has no CompFlickable" % advice.group(1)]
    return []


def unsaved_component_problems(src_dir):
    """SL2 offline (GSS_SESSION_RESET_REPAIR_SNEAKS_INTO_SAVES, L1 2026-10-15): every Game/Map/WorldComponent GSS
    defines is written into the save as <li Class=...> unless an Expose* patch drops it while saving. So each such class
    must be named by a `c is <Class>` in a [HarmonyPatch(typeof(Game|Map|World), "Expose...")] class. GssSessionReset
    (e42ac437f0) had none and every save named it."""
    import re
    bodies = {}
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(src_dir, "**", "*.cs"), recursive=True):
        if os.sep + "SelfTest" + os.sep in path:
            continue
        bodies[path] = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    comps = set()
    skipped = set()
    for body in bodies.values():
        comps.update(re.findall(r"class\s+(\w+)\s*:\s*(?:GameComponent|MapComponent|WorldComponent)\b", body))
        for m in re.finditer(r'HarmonyPatch\(typeof\((?:Game|Map|World)\),\s*"Expose\w*"\)\]', body):
            nxt = body.find("HarmonyPatch(", m.end())
            skipped.update(re.findall(r"c is (\w+)\)", body[m.end():nxt if nxt > 0 else len(body)]))
    return ["%s is saved (no Expose* patch drops it while saving)" % c for c in sorted(comps - skipped)]

def lamp_register_problems(ours, vanilla):
    """What differs between our lamp mast's light and vanilla's standing lamp (both ThingDef elements). Owner by card
    2026-10-11: "They should be registered just like vanilla Rimworld handles wall lights. Same register." 1.6 code finds
    a light by CompGlower alone, and AtmosphericBase discovers emitters by Building + CompGlower, so the register is:
    category Building, the CompGlower's fields, the ColoredLights power upgrade, Flickable and PlaceWorker_GlowRadius."""
    def glower(d):
        return next((li for li in d.iter("li") if li.get("Class") == "CompProperties_Glower"), None)
    probs = []
    go, gv = glower(ours), glower(vanilla)
    if go is None:
        return ["no CompProperties_Glower on the mast"]
    for f in ("glowRadius", "glowColor", "colorPickerEnabled", "darklightToggle"):
        a, b = (go.findtext(f) or "").replace(" ", ""), (gv.findtext(f) or "").replace(" ", "") if gv is not None else None

def origin_for_anchor(anchor, size_x, size_z, margin=3):
    """The scene origin that centres the scene on `anchor`, clamped so the whole SITE (+margin) is on the map."""
    mx0, mz0, mx1, mz1 = SCENE_EXTENT
    x = anchor[0] - (mx0 + mx1) // 2
    z = anchor[1] - (mz0 + mz1) // 2
    x = max(margin - mx0, min(size_x - 1 - margin - mx1, x))
    z = max(margin - mz0, min(size_z - 1 - margin - mz1, z))
    return x, z

def _reraise_harness_stop(ex):
    """A detector / clock abort (watch.SurpriseAbort) or a failed clock-verified wait must end the suite
    component, never be folded into a block's own FAIL row (that would charge the environment to the mod)."""
    if getattr(ex, "is_surprise_abort", False) or isinstance(ex, ExpectationFailed):
        raise ex


def live_battery(B, fresh_map=False, rows=None):
    """The live tier on B's map. `rows` (optional) is filled in place, so a caller sees every row measured
    before an abort."""
    rows = [] if rows is None else rows
    log = []
    res = {"mod": MOD, "mode": "live", "tier": TIER, "started": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "rows": rows}
    if fresh_map:
        import bridge_concurrency_guard as _G
        _G.refuse_if_foreign_activity("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
        B.call("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
        r = B.call("rimworld/start_debug_game_ready", readiness="mapData", pauseIfNeeded=True, timeoutMs=280000)
        st = None
        for _ in range(90):
            st = B.call("rimworld/get_ui_state").get("programState")
            if st == "Playing" and B.call("jawa/map_info").get("success"):
                break
            time.sleep(2)
        hrow(rows, "L0_fresh_map", "PASS" if st == "Playing" else "FAIL", "SITE", {"start": r.get("success"), "programState": st})
        if st != "Playing":
            res["aborted"] = "no fresh map"
            return res
    # environment fingerprint for `modcheck record`
    env = {}
    rm = B.call("jawa/running_mods", assembly="RimMandrakeGimmeSomeSlack", details=False)
    if rm.get("success"):
        import hashlib
        env["running"] = [p.lower() for p in rm.get("packageIds") or []]
        env["running_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256("\n".join(env["running"]).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
        ms = (rm.get("assembly") or {}).get("matches") or []
        env["assembly_matches"] = len(ms)
    res["env"] = env
    try:
        sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(UTILS, "modcheck"))
        import status as _mc  # noqa: E402
        res["mod_hash"] = _mc.mod_hash(HERE)          # the mod DIR; a bare name hashes nothing
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001
        res["mod_hash"] = None
        log.append("mod_hash unavailable: %s" % ex)
    hrow(rows, "L1_tier_running", "PASS" if PKG in env.get("running", []) else "FAIL", "SITE",
        "%d mods running, gimmesomeslack %s" % (len(env.get("running", [])), PKG in env.get("running", [])))
    lg0 = B.call("rimbridge/list_logs", limit=500, minimumLevel="warning")
    logs0 = lg0.get("logs") or []
    log_base = max([x.get("Sequence", 0) for x in logs0] or [0])
    bridge_line = any("[RimBridge]" in (x.get("Message") or "") for x in logs0)
    pre = [x.get("Message", "")[:200] for x in logs0 if "GimmeSomeSlack" in (x.get("Message", "") + x.get("StackTrace", ""))
           and (x.get("Level") or "").lower() in ("error", "exception")]
    if not bridge_line:
        # 2026-10-10 (550-mod list): chatty mods push the startup out of the bridge's last 500 entries; Player.log has it
        # (same fallback as proof_all P2)
        try:
            with open(PLAYER_LOG, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
                lines = f.read().splitlines()
            bridge_line = any("[RimBridge]" in ln for ln in lines)
            pre = [ln[:200] for ln in lines if "GimmeSomeSlack" in ln and ("Exception" in ln or "rror" in ln)][:6]
        except OSError:
            pass
    hrow(rows, "L2_startup_log_clean", ("PASS" if not pre else "FAIL") if bridge_line else "UNMEASURED", "MOD",
        pre or "no GimmeSomeSlack error in %d warn+ startup entries (sanity: [RimBridge] line seen=%s)" % (len(logs0), bridge_line))
    pd = B.probe("defaults")
    if not pd.get("success"):
        res["aborted"] = "probe channel dead: %s" % pd
        row(rows, "L3_probe_channel", "FAIL", "HARNESS", pd)
        return res
    t_start = B.probe("census").get("ticksGame")

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- site and scene
    x, z, w, h = SITE
    B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE, categories="All")

    b5 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="StandingLamp:%d,%d" % LAMP, faction="player")
    built = {k: (v.get("survived"), len(v.get("failed") or [])) for k, v in

    bat_id = None

    c0 = B.probe("census")

    want_types = {"battery", "consumer", "junction", "stub_wall"}

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- determinism (fresh builder, same map)

    m2 = all(c.get("cordsAcrossNets") == 0 and c.get("cordEndsWithoutNet") == 0 for c in (c0, c2))

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- M7: master off -> vanilla art

    m7 = (not c4.get("invisibleApplied")) and tp4 and all(v != TRANSPARENT for v in tp4.values()) and \
        c4.get("spawnedConduitTexture") not in (None, "ConduitTransparent") and not c4.get("layerVisible")
    row(rows, "M7_off_restores_vanilla", "PASS" if m7 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"texPaths": tp4, "spawned": c4.get("spawnedConduitTexture"), "layerVisible": c4.get("layerVisible")})
    B.probe("set:enabled=True")
    c5 = B.probe("census")
    row(rows, "M7b_on_again_invisible", "PASS" if c5.get("spawnedConduitTexture") == "ConduitTransparent" and c5.get("layerVerts", 0) > 0 else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {"spawned": c5.get("spawnedConduitTexture"), "layerVerts": c5.get("layerVerts")})
    B.probe("defaults")
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- log budget
    lg = B.call("rimbridge/list_logs", limit=500, minimumLevel="warning")
    new = [e for e in lg.get("logs") or [] if (e.get("Sequence") or 0) > log_base]
    errs = [e for e in new if str(e.get("Level", "")).lower() in ("error", "exception")]
    # the scene clear's own destroy_batch over a map geyser/monolith ("Tried to destroy non-destroyable thing
    # SteamGeyser..."): the harness, not the mod -- counted, never charged to the mod (run_live.py does the same)
    site = [e for e in errs if "non-destroyable" in str(e.get("Message", ""))]
    errs = [e for e in errs if e not in site]
    if not SHARED:                   # SHARED: one run-end log budget over the whole session (proof_all Z)
        row(rows, "Z_log_budget", "PASS" if not errs else "FAIL", "MOD",
            {"errors": [str(e.get("Message", ""))[:200] for e in errs[:6]], "newWarnings": len(new), "siteClearErrors": len(site)})
    t_end = B.probe("census").get("ticksGame")
    res["ticks"] = (t_end - t_start) if isinstance(t_end, int) and isinstance(t_start, int) else None
    res["log"] = log
    return res

# a run east into a wall that carries one buried conduit cell (a live WALL terminal = downed wire, outdoors so

SHOTS = os.path.join(REPO, "Transient", "messy_conduit_live_20261002")


def shot(B, name, rect, log, pad=1, root=None):
    import shutil
    kw = {} if root is None else {"rootSize": root}
    r = B.call("rimworld/screenshot_cell_rect", x=rect[0], z=rect[1], width=rect[2], height=rect[3], paddingCells=pad,
               fileName=name, suppressMessage=True, **kw)
    src = r.get("path") or r.get("filePath")
    dst = None
    try:
        if src and os.path.exists(src):
            os.makedirs(SHOTS, exist_ok=True)
            dst = os.path.join(SHOTS, name + os.path.splitext(src)[1])
            shutil.copyfile(src, dst)
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001
        log.append("screenshot copy failed %s: %r" % (name, ex))
    log.append({"shot": name, "src": src, "dst": dst, "ok": r.get("success")})
    return dst


def motion(B, frames=2):
    """The motion counters describe the LAST drawn frame: read twice so a setting change has been drawn."""
    m = {}
    for _ in range(frames):
        m = B.probe("motion")
        time.sleep(0.25)
    return m


def lane_a_live(B, rows, log):
    b1 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("Wall", WALL2), stuff="Steel", faction="player")
    b2 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="Battery:%d,%d,0" % BAT2, faction="player")
    b3 = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=ops("PowerConduit", FIELD + RUN2), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
    bat2 = None
    for t in B.call("jawa/list_things", defName="Battery", limit=10).get("things") or []:
        pos = t.get("position") or t.get("pos") or t.get("cell")
        xz = (pos.get("x"), pos.get("z")) if isinstance(pos, dict) else (tuple(pos[:1]) + tuple(pos[-1:]) if pos else None)
        if xz == BAT2:                       # a dict pos used to be sliced first (TypeError) before its own branch
            bat2 = t.get("id") or t.get("thingId")
    if not bat2:
        lst = B.call("jawa/list_things", defName="Battery", limit=10).get("things") or []
        bat2 = (lst[-1].get("id") or lst[-1].get("thingId")) if lst else None
    bs = B.call("jawa/battery_set", thing=bat2, mode="setPct", value=1.0) if bat2 else {}
    frame_fit(B, SITE)   # 2026-10-10: the kept zoom can be a 12x6 view on the full list (B7 swayDraws 0, R2)
    B.ticks(2)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    B.probe("poll")
    m0 = motion(B)
    log.append({"lane_a_m0": m0, "plot": {"walls": b1.get("survived"), "battery": bat2, "conduit": b3.get("survived"),
                                          "stored": bs.get("storedEnergyAfter")}})
    hrow(rows, "P1B_plot_built", "PASS" if b3.get("survived") == len(FIELD + RUN2) and bs.get("storedEnergyAfter", 0) > 0 else "FAIL",
        "SITE", {"conduit": b3.get("survived"), "battery2": bat2, "stored": bs.get("storedEnergyAfter")})
    # owner review 2026-10-04 B1: power strips are the Modern (ExtensionCord) look only; the default Scrapper look's
    # pile is junction boxes. So the strip rows (B6, B6b) read the field in the Modern look; settle is look-agnostic.
    B.probe("set:style=ExtensionCord")
    B.ticks(2)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    m0 = motion(B)
    # B1 settle
    row(rows, "B1_rope_settle", "PASS" if m0.get("settledStrands", 0) > 0 and m0.get("settleMaxStretch", 1) < 0.03 and
        m0.get("settleMaxLenDev", 1) <= 0.05 else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {k: m0.get(k) for k in ("settledStrands", "settleMaxStretch", "settleMaxLenDev", "endHeaps", "laidPoints", "lastRebuildMs")})
    # L2 tangle entity + lit strips
    row(rows, "B6_tangle_lit_strips", "PASS" if m0.get("tangles", 0) >= 1 and m0.get("litStrips", 0) > 0 and m0.get("darkStrips", 1) == 0 else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {k: m0.get(k) for k in ("tangles", "tangleMinUsed", "litStrips", "darkStrips", "stubs", "mergedStubs")})
    shot(B, "p1b_01_wide", SITE, log)
    shot(B, "p1b_02_tangle_lit_and_downed_wire", (X0 + 18, Z0 + 6, 10, 6), log, root=7)
    # B3 whip
    w_on = m0.get("whipDraws", 0)
    B.probe("set:whip=False")
    frame_fit(B, SITE)   # the shots above re-centred the camera; whip draws count only what is on screen
    m1 = motion(B)
    B.probe("set:whip=True")
    m1b = motion(B)
    row(rows, "B3_whip_live_ends", "PASS" if w_on > 0 and m0.get("whipTails", 0) > 0 and m1.get("whipDraws") == 0 and m1b.get("whipDraws", 0) > 0 else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {"whipDraws_on": w_on, "whipTails": m0.get("whipTails"), "liveFloorEnds": m0.get("liveFloorEnds"),
                "deadFloorEnds": m0.get("deadFloorEnds"), "whipDraws_off": m1.get("whipDraws"), "whipDraws_on_again": m1b.get("whipDraws")})
    # B4 downed-wire schedule: real time, histogram of events (counts while paused; flecks only while time runs)
    B.probe("motionreset")
    hist, t0 = {}, time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < 45:

def same_frame_dirty_live(B, rows):
    """GPT pre-release A8 (PLAUSIBLE): a visible dirty event landing after this frame's rebuild may be dropped by the
    builtFrame latch (PiecesForSection rebuilds only when Time.frameCount != builtFrame). The probe's sameframe: verb does
    it all inside ONE frame (it runs in MapComponentUpdate): Rebuild(), one steel wall on a plain floor strand's middle
    cell in SITE (on screen), then vanilla Section.TryUpdate on the sections around it, which regenerates our layer and
    consumes the dirty flags. Two frames later `fresh` (a from-scratch build) must match the laid pieces and `strands:`
    must show every strand drawn by exactly one path. A wall that does not change the route proves nothing: SITE."""
    frame_fit(B, SITE)                        # on screen: the dirty patch leaves on-screen sections to the layer itself
    B.ticks(2)
    try:
        sf = B.probe("sameframe:%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)
        B.ticks(2)
        motion(B, 2)                          # >= 2 drawn frames after the probe frame (B.ticks alone may not render)
        fr = B.probe("fresh")
        st = B.probe("strands:%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)
    finally:                                  # review: the wall never outlives the row
        cl = B.probe("sameframe:clear")
    B.ticks(2)
    d = {k: sf.get(k) for k in ("success", "error", "cell", "oneFrame", "onScreen", "sectionsTried", "sectionsRegenerated",
                                "wallChangesRoute", "inFrameStale", "preHash", "afterRegenHash", "freshHash")}
    d.update({"fresh": {k: fr.get(k) for k in ("edges", "same", "different", "missing", "extra")},
              "badPaths": st.get("badPaths"), "cleared": cl.get("destroyed")})
    if not sf.get("success") or not sf.get("oneFrame") or not sf.get("onScreen") or not sf.get("wallChangesRoute") \
            or not sf.get("sectionsRegenerated") or not fr.get("success") or not fr.get("edges"):
        row(rows, "A8_same_frame_dirty_not_dropped", "UNMEASURED", "SITE", d)
        return
    ok = fr.get("different") == 0 and fr.get("missing") == 0 and fr.get("extra") == 0 and st.get("badPaths") == 0
    row(rows, "A8_same_frame_dirty_not_dropped", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL", "MOD", d)

    keys = ("dives", "unroutable", "pieces", "decals")

    d = {"on": {k: on.get(k) for k in keys}, "off": {k: off.get(k) for k in keys},
         "ring": w.get("survived"), "heater": h.get("survived"), "consumers": cons}
