SLIDE_FRAC = 0.18                    # CordGraph.SlideFrac
PLUG_OUT = 0.08                      # CordGraph.PlugPoint: the plug sits 0.08 outside the footprint side
FRAC_TOL = 0.025                     # 0.18+tol < 0.25-tol: the ON and OFF fraction sets never overlap


def plug_tip(poly, fp):
    """The plug point of one laid cord strand into a machine of footprint fp = (x0, z0, w, h), from the rect census
    polyline (stride 1). IntoArt appends the run from the plug point on into the centroid, so walk from the end that
    sits on the centroid outward; the first vertex at least 0.07 outside the footprint is the plug point (the slide's
    carry samples reach only 0.045 outside, the straight run's last sample 0.03). None when no end is on the centroid.
    Returns (x, z, side, frac): side 'x' when the plug is off an x side (its along coordinate is z), frac = the along
    coordinate's fraction within its cell."""
    if not poly or len(poly) < 2:
        return None
    x0, z0, w, h = fp
    x1, z1 = x0 + w, z0 + h
    cx, cz = x0 + w / 2.0, z0 + h / 2.0

    def near_c(p):
        return abs(p[0] - cx) < 0.06 and abs(p[1] - cz) < 0.06
    if near_c(poly[-1]):
        walk = list(reversed(poly))
    elif near_c(poly[0]):
        walk = list(poly)
    else:
        return None
    for x, z in walk:
        ox, oz = max(x0 - x, x - x1, 0.0), max(z0 - z, z - z1, 0.0)
        if max(ox, oz) >= 0.07:
            side = "x" if ox >= oz else "z"
            along = z if side == "x" else x
            return (x, z, side, round(along - math.floor(along), 4))
    return None


def slide_under_verdict(tips, slide_on):
    """M12 slideUnder, one side. ON every plug point sits SlideFrac (0.18) in from a corner of its cell along the side
    (0.18 or 0.82); OFF it sits on the hookup's cell centre clamped 0.25 in from the footprint corners (0.25, 0.5 or
    0.75). No tip -> (UNMEASURED, SITE): the heater never hooked up, the row could not ask."""
    if not tips:
        return "UNMEASURED", "SITE"
    targets = (SLIDE_FRAC, 1 - SLIDE_FRAC) if slide_on else (0.25, 0.5, 0.75)
    ok = all(any(abs(t[3] - g) <= FRAC_TOL for g in targets) for t in tips)
    return ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"), "MOD"


def slide_under_live(B, rows, log):
    """M12a/M12b (slideUnder, default on; GSS_SWITCHES_PROVE_LAST_FOUR_STANDING). A lone heater north of the main run
    (the M11 pocket cell, ring gone) cords to the conduit.
    PROVE  set:slideUnder=False / True, rebuild, rect census polylines (stride 1) -> plug_tip() of every strand that ends
           on the heater's centroid; geometryHash of the rect each way.
    EXPECT OFF: every plug fraction in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75} (+-0.025); ON: every one in {0.18, 0.82}; the hash differs
           ON vs OFF and the restored setting reads back (census settings) as it was before the row.
    LIES   a deployed build whose CordGraph.PlugPoint changed its constants reads FAIL, not a lie; a cord into some other
           machine whose end also lies on the heater centre would be counted (none in this rect); fewer than one strand
           each way is UNMEASURED/SITE, never a pass. It reads the laid geometry, not the drawn picture."""
    hx, hz = POCKET_HEATER
    rect = "%d,%d,%d,%d,200000" % (X0 + 3, Z0 + 3, 5, 9)
    fp = (hx, hz, 1, 1)
    prior = (B.probe("census").get("settings") or {}).get("slideUnder")
    h = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="Heater:%d,%d,0" % (hx, hz), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
    B.ticks(2)                       # the connector hooks up on the next tick (as M11)
    res = {}
    try:
        for val in ("False", "True"):
            s = B.probe("set:slideUnder=%s" % val)
            B.probe("rebuild")
            B.ticks(2)
            rc = B.probe("rect:" + rect)
            tips = [t for t in (plug_tip(p, fp) for p in rc.get("polylines") or []) if t]
            res[val] = {"readback": s.get("value"), "hash": rc.get("geometryHash"), "stride": rc.get("polyStride"),
                        "tips": tips, "rectOk": bool(rc.get("success"))}
    finally:
        back = "True" if prior not in ("True", "False") else prior
        B.probe("set:slideUnder=%s" % back)
        B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,1,1" % (hx, hz), categories="Building")
        B.probe("rebuild")
        after = (B.probe("census").get("settings") or {}).get("slideUnder")
    off, on = res.get("False", {}), res.get("True", {})
    d = {"heater": h.get("survived"), "off": off, "on": on, "prior": prior, "restored": after}
    log.append({"M12_slide_under": d})
    if after != back:
        row(rows, "M12_restore_setting", "FAIL", "HARNESS", {"prior": prior, "restored": after})
    ids = (("M12a_slide_under_off_plug_on_cell_centre", off, False, "False"),
           ("M12b_slide_under_on_plug_off_centre", on, True, "True"))
    stride1 = all(str(x.get("stride")) == "1" for x in (off, on))
    for rid, side, slide_on, want in ids:
        if not h.get("survived") or not side.get("rectOk") or not stride1:
            row(rows, rid, "UNMEASURED", "SITE" if not h.get("survived") else "HARNESS", d)
            continue
        st, cl = slide_under_verdict(side.get("tips"), slide_on)
        if st == "PASS" and (side.get("readback") != want or on.get("hash") == off.get("hash")):
            st = "FAIL"              # the switch did not take, or the geometry did not move
        row(rows, rid, st, cl, {"readback": side.get("readback"), "fracs": [t[3] for t in side.get("tips") or []],
                                "hashOff": off.get("hash"), "hashOn": on.get("hash"), "tips": side.get("tips")})

    """GSS_HOOKUP_CABLE_PROBE_HIDDEN_CONDUIT, GPT pre-release B13 (PLAUSIBLE): a device hooked to a HIDDEN conduit is classed
    PatchCable, and the hookup patch then PRINTS the look's thick cable to it, if vanilla reaches PrintWirePieceConnecting for
    hidden conduit at all. A lamp 3 cells from a hidden-conduit line (the M11 pocket, cleared by then): the census counter
    hookupCablesPrinted must not move. A rise confirms B13 (a cosmetic call for the owner); no HiddenConduit def is UNMEASURED.
    B12 (shader-sway strands drawn once at near and far zoom) follows: shader_sway_far_zoom_live."""
    x0, z0 = POCKET_RECT[0], POCKET_RECT[1]
    before = B.probe("census")
    try:
        hc = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops=";".join("HiddenConduit:%d,%d" % (x0 + i, z0) for i in range(5)), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
        lamp = B.call("jawa/build_batch", ops="StandingLamp:%d,%d,0" % (x0 + 2, z0 + 3), faction="player", wipeExisting=False)
        frame_fit(B, POCKET_RECT)    # the hookup is PRINTED on section regeneration, which needs the section on screen
        B.ticks(3)
        after = B.probe("census")
    finally:                         # review: never leave the line or the lamp in later rows' pocket
        B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,%d,%d" % POCKET_RECT, categories="Building")
    d = {"hidden": hc.get("survived"), "lamp": lamp.get("survived"),
         "printed": [before.get("hookupCablesPrinted"), after.get("hookupCablesPrinted")],
         "suppressed": [before.get("hookupWiresSuppressed"), after.get("hookupWiresSuppressed")]}
    # review: the hookup must have been printed at all (cable printed or wire suppressed), or the row exercised nothing
    hooked = (int(after.get("hookupCablesPrinted") or 0) + int(after.get("hookupWiresSuppressed") or 0)) - \
             (int(before.get("hookupCablesPrinted") or 0) + int(before.get("hookupWiresSuppressed") or 0))
    d["hookupPrints"] = hooked
    if not hc.get("survived") or not lamp.get("survived") or after.get("hookupCablesPrinted") is None or hooked < 1:
        row(rows, "B13_hidden_conduit_hookup_not_drawn", "UNMEASURED", "SITE", d)
    else:
        moved = int(after["hookupCablesPrinted"]) - int(before.get("hookupCablesPrinted") or 0)
        row(rows, "B13_hidden_conduit_hookup_not_drawn", "PASS" if moved == 0 else "FAIL", "MOD", dict(d, moved=moved))
    shader_sway_far_zoom_live(B, rows)


def shader_sway_far_zoom_live(B, rows):
    """GPT pre-release B12: swayMode=Shader + lod on, the WALL2 terminal's hanging (lifted) strands in SITE. A shader
    strand is printed ONCE in a full-detail CutoutPlant sub-mesh; at far zoom DrawLayer disables every full sub-mesh and
    DrawMotion draws no geometry, so the LOD strand is the one draw. Near: plant sub-meshes enabled (shaderEnabled > 0),
    no CPU sway draw (swayDraws 0), and every lifted strand in SITE printedStatic with paths == 1 (strands:). Far (the
    camera's maximum root, as B8): lodFarNow, shaderEnabled 0, swayDraws 0, lodEnabled > 0, fullEnabled 0. No lifted
    strand, or no plant sway in prefs (the shader route is off), is UNMEASURED SITE. Settings and zoom are restored."""
    m0 = B.probe("motion")
    prev_mode, prev_lod = m0.get("swayModeSetting") or "CPU", m0.get("lodSetting")
    cam = B.call("rimworld/get_camera_state")   # review: read before the sets, so nothing can raise between them and the try
    try:
        B.probe("set:swayMode=Shader")
        B.probe("set:lod=True")
        frame_fit(B, SITE)
        B.ticks(2)
        near = motion(B, 3)
        sn = B.probe("strands:%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)
        far_root = max(58, int(((cam.get("sizeRange") or {}).get("max")) or 58))
        B.call("rimworld/set_camera_zoom", rootSize=far_root)
        t_z = time.time()
        far = motion(B, 3)
        while far.get("zoom") != "Furthest" and time.time() - t_z < 5.0:
            far = motion(B, 2)
        sf = B.probe("strands:%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE)
    finally:
        B.call("rimworld/set_camera_zoom", rootSize=cam.get("rootSize") or 24)
        B.probe("set:swayMode=%s" % prev_mode)
        B.probe("set:lod=%s" % ("False" if prev_lod is False else "True"))   # an unread setting restores the shipped default (on)
        frame_fit(B, SITE)
        B.ticks(2)
    lifted = [x for x in (sn.get("strands") or []) if x.get("lifted") and x.get("ownerPrinted")]
    keys = ("zoom", "swayMode", "swayModeReason", "lodFarNow", "shaderSubMeshes", "shaderEnabled", "swayDraws",
            "lodEnabled", "fullEnabled", "plantWindSway")
    d = {"near": {k: near.get(k) for k in keys}, "far": {k: far.get(k) for k in keys},
         "liftedNear": [[x.get("key"), x.get("printedStatic"), x.get("dynamic"), x.get("paths")] for x in lifted],
         "farLiftedDynamic": sum(1 for x in (sf.get("strands") or []) if x.get("lifted") and x.get("dynamic")),
         "restored": [prev_mode, prev_lod]}
    if near.get("swayMode") != "Shader" or not lifted:
        row(rows, "B12_shader_sway_far_zoom_drawn_once", "UNMEASURED", "SITE", d)
        return
    near_ok = ((near.get("shaderEnabled") or 0) > 0 and near.get("swayDraws") == 0 and not near.get("lodFarNow") and
               all(x.get("printedStatic") and not x.get("dynamic") and x.get("paths") == 1 for x in lifted))
    far_ok = (far.get("lodFarNow") is True and far.get("shaderEnabled") == 0 and far.get("swayDraws") == 0 and
              (far.get("lodEnabled") or 0) > 0 and far.get("fullEnabled") == 0 and d["farLiftedDynamic"] == 0)
    row(rows, "B12_shader_sway_far_zoom_drawn_once", "PASS" if near_ok and far_ok else "FAIL", "MOD", d)

def style_live(B, rows, log, shots_prefix=None):
    """ST rows: every style loads every texture it needs (no null / bad / missing material, fallbacks only to
    the Jawa slots no family has art for), switching re-prints the section meshes with that style's strand,
    the extension-cord colour modes, the settings file round trip, and a clean return to the default."""
    per, st1 = {}, {}
    for st in STYLES:
        B.probe("set:style=%s" % st)
        B.ticks(1)
        time.sleep(0.5)
        c = B.probe("census")
        sp = B.probe("styles")
        per[st] = sp
        log.append({"style": st, "styles": sp})
        fb = set(sp.get("fallbacks") or [])
        allowed = set() if st == "StarWarsJawa" else ALLOWED_FALLBACKS
        ok = (sp.get("success") and not sp.get("nulls") and not sp.get("bad") and not sp.get("missing") and fb <= allowed and
              sp.get("builtKey") == sp.get("currentKey") and (sp.get("installed") or {}).get(st) and (c.get("layerVerts") or 0) > 0)
        st1[st] = {"ok": bool(ok), "strandTex": sp.get("strandTex"), "fallbacks": sorted(fb), "nulls": sp.get("nulls"),
                   "bad": sp.get("bad"), "missing": sp.get("missing"), "layerVerts": c.get("layerVerts")}
        if shots_prefix:
            shots_prefix(st)
    # ST1 x4 -> ONE row (consolidation doc section 2 "Core": "ST1 x4 (each look's textures load) -> 1 consolidated
    # row"); the detail names every look and the failing one(s), so no detection is lost.
    row(rows, "ST1_styles_textures_load", "PASS" if all(v["ok"] for v in st1.values()) else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"failing": [k for k, v in st1.items() if not v["ok"]], "perStyle": st1})
    strand_sets = {st: tuple(per[st].get("strandTex") or []) for st in STYLES}
    distinct = len(set(strand_sets.values())) == len(STYLES)
    printed_ok = {st: any(t in (per[st].get("printedTex") or {}) for t in strand_sets[st]) and
                  not any(t in (per[st].get("printedTex") or {}) for o in STYLES if o != st for t in strand_sets[o] if t not in strand_sets[st])
                  for st in STYLES}
    plug_ids = {st: ((per[st].get("slots") or {}).get("Plug") or {}).get("id") for st in STYLES}

    # multi-coloured, so its span cable is the black rubber strand, not its first floor strand
    span_want = {st: ("Strand_BlackRubber" if st == "ExtensionCord" else (strand_sets[st][0] if strand_sets[st] else None)) for st in STYLES}
    span_ok = {st: per[st].get("aerialSpanTex") == span_want[st] for st in STYLES}
    row(rows, "ST2_switch_changes_textures", "PASS" if distinct and all(printed_ok.values()) and len(set(plug_ids.values())) == len(STYLES)
        and all(span_ok.values()) else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"strandTex": strand_sets, "printedOnlyOwnStrand": printed_ok, "plugTexIds": plug_ids, "aerialSpanFollows": span_ok,
         "rebuilds": [per[st].get("rebuilds") for st in STYLES]})
    # extension cords: mixed = 5 colours, one per net (every piece of one net the same colour); single = one colour
    B.probe("set:style=ExtensionCord")
    B.probe("set:extCordColorMode=Mixed")
    B.ticks(1)
    mx = B.probe("styles")
    B.probe("set:extCordColor=2")
    B.probe("set:extCordColorMode=Single")
    B.ticks(1)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    sg = B.probe("styles")
    pt = sg.get("printedTex") or {}
    other = [k for k in pt if k.startswith("Strand_") and k != "Strand_Brown" and "(lod)" not in k]
    nets_ok = sum((mx.get("netsPerVariant") or {}).values()) == mx.get("cordNets")   # each net in exactly one variant
    row(rows, "ST3_extcord_colour_modes", "PASS" if mx.get("variantCount") == 5 and nets_ok and sg.get("variantCount") == 1 and
        sg.get("strandTex") == ["Strand_Brown"] and "Strand_Brown" in pt and not other else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"mixed": {k: mx.get(k) for k in ("variantCount", "piecesPerVariant", "netsPerVariant", "cordNets")},
         "single": {"strandTex": sg.get("strandTex"), "printed": pt}})
    B.probe("set:extCordColorMode=Mixed")
    B.probe("set:extCordColor=0")
    # the settings file round trip (written, reset in memory, read back), then the pre-test values restored
    rt = B.probe("settingsroundtrip")
    row(rows, "ST4_settings_roundtrip", "PASS" if rt.get("readBack") == "Cybertek/Single/3" and rt.get("afterReset") != rt.get("readBack")
        and rt.get("fileHadStyle") and rt.get("fileHadMode") and not rt.get("restoredFileHasCybertek") else "FAIL", "MOD", rt)
    # restore cleanly: the default style is back, same textures as the first read, master switch still works
    B.probe("set:style=StarWarsJawa")
    B.probe("set:enabled=False")
    off = B.probe("census")
    B.probe("set:enabled=True")
    B.ticks(1)
    time.sleep(0.5)
    on = B.probe("census")
    back = B.probe("styles")
    row(rows, "ST5_restore_default_and_master", "PASS" if back.get("strandTex") == list(strand_sets["StarWarsJawa"]) and
        not off.get("layerVisible") and on.get("layerVisible") and (on.get("layerVerts") or 0) > 0 and not back.get("nulls") else "FAIL",
        "MOD", {"strandTex": back.get("strandTex"), "offVisible": off.get("layerVisible"), "onVerts": on.get("layerVerts"),
                "printed": back.get("printedTex")})
    return per

def reveal(B, rect, ticks=30):

    Slack's harness no longer needs FlowWorks' HoseProbe)."""

def frame_fit(B, rect, pad=1):
    """frame_cell_rect, then zoom OUT until the camera's view rect holds the whole rect. 2026-10-10 (550-mod list):
    frame_cell_rect keeps the zoom, and that list's camera sat at root 11 = a 12x6-cell view, so a 46x20 site showed two
    of its four masts (R2 topDraws 2). Returns the camera state read last."""
    x, z, w, h = rect
    B.call("rimworld/frame_cell_rect", x=x, z=z, width=w, height=h, paddingCells=pad)
    cam = B.call("rimworld/get_camera_state")
    rng = cam.get("sizeRange") or {}
    root = int(cam.get("rootSize") or rng.get("min") or 11)
    top = int(rng.get("max") or 60)
    while root < top:
        v = cam.get("viewRect") or {}
        if v and v.get("minX", 1e9) <= x - pad and v.get("minZ", 1e9) <= z - pad and \
                v.get("maxX", -1) >= x + w - 1 + pad and v.get("maxZ", -1) >= z + h - 1 + pad:
            break
        root += 1
        B.call("rimworld/set_camera_zoom", rootSize=root)
        B.call("rimworld/frame_cell_rect", x=x, z=z, width=w, height=h, paddingCells=pad)
        cam = B.call("rimworld/get_camera_state")
    return cam


def _frame_poll_census(B):
    B.call("rimworld/frame_cell_rect", x=SITE[0], z=SITE[1] - 6, width=SITE[2], height=SITE[3] + 6, paddingCells=1)
    B.ticks(2)                       # nets + hookups form on the next tick (LEARNED, seed)
    time.sleep(1.0)
    B.probe("poll")
    return B.probe("census")


def _cord_set(c):
    """The comparable cord set: everything about the laid cords that must survive a save/load."""

            "decals": c.get("decals"), "conduitCells": c.get("conduitCells"), "cordEdges": c.get("cordEdges"),
            "strands": c.get("strands"),
            "ends": sorted((tuple(e["cell"]), e.get("wall"), e.get("netLive"), e.get("registryLive")) for e in c.get("ends") or [])}


def run_save_load(args):
    """On whatever scene the current map holds (run after --live): census, save under a NEW name with the Saves
    folder stat'd before/after (save_game has written the current slot instead of the name), load it."""
    B = Bridge()
    rows = []
    res = {"mod": MOD, "mode": "save-load", "tier": TIER, "started": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "rows": rows}
    name = args.save_load
    ca = _frame_poll_census(B)
    if not ca.get("edgeHashes"):
        row(rows, "SAVE_precondition", "FAIL", "SITE", "no cords on the current map to compare: %s" % str(ca)[:200])
        return res
    before = _saves_stat()
    if name + ".rws" in before:
        row(rows, "SAVE_precondition", "FAIL", "HARNESS", "%s.rws already exists; pick a new name" % name)
        return res
    sv = B.call("rimworld/save_game", saveName=name)
    _wait_saved(name)
    after = _saves_stat()
    new = sorted(set(after) - set(before))
    changed = sorted(n for n in before if n in after and after[n] != before[n])
    gone = sorted(set(before) - set(after))
    ok_save = new == [name + ".rws"] and not changed and not gone
    row(rows, "SAVE_landed_new_file_only", "PASS" if ok_save else "FAIL", "HARNESS",
        {"new": new, "changed": changed, "gone": gone, "size": after.get(name + ".rws"), "tool": sv.get("success")})
    if not ok_save:
        res["aborted"] = "save did not land as a new file only -- not loading"
        return res
    with open(os.path.join(SAVES, name + ".rws"), "rb") as f:
        blob = f.read()
    hits = [blob[max(0, i - 120):i + 80].decode("utf-8", "replace") for i in _find_all(blob, b"GimmeSomeSlack")]
    res["save_mentions"] = hits
    # Run 2026-10-02: the save held <li Class="RimMandrake.GimmeSomeSlack.RM_MapComponent_CordGraph" />, which made a
    # mod-less load log two red errors (M9). Nothing of ours may be in a save; the packageId in the mod list is
    # lowercase and does not match this needle.
    row(rows, "M9a_save_holds_nothing_of_ours", "PASS" if not hits else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"count": len(hits), "first": [h.strip()[-160:] for h in hits[:4]]})
    ld = B.call("rimworld/load_game", saveName=name)
    ok, waited = _wait_playing(B)
    if not ok:
        row(rows, "SAVE_load", "FAIL", "SITE", {"load": ld.get("success"), "state": waited})
        return res
    row(rows, "SAVE_load", "PASS", "HARNESS", {"loadSeconds": waited})
    return res


def run_triplet(args):
    """--triplet (PROOF_HARNESS_BUILD_SAVELOAD_TRIPLET): on whatever scene the current map holds (run after --live), one save and
    three arms -- live, load, reload -- read at the same measured tick (validation_core.saveload_triplet). The reading is
    _cord_set of a framed census; verdict IDENTICAL is PASS, SAVE_DROPS_STATE / LOAD_NONDETERMINISTIC are MOD FAILs that
    say WHICH side lost the state, anything unread is UNMEASURED."""
    B = Bridge()
    rows = []
    res = {"mod": MOD, "mode": "triplet", "tier": TIER, "started": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "rows": rows}
    ca = _frame_poll_census(B)
    if not ca.get("edgeHashes"):
        row(rows, "TRIPLET_precondition", "UNMEASURED", "SITE", "no cords on the current map to compare: %s" % str(ca)[:200])
        return res

    def read(b):
        # _frame_poll_census without its 2 ticks: the triplet reads AT its target tick (a ticking reader hides when it
        # sampled); every arm has run >= 50 ticks since the save/load, so nets and hookups have long formed
        b.call("rimworld/frame_cell_rect", x=SITE[0], z=SITE[1] - 6, width=SITE[2], height=SITE[3] + 6, paddingCells=1)
        time.sleep(1.0)
        b.probe("poll")
        c = b.probe("census")
        return _cord_set(c) if c.get("success") and c.get("edgeHashes") else None

    name = args.triplet_name or "RM_gss_triplet_%s" % time.strftime("%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
    t = VC.saveload_triplet(B, read, ticks=args.triplet_ticks, save_name=name)
    res["triplet"] = {k: t[k] for k in ("verdict", "why", "save", "target", "AB", "BC", "AC")}
    res["triplet"]["ticks"] = {k: (v.get("loadedAt"), v.get("tick")) for k, v in t["arms"].items()}
    status = {VC.TRIPLET_IDENTICAL: "PASS", VC.TRIPLET_SAVE_DROPS: "FAIL", VC.TRIPLET_LOAD_NONDET: "FAIL"}.get(t["verdict"],
                                                                                                               "UNMEASURED")
    row(rows, "TRIPLET_live_load_reload_identical", status, "MOD" if status == "FAIL" else "HARNESS",
        {"verdict": t["verdict"], "why": t["why"], "save": t["save"], "AB": t["AB"], "BC": t["BC"]})
    return res


def _find_all(blob, needle):
    i = blob.find(needle)
    while i >= 0:
        yield i
        i = blob.find(needle, i + 1)


def run_removal_check(args):
    """M9: load a save made WITH the mod on a tier WITHOUT it; no red error may name the mod."""
    B = Bridge()
    rows = []
    res = {"mod": MOD, "mode": "removal-check", "started": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "rows": rows}
    rm = B.call("jawa/running_mods", details=False)
    running = [p.lower() for p in rm.get("packageIds") or []]
    if not running or PKG in running:
        row(rows, "M9_remove_mod_clean", "UNMEASURED", "SITE", "mod list unreadable or %s still running" % PKG)
        return res
    lg0 = B.call("rimbridge/list_logs", limit=500, minimumLevel="warning")
    base = max([x.get("Sequence", 0) for x in lg0.get("logs") or []] or [0])
    log_off = os.path.getsize(PLAYER_LOG)
    ld = B.call("rimworld/load_game", saveName=args.removal_check, ignoreModCompatibility=True)
    ok, waited = _wait_playing(B)
    if not ok:
        row(rows, "M9_remove_mod_clean", "FAIL", "MOD", {"load": ld, "state": waited})
        return res
    B.call("rimworld/jump_camera_to_cell", x=X0 + 14, z=Z0 + 4)
    B.ticks(60)                                   # a second of play: ticks, nets, a section regenerate in view
    time.sleep(1.0)
    lg = B.call("rimbridge/list_logs", limit=500, minimumLevel="warning")
    new = [e for e in lg.get("logs") or [] if (e.get("Sequence") or 0) > base]
    errs = [e for e in new if str(e.get("Level", "")).lower() in ("error", "exception")]
    ours = [e for e in errs if any(m in (str(e.get("Message", "")) + str(e.get("StackTrace", ""))) for m in MOD_MARKERS)]
    with open(PLAYER_LOG, "rb") as f:
        f.seek(log_off)
        tail = f.read().decode("utf-8", "replace").splitlines()
    plog = [ln.strip()[:240] for ln in tail if any(m in ln for m in MOD_MARKERS)]
    lt = B.call("jawa/list_things", defName="PowerConduit", limit=3)
    plog_bad = m9_bad_log_lines(plog)
    row(rows, "M9_remove_mod_clean", "PASS" if not ours and not plog_bad and lt.get("things") else "FAIL", "MOD",
        {"running": len(running), "loadSeconds": waited, "errorsNamingMod": [str(e.get("Message", ""))[:240] for e in ours[:6]],
         "playerLogLinesNamingMod": plog[:8], "playerLogErrorLines": plog_bad[:8], "otherErrors": [str(e.get("Message", ""))[:160] for e in errs if e not in ours][:6],
         "newWarnings": len(new) - len(errs), "conduitStillThere": len(lt.get("things") or [])})
    return res


# ============================================================================ modcheck suite
suite = Suite("GimmeSomeSlack")
suite.toggles = list(SHIPPED)          # every Mod Settings field; floor.uncovered() names the ones no row flips

               "ST2_switch_changes_textures": "style", "ST3_extcord_colour_modes": "extCordColorMode"}
ROW_TOGGLES["ST1_styles_textures_load"] = "style"
NOT_MEASURED = ("UNMEASURED", "UNBUILT", "UNCOVERED")

# North star (DRAFT, agent-seeded 2026-10-05; design/validation_walks/RimMandrake/GimmeSomeSlack.md `## north star`):
# which must-show / cannot-show ids each row is evidence for (`shows=`, north_star_validation_spec.md section 2).
# Every id named here is a row that already exists; no check was added or relaxed to claim a bar. Binds nothing
# in the floor until the owner validates the section (a DRAFT bar is empty by design).
ROW_SHOWS = {
    # offline tier (this suite's offline chain)

    # rows only proof_all.py produces (matrix, aerial, style blocks; the hose rows moved to FlowWorks/validation.py)
    "MX_F00_T0_S0": ["cord_lies_slack_in_loops", "never_taut_straight_cord"],

CORE_SHOW_IDS = ["M1_conduit_transparent", "M7b_on_again_invisible", "B1_rope_settle", "M1c_end_pieces",
                 "M2b_no_vertex_unwalkable", "B6_tangle_lit_strips", "M8_break_two_ends_live_dead",
                 "B6b_strips_dark_when_dead", "B4_downed_wire_bursts", "ST1_styles_textures_load",
                 "ST2_switch_changes_textures"]
OFFLINE_SHOW_IDS = ["O3_core_selftest", "O5_style_art_sane", "O6_review_round1"]
PROOF_ALL_SHOW_IDS = [r for r in ROW_SHOWS if r not in CORE_SHOW_IDS and r not in OFFLINE_SHOW_IDS]
MIRROR_POSIX = "/mnt/d/Luke/dev/RimMandrake"       # read-only origin/main mirror: the offline tier writes exports


def _report_rows(t, rows, declare=()):
    """One component per standalone row, same id. FAIL raises (-> FAIL + finding); UNMEASURED/UNBUILT/UNCOVERED
    record UNMEASURED with the status in the detail. The rows are already-measured, independent results, so a
    FAIL row does not blank the rows after it (it would under the chain's upstream rule, which exists for
    components that still drive the game). Under the declaration probe (no game) `declare` lists the ids to
    declare, so toggle coverage is answerable offline."""
    if not t._guard() and not rows:
        for rid in declare:
            with t.component(rid, toggle=ROW_TOGGLES.get(rid), shows=ROW_SHOWS.get(rid)):
                pass
        return
    for r in rows:
        st = r["status"]
        with t.component(r["id"], toggle=ROW_TOGGLES.get(r["id"]), shows=ROW_SHOWS.get(r["id"])):
            if t._guard() and st == "FAIL":
                raise ExpectationFailed("[%s] %s" % (r.get("class"), str(r.get("detail"))[:600]))
        c = t.components[-1]
        c.evidence.append({"call": "row %s" % r["id"], "result": r})
        if c.verdict == "FAIL":
            t.upstream_failed = False        # this row only; it touched nothing
        elif c.verdict == "PASS":
            if st in NOT_MEASURED or st not in ("PASS", "FAIL"):
                c.verdict, c.detail = "UNMEASURED", "%s: %s" % (st, str(r.get("detail"))[:400])
            else:
                c.detail = str(r.get("detail"))[:400]


def _posix(p):
    import re
    m = re.match(r"^\\\\wsl(?:\.localhost|\$)\\[^\\]+\\(.*)$", p)
    if m:
        return "/" + m.group(1).replace("\\", "/")
    m = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z]):[\\/](.*)$", p)
    if m:
        return "/mnt/%s/%s" % (m.group(1).lower(), m.group(2).replace("\\", "/"))
    return p


def offline_rows():
    """run_offline()'s rows. Under python.exe (the bridge side: no numpy, no WSL selftest toolchain) the same
    function runs in WSL python3 through `--rows-json -`."""
    if os.name != "nt":
        return run_offline()
    me = _posix(os.path.abspath(__file__))
    if me.startswith(MIRROR_POSIX):
        rows = []
        row(rows, "O0_offline_tier_reachable", "UNMEASURED", "HARNESS",
            "validation.py was loaded from the read-only mirror (%s); the offline tier re-exports into its own tree, "
            "so it runs only from a seat clone" % me)
        return rows
    r = subprocess.run(["wsl.exe", "python3", me, "--rows-json", "-"], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=3600)
    for ln in reversed(r.stdout.splitlines()):
        if ln.startswith("ROWS_JSON "):
            return json.loads(ln[len("ROWS_JSON "):])
    raise ExpectationFailed("offline tier in WSL printed no ROWS_JSON (exit %s): %s"
                            % (r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip()[-400:]))


OFFLINE_IDS = ["O1_mod_files", "O2_settings_defaults", "O5_style_art_sane", "O6_review_round1", "O3_core_selftest",
               "O3n_selftest_can_fail", "O4_python_oracle", "O7_gpt_read_fixes", "O8_lamp_mast_vanilla_register"]


@suite.chain("offline_O1_O5")
def offline_O1_O5(t):
    """O1 files/csproj/DLL/textures, O2 shipped defaults, O5 style art sanity (+ planted negatives), O3 the C#
    core SelfTest against the Python oracle (+ --probe must turn red), O4 the oracle's own selftest. 0 ticks."""
    rows = []
    with t.component("offline_tier_ran"):
        if t._guard():
            rows = offline_rows()
    if t.components and t.components[-1].verdict == "PASS":
        _report_rows(t, rows, declare=OFFLINE_IDS)


@suite.chain("live_battery")
def live_battery_chain(t):
    """validation.py --live on the runner's map: scene built around the anchor, M1-M3, M5-M8, D1, phase-1b lane A
    (B1-B9, M10), lane C styles (ST1-ST5), log budget."""
    rows = []
    built = False
    try:
        with t.component("live_battery_ran"):
            if t._guard():
                info = t.session.call("jawa/map_info") or {}
                if isinstance(info, dict) and info.get("content"):
                    info = json.loads(info["content"][0]["text"])
                ox, oz = origin_for_anchor(t.anchor, int(info.get("sizeX", 250)), int(info.get("sizeZ", info.get("sizeX", 250))))
                _set_origin(ox, oz)
                built = True
                res = live_battery(SuiteBridge(t), fresh_map=False, rows=rows)
                if res.get("aborted"):
                    raise ExpectationFailed("live tier aborted: %s" % res["aborted"])
        ran = t.components[-1] if t.components else None
        if ran is not None and ran.verdict in ("PASS", "FAIL") and ran.surprises is None:
            t.upstream_failed = False        # the rows measured before a crash/abort are still real results
            _report_rows(t, rows, declare=sorted(set(ROW_TOGGLES) | set(CORE_SHOW_IDS)))
    finally:
        if built and t.session is not None:
            try:                             # teardown is absolute: the whole scene (SITE holds every build)
                t.session.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,%d,%d" % SITE, categories="All")
            except Exception:                # noqa: BLE001 - the runner's own sweep still follows
                pass
            clear_off_site(t.session.call)
            _set_origin(150, 150)


@suite.chain("proof_all_only_rows")
def proof_all_only_rows(t):
    """North-star coverage for rows that only proof_all.py measures (matrix, aerial, style blocks). This suite's own chains never measure them, so on a live
    `modcheck run` each records UNMEASURED naming where its measurement lives -- never PASS. 0 ticks."""
    rows = []
    if t._guard():
        rows = [{"id": rid, "status": "UNMEASURED", "class": "HARNESS",
                 "detail": "measured only by proof_all.py --live (block row); record that result with `modcheck record`"}
                for rid in PROOF_ALL_SHOW_IDS]
    _report_rows(t, rows, declare=PROOF_ALL_SHOW_IDS)


def main(argv=None):
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--live", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--fresh-map", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--save-load", default=None, metavar="NAME", help="census, save as NAME (new), load, census, compare")
    ap.add_argument("--triplet", action="store_true",
                    help="after --live: save once, read live/load/reload arms at one tick (validation_core.saveload_triplet)")
    ap.add_argument("--triplet-name", default=None, metavar="NAME", help="--triplet save name (default RM_gss_triplet_<stamp>)")
    ap.add_argument("--triplet-ticks", type=int, default=60, help="--triplet: ticks from the save to the read (>= 2)")
    ap.add_argument("--removal-check", default=None, metavar="NAME", help="M9: load NAME on a tier WITHOUT the mod, read the log")
    ap.add_argument("--style-shots", action="store_true",
                    help="lane C: on the current map (after --live and validation_aerial --live) screenshot every style, same rects")
    ap.add_argument("--rows-json", default=None, metavar="-",
                    help="offline tier, then print its rows as one 'ROWS_JSON <json>' line (the suite's WSL hop)")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.rows_json:
        rows = run_offline()
        print("ROWS_JSON " + json.dumps(rows, default=str))
        return 0
    if a.style_shots:
        return run_style_shots()
    if a.save_load or a.removal_check or a.triplet:
        res = run_triplet(a) if a.triplet else run_save_load(a) if a.save_load else run_removal_check(a)
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(HERE, "northstar"), exist_ok=True)
        out = a.out or os.path.join(HERE, "northstar", "validation_%s_%s.json" % (res["mode"], time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")))
        with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(res, f, indent=1, default=str)
        bad = [r for r in res["rows"] if r["status"] not in ("PASS", "INFO")]
        print("%s: %d rows, %d not PASS -> %s" % (res["mode"], len(res["rows"]), len(bad), out))
        return 1 if bad or res.get("aborted") else 0
    if not a.live:
        rows = run_offline()
        bad = [r for r in rows if r["status"] != "PASS"]
        print("offline: %d/%d PASS" % (len(rows) - len(bad), len(rows)))
        return 1 if bad else 0
    res = run_live(a)
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(HERE, "northstar"), exist_ok=True)       # excluded from status.mod_hash
    out = a.out or os.path.join(HERE, "northstar", "validation_result_%s.json" % time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"))
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(res, f, indent=1, default=str)
    t = {}
    for r in res["rows"]:
        t[r["status"]] = t.get(r["status"], 0) + 1
    print("live: %s ticks=%s -> %s" % (t, res.get("ticks"), out))
    return 0 if not res.get("aborted") and t.get("FAIL", 0) == 0 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""STILLSAND_DUNE_GALE_LIVE_1 live proofs A1-A4: run the Stillsand gale chain up to its carry row once, then judge
one clause off modcheck's own results JSON (Transient/modcheck/Stillsand_*.json, runner.write_sheet), never the console.

  A1, A3  gale_phases_and_aftermath    the '[Stillsand] dune gale ended on ... (delta ...); cells moved past ...' line
                                       with a non-zero delta or cell count (A1); exactly one emergence letter and every
                                       thing it placed still on the map (A3)
  A2      gale_dims_sun_exposure       a colonist on the open anchor cell reads ~0.2 (0.15..0.25) of its clear-sky
                                       ShadeGrid.ExposureFor in the gale
  A4      gale_carry_drag_and_return   a dragged colonist leaves RM_Filth_DragMark (or a 'Carried off' letter), one
                                       carried off the edge gets 'Carried off' and comes back

One gale serves every clause: a results JSON from the last REUSE_S seconds that holds all three rows is judged
instead of running the chain again, so the four live-proof lines cost one 6000-tick gale.

Exit: 0 PASS, 1 FAIL / UNMEASURED / row missing / unknown clause, 2 no results JSON written.
"""
import argparse
import glob
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "..", ".."))
CLAUSES = {"A1": "gale_phases_and_aftermath", "A3": "gale_phases_and_aftermath",
           "A2": "gale_dims_sun_exposure", "A4": "gale_carry_drag_and_return"}
ROWS = ["gale_phases_and_aftermath", "gale_dims_sun_exposure", "gale_carry_drag_and_return"]
REUSE_S = 1800


def _components(path):
    try:
        summary = json.load(open(path, encoding="utf-8"))["summary"]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError):
        return {}
    out = {}
    for ch in summary.get("chains") or []:
        for c in ch.get("components") or []:
            out[c.get("name")] = c
    return out


def _results(since):
    paths = [p for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, "Transient", "modcheck", "Stillsand_*.json"))
             if os.path.getmtime(p) >= since]
    return sorted(paths, key=os.path.getmtime, reverse=True)


def _reusable(now):
    for p in _results(now - REUSE_S):
        if all(r in _components(p) for r in ROWS):
            return p
    return None


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    ap.add_argument("--clause", required=True)
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    row = CLAUSES.get(a.clause)
    if row is None:
        print("unknown clause %r (have %s)" % (a.clause, ", ".join(sorted(CLAUSES))))
        return 1
    start = time.time()
    path = _reusable(start)
    if path is None:
        rc = subprocess.call([sys.executable, "-m", "modcheck.cli", "run", "Stillsand", "--rows", ",".join(ROWS),
                              "--item", "STILLSAND_DUNE_GALE_LIVE_1"],
                             cwd=os.path.join(ROOT, "src", "RimMandrake", "Utils"), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        fresh = _results(start)
        if not fresh:
            print("NO RESULTS: modcheck exited %d and wrote no Stillsand results JSON" % rc)
            return 2
        path = fresh[0]
    c = _components(path).get(row)
    if c is None:
        print("%s %s missing from %s" % (a.clause, row, path))
        return 1
    print("%s %s: %s -- %s (%s)" % (a.clause, row, c.get("verdict"), str(c.get("detail"))[:600], path))
    return 0 if c.get("verdict") == "PASS" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Read a northstar_driver --out results file and exit 0 when every named row (`chain.component`) is PASS, 1 when any
is FAIL, 2 when any is missing or UNMEASURED. Used by BLUEDESERT_GPT_ENRICHMENT_1's live proofs A2 and A5, whose
driver run selects one chain with --chains (the other chains read 'chain not run', so the run's own exit is not
the clause's verdict).
    python3 src/RimMandrake/BlueDesert/prove_rows.py <results.json> cold_rack.rack_cools_loaded_room_only ...
"""
import json
import sys


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) < 3:
        print(__doc__)
        return 2
    try:
        with open(argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            doc = json.load(fh)

scripts.src/RimMandrake/TheSump/prove_glasswalk_:
"""SUMP_GLASSWALK_SPEED_RATIO_1 live clause A1: glasswalk's real speed against TileGranite, timed exactly.

Run under python.exe from the repo root (bridge held by the caller):
    python.exe "$(wslpath -w src/RimMandrake/TheSump/prove_glasswalk_speed.py)" < /dev/null
Exit 0 = A1 holds, 1 = it does not (or could not be measured).

Builds a one-cell lane in a roofed room on a throwaway map, then walks one colonist (ordered Goto = Jog urgency, glasswalk
slip OFF) over 12 cells of each floor, twice. The 2026-10-10 scene timed with scenelib.run(10), which plays at least
200 ms at speed 4 (~80 ticks a sample) against 120-200 tick walks; this one advances rimworld/step_game_ticks STEP ticks at
a time, so a crossing is placed within STEP ticks (per-cell error <= STEP/12).

A1 holds when, for the pawn's own T = 60 / MoveSpeed (roofed, so no weather factor):
  granite ticks/cell within TOL of T                       (the instrument sees the pawn's base cost)
  glass - granite ticks/cell within TOL of RM_Glasswalk pathCost 3   (the engine ADDS pathCost: test_glasswalk_speed_model.py)
  so a standard colonist (T = 13.04) gets 13.04 / 16.04 = 0.81, the spec's "~80%". The ratio at this pawn's T is printed.
"""
import os
import statistics as st
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "Utils"))
from scenes import scenelib as S  # noqa: E402

TILE = 114502
ST = "RimMandrake.EnvironmentalHazards.RM_EnvironmentalHazardsSettings"
PATH_COST = 3
STEP = 2            # ticks per exact step
TOL = 0.75          # ticks/cell
X0, X1 = 4, 16      # timed span: 12 cells, start/stop effects excluded
STANDARD_T = 60.0 / 4.6


def px(pid):
    return ((S.call("jawa/pawn_get", pawn=pid).get("pawns") or [{}])[0].get("position") or {}).get("x")


def move_speed(pid):
    r = S.call("jawa/pawn_stats", pawn=pid, stats="MoveSpeed")
    for row in (r.get("stats") or []) if isinstance(r, dict) else []:
        if row.get("defName") == "MoveSpeed":
            v = row.get("value")
            try:
                return float(v)
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                return None
    return None


def step(n):
    return S.need(S.call("rimworld/step_game_ticks", ticks=n, timeoutMs=60000), "step_game_ticks")


def walk_exact(sc, pid):
    """Walk from the lane's west end to its east end; return ticks spent between x>=X0 and x>=X1 (exact steps)."""
    S.call("jawa/ordered_job", pawnId=pid, jobDef="Goto", targetAX=sc.x + 1, targetAZ=sc.z + 1, waitTicks=1)
    for _ in range(80):
        step(20)
        x = px(pid)
        if x is not None and x <= sc.x + 1:
            break
    step(20)
    S.call("jawa/kill_hostiles")
    S.call("jawa/ordered_job", pawnId=pid, jobDef="Goto", targetAX=sc.x + 18, targetAZ=sc.z + 1, waitTicks=1)
    t, ta = 0, None
    while t < 1200:
        step(STEP)
        t += STEP
        x = px(pid)
        if x is None:
            continue
        if ta is None and x >= sc.x + X0:
            ta = t
        if ta is not None and x >= sc.x + X1:
            return t - ta
    return None


def main():
    S.call("jawa/set_game_speed", speed=0)
    mid = S.biome_map(TILE, "RM_GreySea", surface_biome="RM_GreySea")
    sc = None
    verdict = 1
    try:
        sc = S.Scene("glass", 40, 60, 20, 4)
        sc.__enter__()
        sc.room(roof=True)
        S.call("jawa/spawn_batch", ops=";".join("Wall:%d,%d" % (sc.x + dx, sc.z + 2) for dx in range(0, 20)),
               stuff="BlocksGranite")
        pid = sc.colonist(1, 1)
        S.call("jawa/pawn_need", pawn=pid, action="need", need="Mood", level=1.0)
        res = {"TileGranite": [], "RM_Glasswalk": []}
        speeds = []
        with S.setting(ST, glasswalkSlipEnabled="False"):
            for rep in range(2):
                for terr in ("TileGranite", "RM_Glasswalk"):
                    sc.floor(terr, (1, 1, 18, 1))
                    S.call("jawa/map_commit", full=True)
                    ms = move_speed(pid)
                    speeds.append(ms)
                    w = walk_exact(sc, pid)
                    res[terr].append(w)
                    print(rep, terr, "ticks/12 cells =", w, "MoveSpeed =", ms, flush=True)
        g = [w / float(X1 - X0) for w in res["TileGranite"] if w]
        s = [w / float(X1 - X0) for w in res["RM_Glasswalk"] if w]
        ms = [v for v in speeds if v]
        if len(g) < 2 or len(s) < 2 or not ms:
            print("RESULT SUMP_GLASSWALK_SPEED_RATIO_1/A1 UNMEASURED granite=%s glass=%s MoveSpeed=%s" % (g, s, speeds))
            return 1
        T = 60.0 / st.mean(ms)
        gm, sm = st.mean(g), st.mean(s)
        delta = sm - gm
        ok_base = abs(gm - T) <= TOL
        ok_add = abs(delta - PATH_COST) <= TOL
        verdict = 0 if (ok_base and ok_add) else 1
        print("RESULT SUMP_GLASSWALK_SPEED_RATIO_1/A1 %s T=%.2f granite=%.2f (|g-T|<=%.2f: %s) glass=%.2f delta=%.2f "
              "(|delta-%d|<=%.2f: %s) ratio_this_pawn=%.3f law_this_pawn=%.3f standard_pawn_ratio=%.3f"
              % ("PASS" if verdict == 0 else "FAIL", T, gm, TOL, ok_base, sm, delta, PATH_COST, TOL, ok_add,
                 gm / sm, T / (T + PATH_COST), STANDARD_T / (STANDARD_T + delta)), flush=True)
    finally:
        try:
            S.call("jawa/set_game_speed", speed=0)
            if sc is not None:
                sc.teardown()
        except Exception as e:
            print("teardown", e)
        S.drop_map(mid, TILE, back=0)
    return verdict


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""modcheck -- the scripted mod-functionality validator (pre-playtest).

    python.exe src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py run <mod> [<mod>...] [--debug]
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py status
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py declare <mod> minor --why "..."
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py rename-key <old> <new> --why "..."
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py forget-key <key> --why "..."
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py validate <mod> [--owner-said "..."]
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py review <mod> --owner-said "..."
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py record <mod> --result <json> [--tier T]

`record` (2026-10-02) records a functional script's LIVE result (e.g.
FlowWorks/northstar/validation_v2.py) through status.record_run WITHOUT
touching ModsConfig.xml -- it refuses a stale result (mod hash moved), a run
whose live mod set is not the declared tier, and an aborted run (record.py).

`run` drives a live bridge session and needs `python.exe` (Windows) for the
same WSL-loopback reason every other bridge driver does
(rimbridge_client.py). `status` and `declare` touch only
`infrastructure/state/modcheck_status.json` and run fine under plain
`python3`.

`rename-key` and `forget-key` are the two verbs `modcheck_status.json` owed
the naming migration (MEASURED 2026-09-17: `FluidCanals` sat GREEN under its
dead pre-rename name while the mod ships as `FlowWorks`) -- the only
sanctioned way to move or drop a key, since hand-editing that file is
forbidden.

`validate` and `review` are the two OWNER-AUTHORISED verbs added 2026-09-15
(design/RimMandrake/north_star_validation_spec.md): `validate` turns a mod's
agent-drafted `## north star` checklist into a binding bar, `review` records
that he has read a run's sheet with his own eyes -- required once, before a
mod's first GREEN. Both take his verbatim `--owner-said` and neither re-derives
his judgement; `validate` with no `--owner-said` prints the bar and writes
nothing, so the lines can be read to him first.
"""
import argparse
import os
import sys

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if _HERE not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _HERE)
_UTILS = os.path.dirname(_HERE)
if _UTILS not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _UTILS)


def main(argv=None):
    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else list(argv)
    if argv[:1] == ["metrics"]:     # its own argparse (metrics.py --help); listed below for discoverability
        import metrics
        return metrics.main(argv[1:])
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
                                 formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_run = sub.add_parser("run")
    p_run.add_argument("mods", nargs="+",
                       help="mod folder name(s), e.g. Pits")
    p_run.add_argument("--item", action="append", default=[],
                       help="ITEM_ID: TARGETED run of the chains that item maps to (its rows cite it, or its "
                            "ledger text names a chain/row), recorded against it; refused if nothing maps. "
                            "MOD=ITEM_ID: only the ledger item a run is recorded against (default "
                            "MODCHECK_<MOD>_RUN_1)")
    p_run.add_argument("--chains", default="",
                       help="TARGETED: comma-separated chain names to run (one mod)")
    p_run.add_argument("--rows", default="",
                       help="TARGETED: comma-separated row ids; each row's chain runs as a PREFIX and stops after its "
                            "last requested row, the tail recorded NOT_RUN (one mod)")
    p_run.add_argument("--preview", action="store_true",
                       help="TARGETED: print the per-chain plan (requested -> prerequisites -> executed -> skipped) "
                            "and stop: no mod-list swap, no game")
    p_run.add_argument("--full", action="store_true",
                       help="the whole suite: a scheduled sweep, at most daily (owner 2026-10-25). A run with no "
                            "--chains/--rows/--item ITEM_ID is refused without it")
    # focused_testing_plan option B (all opt-in; without them a run behaves exactly as before)
    p_run.add_argument("--reuse", choices=("off", "report", "on"), default=None,
                       help="external-driver rows with no result at the current mod hash: 'report' (the default when "
                            "unset) tags a result whose runtime+test manifest and DLL still match as reusable@<file> "
                            "and leaves the row UNMEASURED; 'on' takes its status as reused@<file> (never fresh_green); "
                            "'off' does not look (sets MODCHECK_REUSE, modcheck/reuse.py)")
    p_run.add_argument("--drivers", choices=("on", "off"), default=None,
                       help="'on': before the chains, run the suite's external live drivers (suite.live_drivers, e.g. "
                            "FlowWorks northstar/thirst_live.py) whose chains are selected, so their rows are measured at "
                            "this mod hash; the SteveDesktop worker passes it (sets MODCHECK_RUN_DRIVERS, modcheck/drivers.py)")
    p_run.add_argument("--purpose", choices=("fix", "guard", "sweep", "sensitivity", "flake", "commission"),

                            "and only report would_skip. Default: sweep with --full, guard otherwise "

                       help="run the vanilla canary (Steel spawn/read-back/destroy, a live colonist, Playing) before "

    p_run.add_argument("--validity", action="store_true",

                            "explain becomes UNMEASURED/invalid with the FAIL kept as a lead, no finding")
    p_run.add_argument("--changed", default=None, metavar="RANGE|WORKTREE",

                            "only) SUGGESTS, and stop: nothing runs from a suggestion (one mod)")
    p_run.add_argument("--seat", default=None,
                       help="ledger seat for the run's verify/findings when RIMFLOW_SEAT/AGENT_SEAT do not reach "
                            "this process (Windows python.exe); with none the run is still recorded, ledger skipped")
    p_run.add_argument("--debug", action="store_true")
    p_run.add_argument("--situational", action="store_true",
                       help="wrap every chain in the situational envelope: bland map, python-enforced "
                            "tick budget, detector sweeps, evidence+screenshot on any surprise")
    p_run.add_argument("--policy", choices=["abort", "record"], default="abort",
                       help="what a surprise does: abort the component (UNMEASURED) or just record it")
    p_run.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true",
                       help="exercise the orchestration with no game, no "
                            "subprocess side effects (selftest-shaped)")

    p_status = sub.add_parser("status")
    p_status.add_argument("mod", nargs="?")

    p_decl = sub.add_parser("declare")
    p_decl.add_argument("mod")
    p_decl.add_argument("severity", choices=["minor"])
    p_decl.add_argument("--why", required=True)

    p_ren = sub.add_parser("rename-key", help="move a registry entry from an old "
                                              "mod key to its new name")
    p_ren.add_argument("old")
    p_ren.add_argument("new")
    p_ren.add_argument("--why", required=True)

    p_forget = sub.add_parser("forget-key", help="delete a registry entry outright "
                                                 "-- for an orphaned key with no "
                                                 "successor worth preserving")
    p_forget.add_argument("key")
    p_forget.add_argument("--why", required=True)

    p_val = sub.add_parser("validate", help="record the owner's validation of a "
                                            "mod's `## north star` checklist")
    p_val.add_argument("mod")
    p_val.add_argument("--owner-said",
                       help="his verbatim words. Required to WRITE; omit to "
                            "print the lines that would bind and change nothing")
    p_val.add_argument("--by-card", help="a decision he took by question card: "
                       "'<question -> option>'. Stands in for --owner-said")
    p_val.add_argument("--per-ruling", help="with --why: a Conductor instruction "
                       "(conductor_authority.RULING). Stands in for --owner-said")
    p_val.add_argument("--why", help="the Conductor's text; alone it grants nothing")

    p_rev = sub.add_parser("review", help="record that the owner reviewed a "
                                          "mod's sheet -- once, before its first GREEN")
    p_rev.add_argument("mod")
    p_rev.add_argument("--owner-said")
    p_rev.add_argument("--per-ruling", help="with --why: a Conductor instruction "
                       "(conductor_authority.RULING). Stands in for --owner-said")
    p_rev.add_argument("--why", help="the Conductor's text; alone it grants nothing")
    p_rev.add_argument("--run-id", help="defaults to the mod's last recorded run")

    p_rec = sub.add_parser("record", help="record a functional script's live result "
                                          "(no ModsConfig swap) -- refuses stale/off-tier runs")
    p_rec.add_argument("mod")
    p_rec.add_argument("--result", required=True, help="the script's result JSON")
    p_rec.add_argument("--tier", default=None,
                       help="modset_builder tier the run must have been on "
                            "(default: the mod name lowercased)")
    p_rec.add_argument("--extensions", default=None,
                       help="step 4's result JSON (northstar/extension_proof.py --live), for a mod that "
                            "ships one; omitted, step 4 records UNMEASURED and the checkout cannot be green")

    p_lint = sub.add_parser("lint", help="every identifier a validation walk "
                                         "names must exist (walklint)")
    p_lint.add_argument("--warn", action="store_true",
                        help="also print WARN findings (UNKNOWN_ID, BAD_FILE), "
                             "which never affect the exit code")

    p_floor = sub.add_parser("floor", help="the visual/settings floor triage "
                                           "-- read-only, no bridge, no "
                                           "ModsConfig.xml write")
    p_floor.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", required=True,
                         help="every mod with a validation walk, one row "
                              "each (the only mode today)")

    sub.add_parser("doctor", help="the five registries keyed on a mod's folder "
                                  "name must agree with disk. Reports and "
                                  "stops -- never repairs; the ownership calls "
                                  "it surfaces are the owner's")

    sub.add_parser("metrics", add_help=False,
                   help="the daily test-orchestration metrics file (WASTE, unclassified share, lanes, gate misses, "
                        "alarms) at <testq>/metrics/<day>.json; `metrics --help` for its flags (modcheck/metrics.py)")

    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    if args.cmd == "record":
        import record
        code, msg, _ = record.record(args.mod, args.result, args.tier or args.mod.lower(),
                                    ext_path=args.extensions)
        print(msg)
        return code

    if args.cmd == "doctor":
        import doctor
        return doctor.main([])

    if args.cmd == "lint":
        import runner
        import walklint
        findings, counts = walklint.lint(runner.ROOT)
        print("walklint: %d walks, %d packageIds, %d symbols indexed"
              % (counts["walks"], counts["packageids"], counts["symbols"]))
        if not counts["walks"] or not counts["packageids"]:
            print("UNMEASURED: an index came back empty -- this is a query bug, "
                  "not a clean repo. Refusing to report zero findings.")
            return 2
        shown = [f for f in findings
                 if f[0] == walklint.FAIL or args.warn]
        for f in shown:
            print(walklint.format_finding(f))
        n_fail = sum(1 for f in findings if f[0] == walklint.FAIL)
        n_warn = sum(1 for f in findings if f[0] == walklint.WARN)
        print("%d FAIL, %d WARN%s"
              % (n_fail, n_warn, "" if args.warn else "  (--warn to see WARNs)"))

        import readline_registry
        try:
            rl_findings, rl_counts = readline_registry.lint(runner.ROOT)
        except FileNotFoundError as exc:
            print("UNMEASURED: %s" % exc)
            return 2
        print("readline_registry: %d walks, %d registry ids, %d `shared` "
              "citations checked" % (rl_counts["walks"], rl_counts["registry_ids"],
                                     rl_counts["citations"]))
        for f in rl_findings:
            print(readline_registry.format_finding(f))
        print("%d FAIL" % len(rl_findings))

        return 1 if (n_fail or rl_findings) else 0

    if args.cmd == "floor":
        import floor
        import runner
        rows, footer = floor.triage(runner.ROOT)
        if not rows:
            print("UNMEASURED: no validation walks found -- this is a query "
                  "bug, not a clean repo. Refusing to report zero rows.")
            return 2
        print(floor.format_triage(rows, footer))
        return 0

    if args.cmd == "status":
        import status
        data = status.load()
        if args.mod:
            print(status.check(args.mod, _mod_dir_or_die(args.mod)))
            return 0
        if not data:
            print("no mods recorded")
            return 0
        import northstar
        import runner
        # Re-derive per row rather than printing entry["status"]. The stored
        # field is what made this summary disagree with `status <mod>`: it
        # printed `Pits GREEN` while the per-mod view printed STALE, and
        # `FluidCanals GREEN` for a mod renamed away weeks earlier.
        for mod, entry in sorted(data.items()):
            walk = northstar.find_walk(runner.ROOT, mod)
            ns = northstar.parse(walk) if walk else None
            bar = ("checklist %s (%d lines)" % (ns["state"], len(ns["must_show"]))
                   if ns and ns["present"] else "no checklist")
            live = status.check_or_orphaned(mod)
            stored = entry.get("status")
            drift = "" if live.split(" (")[0] == stored else "   [stored: %s]" % stored
            run = ""
            if entry.get("source"):     # a `modcheck record` entry: say what it was run at
                try:
                    cur = status.mod_hash(runner.find_mod_dir(mod))
                    at = "current hash" if cur == entry.get("hash") else "STALE hash"
                except RuntimeError:
                    at = "no mod folder"
                cnt = (entry.get("components") or {}).get("counts") or {}
                try:
                    s4 = status.step4_live(entry, runner.find_mod_dir(mod))
                except RuntimeError:
                    s4 = None
                run = "   [run %s at %s %s; %s%s]" % (
                    entry["source"].get("result", "?").rsplit("/", 1)[-1], at,
                    (entry.get("hash") or "")[:12],
                    " ".join("%s %d" % kv for kv in sorted(cnt.items())),
                    "" if s4 is None else "; step 4 %s" % s4)
            if len(live) > 60:
                live = live[:57] + "..."
            print("%-30s %-22s %s%s%s" % (mod, live, bar, drift, run))
        return 0

    if args.cmd == "declare":
        import status
        entry = status.declare_minor(args.mod, _mod_dir_or_die(args.mod), args.why)
        print("declared minor: %s at %s" % (args.mod, entry["hash"][:12]))
        return 0

    if args.cmd == "rename-key":
        import status
        status.rename_key(args.old, args.new, args.why)
        print("renamed: %s -> %s" % (args.old, args.new))
        return 0

    if args.cmd == "forget-key":
        import status
        status.forget_key(args.key, args.why)
        print("forgotten: %s" % args.key)
        return 0

    if args.cmd == "validate":
        import conductor_authority as CA
        return _validate(args.mod, ("BY CARD: " + args.by_card if args.by_card and not args.owner_said else None)
                         or CA.words(args.owner_said, args.per_ruling, args.why))

    if args.cmd == "review":
        import conductor_authority as CA
        import status
        said = CA.words(args.owner_said, args.per_ruling, args.why)
        if not said:
            print("refused: review needs --owner-said with his words or a Conductor instruction (%s)" % CA.ROUTE,
                  file=sys.stderr)
            return 2
        entry = status.record_owner_review(args.mod, said,
                                          run_id=args.run_id)
        print("%s: owner review recorded against run %s -> %s"
              % (args.mod, entry["owner_review"]["run_id"], entry["status"]))
        return 0

    if args.cmd == "run":
        import runner
        if args.policy != "abort" and not args.situational:
            # MODCHECK_POLICY_FIX_RECORD_NEEDS_SITUATIONAL: only the situational Watch reads --policy; run4 was
            # launched `--policy record` without it and the policy was silently never read.
            print("REFUSED: --policy %s is read only by the situational envelope; add --situational or drop "
                  "--policy" % args.policy)
            return 2
        if args.changed is not None:
            import targeting
            if len(args.mods) != 1:
                print("REFUSED: --changed suggests chains for one mod")
                return 2
            try:
                mod_dir = runner.find_mod_dir(args.mods[0])
                suite = runner.load_validation(mod_dir)
                res = targeting.changed(suite, targeting.changed_files(mod_dir, args.changed), mod_dir)
            except (targeting.TargetError, RuntimeError) as ex:
                print("REFUSED: %s" % ex)
                return 2
            for line in targeting.changed_report(res):
                print(line)
            return 0
        if args.drivers is not None:
            import drivers  # noqa: E402
            os.environ[drivers.ENV] = "1" if args.drivers == "on" else "0"
        if args.reuse is not None:
            os.environ["MODCHECK_REUSE"] = {"off": "0", "report": "report", "on": "1"}[args.reuse]
        if args.gate is not None:
            os.environ["MODCHECK_GATE"] = args.gate
        if args.purpose is not None:
            os.environ["MODCHECK_PURPOSE"] = args.purpose
        elif args.full and not os.environ.get("MODCHECK_PURPOSE"):
            os.environ["MODCHECK_PURPOSE"] = "sweep"   # a sweep bypasses the gate (plan section 3)
        overrides = dict(kv.split("=", 1) for kv in args.item if "=" in kv)
        target_items = [kv for kv in args.item if "=" not in kv]
        chains = [c.strip() for c in args.chains.split(",") if c.strip()]
        rows = [r.strip() for r in args.rows.split(",") if r.strip()]
        targeted = bool(chains or rows or target_items)
        if targeted and args.full:
            print("REFUSED: --full and a target (--chains/--rows/--item ITEM_ID) contradict each other")
            return 2
        if args.preview and args.full and len(args.mods) == 1:
            # a sweep's driver plan only: testq submit sizes the job's timeout from it (TESTQ_SIZING_FIX_...)
            import drivers  # noqa: E402
            import json as _json
            try:
                suite = runner.load_validation(runner.find_mod_dir(args.mods[0]))
            except RuntimeError as ex:
                print("REFUSED: %s" % ex)
                return 2
            print("EXPECTED_DRIVERS " + _json.dumps(drivers.need_s(suite, [n for n, _ in suite.chains])[1]))
            # TESTQ_SWEEP_FIX_DRIVERS_OVER_CAP: which chains each driver serves, so testq sweep can split the sweep
            print("EXPECTED_CHAINS " + _json.dumps([n for n, _ in suite.chains]))
            print("EXPECTED_DRIVER_CHAINS " + _json.dumps(
                {d["name"]: list(d.get("chains") or ()) for d in drivers.plan(suite, [n for n, _ in suite.chains])}))
            return 0
        if args.preview and not targeted:
            print("REFUSED: --preview previews a TARGETED run; name --chains, --rows or --item ITEM_ID")
            return 2
        if not targeted and not args.full:
            print("REFUSED: a live run is TARGETED (owner 2026-10-25, standing_rulings.md \"Live runs are "
                  "TARGETED\"): name what the change touches with --item ITEM_ID, --chains a,b or --rows r1,r2. "
                  "The whole suite is a scheduled sweep (at most daily): add --full for that.")
            return 2
        targets = {}
        if targeted:
            if len(args.mods) != 1 or len(target_items) > 1:
                print("REFUSED: a targeted run names one mod and at most one --item ITEM_ID")
                return 2
            import targeting
            mod = args.mods[0]
            try:
                suite = runner.load_validation(runner.find_mod_dir(mod))
                text = targeting.item_text(target_items[0]) if target_items else None
                sel = targeting.resolve(suite, chains, rows, target_items[0] if target_items else None, text)
            except (targeting.TargetError, RuntimeError) as ex:
                print("REFUSED: %s" % ex)
                return 2
            for line in targeting.preview(sel):     # the exact plan, per chain, before anything launches
                print(line)
            import json as _json                    # machine line: the worker marks planned rows that never ran NOT_RUN
            print("EXPECTED_ROWS " + _json.dumps(list(sel.get("rows_run", []))))
            import drivers  # noqa: E402            # the "pre" drivers --drivers on would start, with their timeouts
            print("EXPECTED_DRIVERS " + _json.dumps(drivers.need_s(suite, sel["chains"])[1]))
            if args.preview:
                return 0
            targets[mod] = sel
            if target_items and mod not in overrides:
                overrides[mod] = target_items[0]
        mods = [(m, overrides.get(m, "MODCHECK_%s_RUN_1" % m.upper()))
               for m in args.mods]
        results = runner.run(mods, debug=args.debug, dry_run=args.dry_run,
                             situational=args.situational, policy=args.policy,
                             targets=targets, seat=args.seat, canary=args.canary, validity=args.validity)
        bad = [m for m, r in results.items() if not r["all_green"]]
        for m, r in results.items():
            print("%-20s %s" % (m, _verdict_line(r)))
        return 1 if bad else 0

    return 2


def _verdict_line(result):
    """One line per mod. Names WHICH half failed, because "RED" alone sent the
    pit's real defect -- right state, absent appearance -- unnamed for a month."""
    if result.get("refused"):
        return "REFUSED  %s" % result["refused"]
    tg = result.get("targeted")
    if tg:      # never a bare GREEN/RED for a subset: it would read as the full-suite verdict
        scope = "TARGETED %d/%d chains (%s)" % (len(tg["chains"]), tg.get("of_chains", 0), ",".join(tg["chains"]))
        return scope + " " + _verdict_line(dict(result, targeted=None))
    if result["all_green"]:
        return "GREEN"
    failed = []
    if not result.get("state_all_green", result["all_green"]):
        failed.append("state")
    if result.get("visual") and not result.get("visual_all_green"):
        failed.append("judge: %s" % ", ".join(
            "%s=%s" % (v["id"], v["verdict"])
            for v in result["visual"] if not v["pass"]))
    return "RED" + ("  (%s)" % "; ".join(failed) if failed else "")


def _validate(mod, owner_said):
    """Print the must-show lines about to BIND, then record his validation.

    Refuses to bless silently, exactly as `code_review_status.py mark-clean`
    does: with no `--owner-said` this prints the bar and writes nothing, so the
    lines can be read to him first. That is the whole point of the verb -- an
    agent-drafted checklist becomes a bar only on his word (owner, 2026-09-15:
    'I write vision, agent writes checklist, I validate checklist').
    """
    import northstar
    import runner
    walk = northstar.find_walk(runner.ROOT, mod)
    if not walk:
        print("REFUSED: %s has no validation walk under design/validation_walks/"
              % mod)
        return 2
    ns = northstar.parse(walk)
    if not ns["present"]:
        print("REFUSED: %s has no `## north star` section -- there is nothing "
              "to validate.\n  %s" % (mod, walk))
        return 2

    print("%s — %s" % (mod, walk))
    print("state on disk: %s%s" % (ns["state"],
                                   "" if not ns["reason"] else "  (%s)" % ns["reason"]))

    # A present-but-misformatted section parses to zero bars, and validating
    # that writes VALIDATED against an empty checklist: `bar_for()` then returns
    # nothing, the visual floor finds nothing uncovered, and the mod silently
    # STOPS being refused. Refusing here is the only thing standing between a
    # formatting slip and a validation that means nothing. Both lists empty is
    # the refusal; must-show empty with cannot-show present is a legitimate
    # walk that only forbids things.
    if not ns["must_show"] and not ns["cannot_show"]:
        print("\nREFUSED: the `## north star` section parses to ZERO bars, so "
              "validating it would\nrecord an approval that binds nothing and "
              "silently stops %s being refused." % mod)
        print("  Expected line format:  - [ ] `some_bar_id` — what must be "
              "visible")
        print("  under a `### must show` or `### cannot show` subheading.")
        print("  Copy the shape from a walk that parses: "
              "design/validation_walks/RimMandrake/FlowWorks.md")
        print("  %s" % walk)
        return 2

    print("\nThese lines BIND once validated. Every one of them refuses the mod "
          "until some\ncomponent claims it with `shows=`, and is then judged "
          "against a screenshot:\n")
    for req_id in ns["must_show"]:
        print("  must    %-32s %s" % (req_id, ns["must_show_text"][req_id]))
    for req_id in ns["cannot_show"]:
        print("  cannot  %-32s %s" % (req_id, ns["cannot_show_text"][req_id]))

    if not owner_said:
        print("\n%d must-show + %d cannot-show lines would bind %s."
              % (len(ns["must_show"]), len(ns["cannot_show"]), mod))
        print("Nothing written. Read these to him; then re-run with "
              "--owner-said \"<his verbatim words>\", or the Conductor's "
              "instruction with --per-ruling.")
        return 1

    written = northstar.record_validation(walk, owner_said)
    print("\nVALIDATED at %s\n  owner said: %s" % (written[:12], owner_said))
    print("  %d must-show + %d cannot-show lines now bind %s."
          % (len(ns["must_show"]), len(ns["cannot_show"]), mod))
    print("  Any later edit to the section reverts it to DRAFT by hash "
          "mismatch.")
    return 0


def _mod_dir_or_die(mod):
    import runner
    return runner.find_mod_dir(mod)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Live proofs of WARSCAR_HOSPICE_DESERTERS_1, one clause per call: exit 0 when it holds, 1 when it does not, 2 when
the instrument cannot see (no bridge, no map, the hook type absent: never a verdict).

    python3 src/RimMandrake/Scarlands/hospice_live_proof.py A1|A2|A3|A4

Each clause is one jawa/static_call into RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_HospiceProof (Source/RM_HospiceProof.cs) on the
CURRENT map of a quicktest colony with Warscar loaded (standalone or inside the Baroque Biomes composite):
  A1 Rings      RM_Warscar runs RM_KneelingRings live; the genstep lays rings facing their centre with 0..cap intact
                chassis, each holding a history that is in its save XML.
  A2 Revival    an intact chassis the haul workgiver offers is fed to a cradle with each stage's input and passes the
                five stages (stage time skipped by DebugCompleteStage); it wakes a colony mech with no mechanitor,
                its history's modification hediffs present, the cradle lights dark at diagnosis and lit after lights.
  A3 Failure    a forced failure at the lights stage leaves RM_FailedChassis labelled with the machine's name.
  A4 WalkIn     the walk-in incident fired with forced parms (pursuer held off), then real ticks through
                jawa/safe_advance until the servitor knelt within 6 cells of the cradle as an intact chassis.
It writes to the quicktest map only (every save but the canonical world saves is disposable) and never the world.
"""
import os
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(HERE, "..", "Utils"))
import rimbridge_client as rb  # noqa: E402

TYPE = "RimMandrake.Scarlands.RM_HospiceProof"
METHOD = {"A1": "Rings", "A2": "Revival", "A3": "Failure"}
ADVANCE_STEP, ADVANCE_MAX = 2500, 12


def hook(c, method, args="current"):
    r = c.call("jawa/static_call", {"type": TYPE, "method": method, "args": args})
    if not isinstance(r, dict) or r.get("success") is False:
        raise RuntimeError("static_call %s refused: %r" % (method, r))
    return str(r.get("result", ""))


def main(argv):
    if len(argv) != 2 or argv[1] not in ("A1", "A2", "A3", "A4"):
        print(__doc__)
        return 2
    clause = argv[1]
    try:
        h, p, tok = rb.resolve_endpoint()
        c = rb.RimBridge(host=h, port=p, token=tok, timeout=120.0)
        c.connect()
        if clause in METHOD:
            line = hook(c, METHOD[clause])
        else:
            fired = hook(c, "WalkInFire")
            if not fired.startswith("PASS fired: "):
                print("A4 " + fired)
                return 1
            unit = fired[len("PASS fired: "):].strip()
            line = "FAIL never read"
            for i in range(ADVANCE_MAX):
                adv = c.call("jawa/safe_advance", {"ticks": ADVANCE_STEP, "stopOn": "default"})
                line = hook(c, "WalkInRead", "current|" + unit)
                print("  +%d ticks: %s (advance: %s)" % ((i + 1) * ADVANCE_STEP, line,
                                                         (adv or {}).get("state") if isinstance(adv, dict) else adv), flush=True)
                if line.startswith("PASS") or "is gone" in line:
                    break
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 -- any bridge failure is an instrument error, never a verdict
        print("%s UNMEASURED: %s: %s" % (clause, type(e).__name__, e))
        return 2
    print("%s %s" % (clause, line))
    return 0 if line.startswith("PASS") else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
