# Ancient-danger containers and map-gen threats (r8 spawner probe, 4 maps: every released group sat in a shrine with
# AncientCryptosleepCasket + AncientHermeticCrate + Sarcophagus within 3 cells; hives/egg sacs/glow pods on r5-r8 maps).
DANGER_RE = re.compile(r"(Cryptosleep|Casket|HermeticCrate|Sarcophag|^Hive$|^BI_Hive|EggSac|GlowPod|"
                       r"Turret|MechDrop|MechCluster|Spawner|Warhead|Mortar|Shell_|Pulser|Monolith$)", re.I)
# Explosive and pulser ITEMS that a fire or a curious colonist sets off (r8: Shell_AntigrainWarhead in two shrines).
DANGER_ITEM_DEFS = ("Shell_AntigrainWarhead", "Shell_HighExplosive", "Shell_Incendiary", "Shell_EMP", "Shell_Firefoam",
                    "Shell_Smoke", "Shell_ChemFuel", "Shell_Toxic", "PsychicAnimalPulser", "ShardAnimalPulser",
                    "PsychicSoothePulser", "PsychicInsanityLance", "PsychicShockLance")
# Kept on purpose (L1 2026-10-15, 3 of 6 quicktest rolls): Anomaly's Fallen monolith (VoidMonolith) is placed on every
# new colony map, has hitPoints -1 (destroy_batch cannot remove it) and stays inert until a colonist is ordered to study
# or activate it. It matched `Monolith$` and failed every clean, so it is exempt from the danger and ruin passes.
INERT_FIXTURES = ("VoidMonolith",)
LIST_LIMIT = 5000
POLL_S = 1.0


def _ok(r):
    return isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("success") is not False


def _now():
    return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())


def is_danger_def(d):
    return bool(d) and (bool(DANGER_RE.search(d)) or d in DANGER_ITEM_DEFS)


def _things(call, **kw):
    """-> (rows, error). A truncated listing is an error: it must never read as 'all gone'."""
    r = call("jawa/list_things", limit=LIST_LIMIT, **kw)
    if not _ok(r) or not isinstance(r.get("things"), list):
        return [], "list_things %s failed: %s" % (kw, str(r)[:200])
    if r.get("isCompleteList") is False or (r.get("countMatched") or 0) > len(r["things"]):
        return [], "list_things %s truncated (%s matched)" % (kw, r.get("countMatched"))
    return [t for t in r["things"] if t.get("x") is not None and t.get("z") is not None], None


def _unowned(t):
    return (t.get("factionName") or t.get("faction")) in (None, "", "None")


def _player(t):
    """list_things: `faction` is the FactionDef defName (PlayerColony/PlayerTribe...), `factionName` the colony's own
    name ("New Arrivals"), so only `faction` can say player."""
    return str(t.get("faction") or "").startswith("Player") or t.get("isPlayer") is True


def danger_things(call):
    """Map-gen danger things on the current map: buildings by DANGER_RE (never the player's), items by DANGER_ITEM_DEFS.
    -> (rows, error)."""
    b, e1 = _things(call, group="BuildingArtificial")
    i, e2 = _things(call, defName=",".join(DANGER_ITEM_DEFS))
    rows = [t for t in b if is_danger_def(t.get("def")) and not _player(t) and t.get("def") not in INERT_FIXTURES] + i
    return rows, e1 or e2


def ruin_things(call, natural=("SteamGeyser", "VHGE_GasGeyser") + INERT_FIXTURES):
    """Unowned artificial buildings (ruins, walls, columns, shrine decor), natural scenery excluded. -> (rows, error)."""
    b, err = _things(call, group="BuildingArtificial")
    return [t for t in b if _unowned(t) and t.get("def") not in natural], err


def _vanish_cells(call, rows, categories, passes, relist):
    total, left = 0, rows
    for _ in range(passes):
        if not left:
            break
        rects = ";".join("%d,%d,1,1" % (t["x"], t["z"]) for t in left)
        r = call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects=rects, categories=categories)
        if _ok(r):
            total += len(left)
        left, err = relist()
        if err:
            return left, total, err
    return left, total, None


def _vanish_pawns(call, profile):
    """calm: every non-colonist (destroy_bulk nonColonists). danger: hostile pawns only, each by id (Destroy(Vanish), no
    death action, no corpse), so a biome site keeps the wildlife its census measures (L1 2026-10-15: the first
    Pyrelands build vanished all 14 non-colonists, the wild animals with the hostiles). -> (count, error)."""
    if profile == "calm":
        db = call("jawa/destroy_bulk", filter="nonColonists", dryRun=False) or {}
        return db.get("matchedCount"), (None if _ok(db) else "destroy_bulk nonColonists failed: %s" % str(db)[:200])
    r = call("jawa/list_pawns", faction="hostile", limit=500) or {}
    if not _ok(r) or not isinstance(r.get("pawns"), list):
        return None, "list_pawns hostile failed: %s" % str(r)[:200]
    n = 0
    for p in r["pawns"]:
        if p.get("dead"):
            continue
        v = call("jawa/pawn_force_incapacitate", pawn=p.get("id"), action="vanish") or {}
        n += 1 if (_ok(v) and v.get("destroyedAfter") is True) else 0
    return n, None


class call_session(object):
    """Adapter: a bare call(tool, **kw) as an object with .call (what testenv_guards / quiet_site take)."""

    def __init__(self, call):
        self.call = call


def clean_map(call, profile, quiet=True):
    """The one cleaning pass. Order matters: triggers first (nothing may fire), then the danger containers by Vanish
    (contents destroyed, never dropped), then every non-colonist pawn, then (calm) the ruins, then the WHOLE-map unfog
    with its re-sweep (no fogged pocket survives into the save, so no later wall removal can flood, letter or wake),
    then a second danger/trigger pass and the map-only quiet profile, then the sky. -> receipt dict; receipt['problems']
    is empty only when every step read back clean."""
    if profile not in ("calm", "danger"):
        raise ValueError("profile must be calm or danger")
    S = call_session(call)
    rec = {"profile": profile, "utc": _now(), "problems": []}
    rec["triggers"] = TG.disarm_fog_triggers(S)
    if rec["triggers"].get("verified") is not True:
        rec["problems"].append("fog triggers not disarmed: %s" % (rec["triggers"].get("error") or rec["triggers"].get("left")))
    d0, err = danger_things(call)
    rec["dangerFound"] = sorted({t.get("def") for t in d0})
    left, n, err2 = _vanish_cells(call, d0, "Building,Item", 4, lambda: danger_things(call))
    rec["dangerVanished"], rec["dangerLeft"] = n, [(t.get("def"), t.get("x"), t.get("z")) for t in left]
    if err or err2 or left:
        rec["problems"].append("danger things: %s" % (err or err2 or rec["dangerLeft"][:6]))
    rec["pawnsVanished"], err = _vanish_pawns(call, profile)
    if err:
        rec["problems"].append("pawns: %s" % err)
    if profile == "calm":
        r0, err = ruin_things(call)
        left, n, err2 = _vanish_cells(call, r0, "Building,Item", 5, lambda: ruin_things(call))
        rec["ruinsVanished"], rec["ruinsLeft"] = n, len(left)
        if err or err2 or left:
            rec["problems"].append("ruins: %s" % (err or err2 or "%d left" % len(left)))
    # L1 2026-10-15 (HARNESS): vanishing shrine walls/caskets above opens their fog pocket and releases the sleepers
    # (4 mechs listed hostile at the unfog guard, after the first sweep), so sweep non-colonists again before the unfog.
    rec["pawnsVanishedBeforeUnfog"], err = _vanish_pawns(call, profile)
    if err:
        rec["problems"].append("pawns before the unfog: %s" % err)
    rec["fog"] = TG.clear_map_fog(S)
    if rec["fog"].get("verified") is not True:
        rec["problems"].append("fog: %s" % rec["fog"].get("error"))
    # after the unfog: anything the fog hid is now listable; one more trigger + danger pass, then read back
    rec["triggersAfter"] = TG.disarm_fog_triggers(S)
    if rec["triggersAfter"].get("verified") is not True:
        rec["problems"].append("fog triggers after the unfog: %s" % (rec["triggersAfter"].get("error") or rec["triggersAfter"].get("left")))
    d1, err = danger_things(call)
    left, n, err2 = _vanish_cells(call, d1, "Building,Item", 3, lambda: danger_things(call))
    rec["dangerAfterUnfog"] = sorted({t.get("def") for t in d1})
    if err or err2 or left:
        rec["problems"].append("danger things after the unfog: %s" % (err or err2 or [(t.get("def")) for t in left][:6]))
    if quiet:
        import quiet_site as QS
        rec["quietMap"] = QS.site_profile_receipt(S, "test_site_saves_clean", controls=QS.MAP_ONLY + ("modal_broker",))
        if rec["quietMap"].get("error") or rec["quietMap"].get("problems"):
            rec["problems"].append("quiet map profile: %s" % (rec["quietMap"].get("error") or rec["quietMap"].get("problems")))
    mi = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
    rec["sky"] = TG.calm_sky(S, (int(mi.get("sizeX", 250)), int(mi.get("sizeZ", 250))))
    if rec["sky"].get("verified") is not True:
        rec["problems"].append("sky: %s" % rec["sky"].get("error"))
    call("jawa/incident_queue_clear")
    return rec


def _colonists(call):
    r = call("jawa/list_pawns", limit=500) or {}
    rows = r.get("pawns") or []
    return [p for p in rows if p.get("isPlayer") and p.get("intelligence", "Humanlike") == "Humanlike" and not p.get("dead")]


def check_map(call, site):
    """Read-back that the CURRENT map is still a clean `site` (after a build, and after every load). Touches nothing
    except a 1x1 unfog probe (the fog count has no read-only tool; on a clean map it changes nothing).
    -> {"verified": bool, "problems": [...], ...readings}."""
    spec = SITES[site]
    out = {"site": site, "utc": _now(), "problems": []}
    P = out["problems"]
    S = call_session(call)
    mi = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
    out["map"] = {k: mi.get(k) for k in ("tile", "mapId", "sizeX", "sizeZ", "mapBiome", "outdoorTempNow")}
    if spec.get("size") and (mi.get("sizeX"), mi.get("sizeZ")) != (spec["size"], spec["size"]):
        P.append("map is %sx%s, want %d" % (mi.get("sizeX"), mi.get("sizeZ"), spec["size"]))
    if spec.get("biome") and mi.get("mapBiome") != spec["biome"]:
        P.append("map biome %s, want %s" % (mi.get("mapBiome"), spec["biome"]))
    fg = call("jawa/set_fog", action="unfog", rect="0,0,1,1") or {}
    out["foggedCells"] = fg.get("foggedCellsNow")
    if fg.get("foggedCellsNow") != 0:
        P.append("fogged cells: %s" % fg.get("foggedCellsNow"))
    tr, err = TG._list_triggers(S)
    out["triggers"] = len(tr) if not err else None
    if err or tr:
        P.append("triggers: %s" % (err or [(t["def"], t["x"], t["z"]) for t in tr][:6]))
    dg, err = danger_things(call)
    out["danger"] = sorted({t.get("def") for t in dg}) if not err else None
    if err or dg:
        P.append("danger things: %s" % (err or out["danger"]))
    if spec["profile"] == "calm":
        rn, err = ruin_things(call)
        out["ruins"] = len(rn) if not err else None
        if err or rn:
            P.append("ruins: %s" % (err or "%d (%s)" % (len(rn), sorted({t.get('def') for t in rn})[:6])))
    ids, err = TG._hostile_pawns(S)
    out["hostiles"] = ids
    if err or ids:
        P.append("hostile pawns: %s" % (err or ids[:6]))
    qs = call("jawa/quiet_site", action="status") or {}
    thr = [t for t in qs.get("threats") or [] if not t.get("kept")]
    out["threatStructures"] = [(t.get("def"), t.get("id")) for t in thr] if _ok(qs) else None
    if not _ok(qs) or thr:
        P.append("threat structures: %s" % (out["threatStructures"] if _ok(qs) else str(qs)[:160]))
    fires, err = _things(call, defName="Fire")
    out["fires"] = len(fires) if not err else None
    if err or fires:
        P.append("fires: %s" % (err or len(fires)))
    w = call("jawa/weather_get") or {}
    wx = w.get("weather") or {}
    out["weather"] = {"current": wx.get("current"), "rainRate": wx.get("rainRate")}
    if (wx.get("rainRate") or 0) > 0.01:
        P.append("raining: %s" % out["weather"])
    band = spec.get("temp")
    t = mi.get("outdoorTempNow")
    if band and (not isinstance(t, (int, float)) or not band[0] <= t <= band[1]):
        P.append("outdoor %s C outside the safe band %s" % (t, band))
    cols = _colonists(call)
    out["colonists"] = [(p.get("id"), bool(p.get("downed"))) for p in cols]
    up = [p for p in cols if not p.get("downed")]
    if len(up) < spec.get("minColonists", 1):
        P.append("%d standing colonist(s), want %d" % (len(up), spec.get("minColonists", 1)))
    out["verified"] = not P
    return out


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ save / load
def saves_stat(saves_dir):
    out = {}
    for f in os.listdir(saves_dir):
        if f.endswith(".rws"):
            st = os.stat(os.path.join(saves_dir, f))
            out[f] = (st.st_size, int(st.st_mtime))
    return out


def backup_saves(saves_dir, backup_dir):
    """Project rule: back up the Saves folder before writing a save. -> number of files copied."""
    os.makedirs(backup_dir, exist_ok=True)
    n = 0
    for f in os.listdir(saves_dir):
        src = os.path.join(saves_dir, f)
        if os.path.isfile(src):
            dst = os.path.join(backup_dir, f)
            if os.path.exists(dst):
                os.chmod(dst, 0o666)
                os.remove(dst)
            shutil.copy2(src, dst)
            n += 1
    return n


def save_site(call, name, saves_dir, wait_s=180, sleep=time.sleep):
    """save_game under `name`, then STAT: a new <name>.rws appeared and no existing file changed (save_game has
    written the CURRENT slot instead of saveName before). Never overwrites: a rebuilt site takes the next _vN."""
    before = saves_stat(saves_dir)
    if name + ".rws" in before:
        raise RuntimeError("%s.rws already exists -- a site save is never overwritten; build the next version" % name)
    call("rimworld/save_game", saveName=name)
    t0 = time.time()
    while name + ".rws" not in saves_stat(saves_dir):
        if time.time() - t0 > wait_s:
            raise RuntimeError("no %s.rws appeared in %s within %ds" % (name, saves_dir, wait_s))
        sleep(POLL_S)
    sleep(3.0)                                  # the writer finishes the file after it appears
    after = saves_stat(saves_dir)
    touched = [f for f in before if after.get(f) != before[f]]
    if touched:
        raise RuntimeError("save touched existing file(s) %s" % touched)
    return {"path": os.path.join(saves_dir, name + ".rws"), "bytes": after[name + ".rws"][0]}


def _state(call):
    try:
        return (call("rimworld/get_ui_state") or {}).get("programState")
    except Exception:                            # noqa: BLE001 - the bridge drops calls during a load
        return None


def _wait(pred, budget_s, sleep):
    t0 = time.time()
    while time.time() - t0 < budget_s:
        try:
            if pred():
                return round(time.time() - t0, 1)
        except Exception:                        # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        sleep(POLL_S)
    return None


LOAD_BROKEN = ("Error in Map.FinalizeLoading", "Error while loading a map", "Error while loading game",
               "Could not resolve cross refs")


def _journal_seq(call):
    """The bridge journal's latest sequence number (0 when unreadable)."""
    try:
        lg = call("rimbridge/list_logs", limit=1, minimumLevel="trace") or {}
        return max([int(x.get("Sequence", 0)) for x in lg.get("logs") or []] or [0])
    except Exception:              # noqa: BLE001 - a missing baseline only widens the scan
        return 0


def _load_errors(call, after_seq):
    """The LOAD_BROKEN lines the journal holds after `after_seq` (errors only, so the 1,000-entry ring keeps them)."""
    try:
        lg = call("rimbridge/list_logs", afterSequence=after_seq, limit=1000, minimumLevel="error") or {}
    except Exception as ex:        # noqa: BLE001
        return ["(journal unreadable: %s)" % type(ex).__name__]
    hits = []
    for x in lg.get("logs") or []:
        m = str(x.get("Message", "")).split("\n")[0]
        if any(k in m for k in LOAD_BROKEN) and m[:80] not in hits:
            hits.append(m[:80])
    return hits


def load_site(call, site, budget_s=420, sleep=time.sleep, check=True, name=None):
    """Load the site save from the MAIN MENU (loading over a live game NREs in the teardown: northstar_site.py), wait for
    Playing + a current map, make the site map current, re-apply the map-only quiet profile and the calm sky (a load
    resets the storyteller static and the weather lock), and READ BACK check_map. -> receipt; receipt['verified']."""
    spec = SITES[site]
    name = name or spec.get("save")
    if not name:
        raise ValueError("site %s has no save of its own (Pyrelands loads through northstar_site.py --reload-only)" % site)
    rec = {"site": site, "save": name, "utc": _now(), "problems": []}
    t0 = time.time()
    if _state(call) == "Playing":
        call("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
        if _wait(lambda: _state(call) == "Entry", 180, sleep) is None:
            rec["problems"].append("main menu not reached within 180 s")
            rec["verified"] = False
            return rec
    seq0 = _journal_seq(call)
    try:
        # ignoreModCompatibility: a registered site save is a fixed fixture whose own mod list is not the tier's. The calm
        # site RM_TestSite_calm_v1 records 22 mods incl. Alpha Animals (sarg.alphaanimals), absent from the 21-mod
        # ratchet_pilot tier, so a plain load answered save.missing_mods and validation_v2 aborted at L0 after 420 s
        # (2026-10-16b). The site is verified by check_map read-back below, not by the save's mod header.
        call("rimworld/load_game", saveName=name, ignoreModCompatibility=True)
    except Exception as ex:                      # noqa: BLE001 - polled below, never resent
        rec["loadCallRaised"] = type(ex).__name__
    got = _wait(lambda: _state(call) == "Playing" and (call("jawa/map_info") or {}).get("tile") is not None, budget_s, sleep)
    rec["load_s"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    if got is None:
        rec["problems"].append("no Playing map within %ds of load_game %s" % (budget_s, name))
        rec["verified"] = False
        return rec
    broken = _load_errors(call, seq0)
    if broken:
        # LIVE 2026-10-21: RM_TestSite_leaningscrub_v1 (saved with retired donors) threw in Map.FinalizeLoading, every
        # read-back below still came back clean, and the site read "verified" on a map that then could not reach the main
        # menu (Update() NRE every frame). A load that logged one of these is broken whatever check_map says.
        rec["problems"].append("the load logged %s" % broken)
    reg = read_registry().get(site) or {}
    if reg.get("tile") is not None:
        mid = reg.get("mapId")
        cur = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
        if cur.get("tile") != reg["tile"] and mid is not None:
            call("jawa/set_current_map", mapId=mid)
        cur = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
        if cur.get("tile") != reg["tile"]:
            rec["problems"].append("current map is tile %s, the save's site is %s" % (cur.get("tile"), reg["tile"]))
    S = call_session(call)
    import quiet_site as QS
    rec["quietMap"] = QS.site_profile_receipt(S, "test_site_saves_load_%s" % site, controls=QS.MAP_ONLY + ("modal_broker",))
    mi = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
    rec["sky"] = TG.calm_sky(S, (int(mi.get("sizeX", 250)), int(mi.get("sizeZ", 250))))
    call("jawa/incident_queue_clear")
    if check:
        rec["check"] = check_map(call, site)
        rec["problems"].extend(rec["check"]["problems"])
    rec["ready_s"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
    rec["verified"] = not rec["problems"]
    return rec


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ registry (what was built, where, at which HEAD)
def read_registry(path=REGISTRY):
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
            return json.load(f)
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return {}


def write_registry(site, entry, path=REGISTRY):
    reg = read_registry(path)
    reg[site] = entry
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
        json.dump(reg, f, indent=1, sort_keys=True)
        f.write("\n")


def _head():
    try:
        import subprocess
        return subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "--short=10", "HEAD"], cwd=_UTILS, text=True).strip()
    except Exception:                            # noqa: BLE001
        # a git-archive export (the live runs' copy) has no .git: read the HEAD the exporter wrote beside it
        try:
            root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(_UTILS)))
            return open(os.path.join(root, "EXPORT_HEAD"), encoding="utf-8").read().strip() or None
        except OSError:
            return None


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ builds
def fresh_quicktest(call, sleep=time.sleep, budget_s=420):
    call("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
    _wait(lambda: _state(call) == "Entry", 180, sleep)
    r = call("rimworld/start_debug_game_ready", readiness="mapData", pauseIfNeeded=True, timeoutMs=280000) or {}
    w = _wait(lambda: _state(call) == "Playing" and (call("jawa/map_info") or {}).get("success") is not False
              and (call("jawa/map_info") or {}).get("tile") is not None, budget_s, sleep)
    mi = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
    return {"start": r.get("success"), "wait_s": w, "tile": mi.get("tile"), "biome": mi.get("mapBiome"),
            "size": (mi.get("sizeX"), mi.get("sizeZ")), "outdoor": mi.get("outdoorTempNow")}


FROZEN_OR_HOT = ("IceSheet", "SeaIce", "Tundra", "ExtremeDesert", "Desert", "TemperateSwamp", "TropicalSwamp", "ColdBog")


def roll_ok(call, site):
    """Is the current fresh quicktest map an acceptable base for `site`? -> None or why not."""
    spec = SITES[site]
    mi = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
    if (mi.get("sizeX"), mi.get("sizeZ")) != (spec["size"], spec["size"]):
        return "size %sx%s" % (mi.get("sizeX"), mi.get("sizeZ"))
    if mi.get("mapBiome") in FROZEN_OR_HOT:
        return "biome %s" % mi.get("mapBiome")
    t = mi.get("outdoorTempNow")
    lo, hi = spec["temp"]
    if not isinstance(t, (int, float)) or not lo + 3 <= t <= hi - 3:      # margin: the band must hold through the day
        return "outdoor %s C" % t
    w = (call("jawa/weather_get") or {}).get("weather") or {}
    if (w.get("rainRate") or 0) > 0.01:
        return "raining"
    if site == "calm":
        e = call("jawa/flowworks_engine_state") or {}
        # P11 forms every natural body at map load (lake floors), so bodyCount > 0 on any map with a lake: pristine =
        # nothing dug (MEASURED 2026-10-18: 6 of 6 rolls refused on bodies 21..29 alone)
        if _ok(e) and (e.get("excavatedCellCount") or e.get("superdeepCellCount")):
            return "FlowWorks engine not pristine (excavated %s superdeep %s)" % (e.get("excavatedCellCount"), e.get("superdeepCellCount"))
    return None


def build(call, site, saves_dir, work_dir, max_rolls=6, sleep=time.sleep, name=None):
    """calm / river: fresh quicktest (re-rolled until roll_ok) -> [river: river_site.py, home map dropped] -> clean_map
    -> check_map -> back up Saves -> save -> registry. Raises on any unclean read-back (nothing is saved then)."""
    spec = SITES[site]
    name = name or spec["save"]
    if name + ".rws" in saves_stat(saves_dir):
        raise RuntimeError("%s.rws exists -- bump the version in SITES (a save is never overwritten)" % name)
    rec = {"site": site, "save": name, "rolls": [], "utc": _now(), "head": _head()}
    for _ in range(max_rolls):
        q = fresh_quicktest(call, sleep=sleep)
        why = roll_ok(call, site) if site == "calm" else None
        if why is None and site == "calm":
            # L1 2026-10-15 (SITE): a map whose clean cannot finish (an indestructible Fallen monolith, VoidMonolith,
            # hitPoints -1, survives destroy_batch) is a bad roll, not a failed build: roll again.
            rec["clean"] = clean_map(call, spec["profile"])
            if rec["clean"]["problems"]:
                why = "clean: %s" % rec["clean"]["problems"]
        q["rejected"] = why
        rec["rolls"].append(q)
        if why is None:
            break
    else:
        raise RuntimeError("no acceptable quicktest map in %d rolls: %s" % (max_rolls, rec["rolls"]))
    if site == "river":
        rec["river"] = make_river_site(call, rec["rolls"][-1].get("tile"))
        rec["clean"] = clean_map(call, spec["profile"])
    if rec["clean"]["problems"]:
        raise RuntimeError("clean_map not clean: %s" % rec["clean"]["problems"])
    rec["check"] = check_map(call, site)
    if not rec["check"]["verified"]:
        raise RuntimeError("check_map after the clean: %s" % rec["check"]["problems"])
    stamp = time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")
    rec["backup"] = {"dir": os.path.join(work_dir, "saves_backup_%s" % stamp)}
    rec["backup"]["files"] = backup_saves(saves_dir, rec["backup"]["dir"])
    rec["saved"] = save_site(call, name, saves_dir, sleep=sleep)
    mi = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
    write_registry(site, {"save": name, "tile": mi.get("tile"), "mapId": mi.get("mapId"), "biome": mi.get("mapBiome"),
                          "builtUtc": rec["utc"], "head": rec["head"], "profile": spec["profile"],
                          "outdoorAtSave": mi.get("outdoorTempNow"), "bytes": rec["saved"]["bytes"]})
    return rec


def make_river_site(call, home_tile):
    """Run FlowWorks' river_site.py in-process (it founds a mild river colony with moving water on >= 2 edges, read back,
    and drops every rejected candidate), then remove the quicktest HOME map so the save holds the river site only."""
    import subprocess
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(_UTILS)))
    rs = os.path.join(root, "src", "RimMandrake", "FlowWorks", "northstar", "river_site.py")
    env = dict(os.environ, RM_ALLOW_CONCURRENT_BRIDGE="1")   # this module's own connection stays open and idle meanwhile
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, rs], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900, env=env)
    out = (p.stdout or "").replace("\r", "")
    rec = {"rc": p.returncode, "tail": out.strip().splitlines()[-4:]}
    if p.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("river_site.py rc %s: %s" % (p.returncode, rec["tail"]))
    mi = call("jawa/map_info") or {}
    rec["site"] = {"tile": mi.get("tile"), "mapId": mi.get("mapId"), "biome": mi.get("mapBiome")}
    if home_tile is not None and home_tile != mi.get("tile"):
        r = call("jawa/settlement_remove", mode="map", tile=home_tile, force=True) or {}
        rec["homeDropped"] = {"tile": home_tile, "ok": _ok(r)}
        call("jawa/set_current_map", mapId=mi.get("mapId"))
    return rec


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ prove: the save fits the running list, then loads clean
def save_header_ids(path):
    """The save's own mod header (<meta><modIds>, first 64 KiB) -> lowercased packageIds, or None if unreadable."""
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
        head = f.read(65536)
    m = re.search(r"<modIds>(.*?)</modIds>", head, re.S)
    ids = [x.strip().lower() for x in re.findall(r"<li>(.*?)</li>", m.group(1))] if m else []
    return ids or None


def tier_ids(tier):
    """The exact packageId list modset_builder writes for `tier` (lowercased), or raise: a site's fixture tier must
    resolve, or 'fits the tier' cannot be judged."""
    import modset_builder as MB
    ids, missing, refusals = MB.resolve_tier(tier, MB.scan())
    if missing or refusals:
        raise RuntimeError("tier %s does not resolve: missing %s refusals %s" % (tier, missing, refusals))
    return [i.lower() for i in ids]


def header_problems(path, running, tier=None):
    """A site save against the RUNNING packageIds -> (problems, header ids). A header mod the running list lacks is the
    RIVER_SITE_REBUILD_FOR_FOURTEEN_MODS class (v1 carried vfe.insectoid2 onto a list without it: GameComponent load
    failed, FinalizeLoading NRE, Update() storm); a retired donor or a missing DLC is a dead fixture on any tier."""
    from retired_mods import is_retired
    from biome_site import missing_dlc
    if not os.path.isfile(path):
        return ["no save file %s" % path], []
    ids = save_header_ids(path)
    if not ids:
        return ["save header unreadable: no <modIds> in the first 64 KiB of %s" % path], []
    run = {str(i).strip().lower() for i in running or ()}
    if not run:
        return ["running mod list unreadable (empty): cannot compare the header"], ids
    P = []
    off = [i for i in ids if i not in run]
    if off:
        P.append("save header names mod(s) the running list lacks %s" % off)
    bad = [i for i in ids if is_retired(i)]
    if bad:
        P.append("save header holds retired donor(s) %s" % bad)
    lack = missing_dlc(ids)
    if lack:
        P.append("save header lacks DLC %s" % lack)
    if tier is not None:
        tl = set(tier)
        beyond = [i for i in ids if i not in tl]
        if beyond:
            P.append("save header names mod(s) beyond its fixture tier %s" % beyond)
    return P, ids


def prove(call, site, saves_dir, work_dir, build_if_missing=False, sleep=time.sleep, load=True):
    """LIVE. A1: the site save exists (built now on the running list if missing and asked) and its header fits the
    running list. A2: a load from the main menu reads verified. A failed load is left at the main menu, never running
    (a broken load sits in an Update() NRE storm). -> receipt with A1, A2 (problem lists) and verified."""
    from biome_site import running_retired
    spec = SITES[site]
    name = spec.get("save")
    if not name:
        raise ValueError("site %s has no save of its own" % site)
    rec = {"site": site, "save": name, "tier": spec.get("tier"), "utc": _now()}
    running, retired = running_retired(call)
    rec["running"] = running
    path = os.path.join(saves_dir, name + ".rws")
    tl = tier_ids(spec["tier"]) if spec.get("tier") else None
    if build_if_missing and not os.path.isfile(path):
        extra = [i for i in running if tl is not None and i not in tl]
        if retired:
            rec["A1"] = ["not built: the running list holds retired donor(s) %s" % retired]
        elif extra:
            # a save records the list it was made on; built on a superset it dies on the tier (v1's whole defect)
            rec["A1"] = ["not built: the running list has mod(s) beyond tier %s %s" % (spec["tier"], extra)]
        else:
            try:
                b = build(call, site, saves_dir, work_dir, sleep=sleep)
                rec["build"] = {k: b.get(k) for k in ("save", "head", "saved")}
            except RuntimeError as ex:
                rec["build"] = {"error": str(ex)[:600]}
    if "A1" not in rec:
        rec["A1"], rec["mods"] = header_problems(path, running, tl)
        if (rec.get("build") or {}).get("error"):
            rec["A1"].insert(0, "build failed: %s" % rec["build"]["error"])
    if rec["A1"]:
        rec["A2"] = ["not loaded: A1 failed"]
    elif not load:
        rec["A2"] = []
        rec["load"] = "skipped (--no-load: A1 only)"
    else:
        ld = load_site(call, site, sleep=sleep)
        rec["load"] = {k: ld.get(k) for k in ("load_s", "ready_s", "verified", "check")}
        rec["A2"] = list(ld.get("problems") or [])
        if rec["A2"]:
            rec["menu"] = to_main_menu(call, sleep=sleep)
    rec["verified"] = not rec["A1"] and not rec["A2"]
    rec["problems"] = rec["A1"] + rec["A2"]
    return rec


def to_main_menu(call, budget_s=180, sleep=time.sleep):
    """Leave a broken load: go to the main menu and report whether Entry was reached (it may not be, in an NRE storm)."""
    try:
        call("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
    except Exception as ex:                      # noqa: BLE001 - polled below
        return {"reached": False, "raised": type(ex).__name__}
    return {"reached": _wait(lambda: _state(call) == "Entry", budget_s, sleep) is not None}


def main(argv=None):
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("verb", choices=("list", "build", "load", "check", "prove"))
    ap.add_argument("--build-if-missing", action="store_true", help="prove: build the site first if its save is absent")
    ap.add_argument("--no-load", action="store_true", help="prove: A1 only (save present, header fits), no load")
    ap.add_argument("site", nargs="?", choices=sorted(SITES))
    ap.add_argument("--work", default=None, help="evidence dir (default Transient/test_site_saves)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=None, help="receipt JSON")
    ap.add_argument("--fingerprint", help="build pyrelands: the Pyrelands def fingerprint of the source fixture")
    ap.add_argument("--from-tag", default=None, help="build pyrelands: the source fixture's tag (e.g. r6)")
    ap.add_argument("--tile", type=int, default=5, help="build pyrelands: the fixture's centre tile")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.verb == "list":
        reg = read_registry()
        for k, v in sorted(SITES.items()):
            print("%-10s %-24s profile=%-6s built=%s" % (k, v.get("save") or "(northstar_site tag %s)" % v.get("tag"),
                                                         v["profile"], json.dumps(reg.get(k)) if reg.get(k) else "-"))
        return 0
    if not a.site:
        ap.error("%s needs a site" % a.verb)
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(_UTILS)))
    work = a.work or os.path.join(root, "Transient", "test_site_saves")
    os.makedirs(work, exist_ok=True)
    from rimbridge_client import RimBridge, resolve_endpoint
    h, p, t = resolve_endpoint()
    with RimBridge(h, p, t, timeout=300.0) as rb:
        call = lambda tool, **kw: rb.call(tool, kw)   # noqa: E731
        if a.verb == "check":
            res = check_map(call, a.site)
        elif a.verb == "load":
            res = load_site(call, a.site)
        elif a.verb == "prove":
            from game_paths import SAVES
            res = prove(call, a.site, SAVES, work, build_if_missing=a.build_if_missing, load=not a.no_load)
        elif a.site == "pyrelands":
            res = build_pyrelands(call, a.fingerprint, a.from_tag, a.tile, work)
        elif SITES[a.site].get("builder"):
            res = build_with_builder(a.site, work)
        else:
            from game_paths import SAVES
            res = build(call, a.site, SAVES, work)
    out = a.out or os.path.join(work, "%s_%s_%s.json" % (a.verb, a.site, time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S")))
    with open(out, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(res, f, indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    ok = res.get("verified", not res.get("problems"))
    print("%s %s: %s -> %s %s" % (a.verb, a.site, "CLEAN" if ok else "NOT CLEAN", out,
                                 "" if ok else (res.get("problems") or (res.get("check") or {}).get("problems"))))
    if a.verb == "prove":
        return 0 if ok else 1
    return 0 if ok else 3


def build_with_builder(site, work_dir):
    """A biome site with its own recipe module (SITES[site]["builder"], relative to src/RimMandrake/): its
    build_site_save(session, work_dir) founds, cleans, reads back, saves and registers the site."""
    import importlib.util
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(_UTILS)))
    path = os.path.join(root, "src", "RimMandrake", SITES[site]["builder"])
    mdir = os.path.dirname(path)
    if mdir not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, mdir)
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("site_builder_%s" % site, path)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    from northstar_driver.session import FastSession
    s = FastSession(strict=False)
    with s:
        return mod.build_site_save(s, work_dir)


def build_pyrelands(call, fingerprint, from_tag, tile, work_dir):
    """Reload the existing Pyrelands fixture (northstar_site.py's own loader + settle), clean it with the DANGER profile
    (its ruins and wildlife are the suite's subject and stay), read back, save as the tag-`calm` fixture."""
    if not fingerprint:
        raise SystemExit("build pyrelands needs --fingerprint (the source fixture's)")
    root = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(_UTILS)))
    pdir = os.path.join(root, "src", "RimMandrake", "Pyrelands")
    if pdir not in sys.path:
        sys.path.insert(0, pdir)
    import northstar_site as NS
    from game_paths import SAVES
    from northstar_driver.session import FastSession
    src = NS.fixture_name(1, fingerprint, NS.TARGET_TEMP, from_tag)
    dst = NS.fixture_name(1, fingerprint, NS.TARGET_TEMP, SITES["pyrelands"]["tag"])
    rec = {"site": "pyrelands", "from": src, "save": dst, "utc": _now(), "head": _head()}
    s = FastSession(strict=False)
    with s:
        rec["reload"] = {k: v for k, v in NS.reload_fixture(s, src, tile).items() if k != "quietSite"}
        rec["clean"] = clean_map(s.call, "danger")
        if rec["clean"]["problems"]:
            raise RuntimeError("clean_map not clean: %s" % rec["clean"]["problems"])
        rec["check"] = check_map(s.call, "pyrelands")
        if not rec["check"]["verified"]:
            raise RuntimeError("check_map after the clean: %s" % rec["check"]["problems"])
        rec["backup"] = {"dir": os.path.join(work_dir, "saves_backup_%s" % time.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S"))}
        rec["backup"]["files"] = backup_saves(SAVES, rec["backup"]["dir"])
        rec["saved"] = save_site(s.call, dst, SAVES)
        mi = s.call("jawa/map_info") or {}
    write_registry("pyrelands", {"save": dst, "tile": mi.get("tile"), "mapId": mi.get("mapId"), "biome": mi.get("mapBiome"),
                                 "builtUtc": rec["utc"], "head": rec["head"], "profile": "danger", "from": src,
                                 "outdoorAtSave": mi.get("outdoorTempNow"), "bytes": rec["saved"]["bytes"],
                                 "load": "northstar_site.py --site 1 --fingerprint %s --tag calm --reload-only --tile %s"
                                         % (fingerprint, tile)})
    rec["verified"] = True
    return rec


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""test_site_tier_gate -- LIVE read-only precondition: is the RUNNING game the site's fixture tier at all?
(RIVER_SITE_REBUILD_FOR_FOURTEEN_MODS A1/A2.)

A site save records the list it was made on, so `test_site_saves.py prove river` refuses to build or load on a game that
is not SITES[site]["tier"]. On 2026-11-03 the live round ran it on another item's 28-mod game (sarg.alphabiomes, HAR,
OuterRim ...): prove said NOT CLEAN, the round wrote FAIL, and a FAIL stands for the build. That reading measured the
game, not the item. This gate runs first in each live line and turns "wrong game" into UNMEASURED (exit 2), which the
round restages, instead of a FAIL.

Fits (exit 0) when the running packageIds hold no retired donor, no mod beyond the resolved tier, every member of the
resolved tier (not only the ones it `want`s: a 13-mod subset is not the 14-mod list), and all five DLC. Exit 2 = wrong game (restage on the tier); exit 3 = the instrument could not read. It never
exits 1: it judges the game, never the item.

    python.exe src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/test_site_tier_gate.py river
"""
import json
import os
import sys

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
_UTILS = os.path.dirname(_HERE)
_NORTHSTAR = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(_UTILS), "FlowWorks", "northstar")
for _p in (_HERE, _UTILS, _NORTHSTAR):
    if _p not in sys.path:
        sys.path.append(_p)

import test_site_saves as T  # noqa: E402

FITS, WRONG_GAME, BLIND = 0, 2, 3


def tier_want(tier):
    """The packageIds the tier must load (modset_builder TIERS[tier]['want'], lowercased)."""
    import modset_builder as MB
    return [str(i).lower() for i in MB.TIERS[tier].get("want") or ()]


def tier_gaps(running, site, tier_list=None, want=None):
    """running packageIds -> problems (empty = the game is the site's tier). tier_list/want default to the resolved
    tier; the selftest passes its own."""
    from retired_mods import is_retired
    from biome_site import missing_dlc
    tier = T.SITES[site].get("tier")
    if not tier:
        return ["site %s names no fixture tier" % site]
    run = [str(i).strip().lower() for i in running or () if str(i).strip()]
    if not run:
        return ["running mod list unreadable (empty)"]
    tl = set(tier_list if tier_list is not None else T.tier_ids(tier))
    want = want if want is not None else tier_want(tier)
    P = []
    bad = [i for i in run if is_retired(i)]
    if bad:
        P.append("running list holds retired donor(s) %s" % bad)
    beyond = [i for i in run if i not in tl]
    if beyond:
        P.append("running list has mod(s) beyond tier %s %s" % (tier, beyond))
    lack = [i for i in want if i not in run]
    if lack:
        P.append("running list lacks tier %s mod(s) %s" % (tier, lack))
    short = sorted(i for i in tl if i not in run and i not in lack)   # the tier is the WHOLE list (14 mods), not its want
    if short:
        P.append("running list lacks tier %s member(s) %s" % (tier, short))
    dlc = missing_dlc(run)
    if dlc:
        P.append("running list lacks DLC %s" % dlc)
    return P


def main(argv=None):
    import argparse
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("site", choices=sorted(k for k, v in T.SITES.items() if v.get("tier")))
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    try:
        from rimbridge_client import RimBridge, resolve_endpoint
        from biome_site import running_retired
        h, p, t = resolve_endpoint()
        with RimBridge(h, p, t, timeout=60.0) as rb:
            running, _ = running_retired(lambda tool, **kw: rb.call(tool, kw))
        P = tier_gaps(running, a.site)          # an unresolvable tier raises here: BLIND too, never a traceback's exit 1
    except Exception as ex:  # noqa: BLE001 - a blind read is UNMEASURED, never a verdict
        print("tier gate %s: BLIND %s: %s" % (a.site, type(ex).__name__, str(ex)[:300]))
        return BLIND
    tier = T.SITES[a.site]["tier"]
    if P:
        print("tier gate %s: WRONG GAME (UNMEASURED; restage on tier %s: modlist_swap.py / modset_builder) %s"
              % (a.site, tier, json.dumps({"problems": P, "running": running})))
        return WRONG_GAME
    print("tier gate %s: FITS tier %s (%d mods)" % (a.site, tier, len(running)))
    return FITS


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""live_log_check.py -- does the RUNNING game's Player.log name a token in an error line? Read-only, no bridge call.

    python3 src/RimMandrake/Utils/live_log_check.py --absent RUT_ExplosiveGrowthRoster --absent RUT_PaleMoss [--warnings]

For criteria worded "Player.log carries no error naming X" (RA_S09_LIVE_WIRE_ONE_REAL_LEAF). A line is an error line when
it matches ERROR_RE (with --warnings, WARN_RE too); a token is matched as a literal substring of such a line.

--never TOKEN fails on ANY line naming the token, error word or not. Player.log carries no level marker: a Log.Warning
is bare text (stack traces are off), so a warning without the word "warn" in it is invisible to --warnings. Name such a
message by its own text with --never ("[RM Minerals] quarry", "name only disabled mineables").

Exit 0 no error line names any token, 1 one does (a real FAIL; the lines are printed), 2 UNMEASURED: no running game,
a log older than the running game (it belongs to an earlier session), or a log without the anchor (default
"Bridge token:", printed once the load finished and RimBridge came up: a log before that has not seen the load's
errors yet). Pair it with live_def_check.py when the criterion also needs the mod to be loaded: an absent token in a
load that never had the mod is not a pass, and this file cannot tell.
"""
import argparse
import datetime
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
PASS, FAIL, UNMEASURED = 0, 1, 2
# Word-ended so an identifier is not an error: RUT_ErrorPlant and "0 errors" are not error lines, NullReferenceException,
# "2 errors" and "Config error in" are. The tokens and every underscore identifier are blanked out first (MASK_RE).
ERROR_RE = re.compile(r"errors?\b|exceptions?\b|\bfailed\b|\bcould not\b|\bcouldn't\b", re.I)
WARN_RE = re.compile(r"warn(ing)?s?\b", re.I)
NONE_RE = re.compile(r"\b(0|no|zero|without)\s+(errors?|exceptions?|warnings?)\b", re.I)
IDENT_RE = re.compile(r"\w*_\w*")
# A line that continues the record above it (a stack trace, an inner exception, a [Ref] stub), not a message of its
# own. Blank lines never split a record: "Exception:\n\n  defName: X" is one record. A failed patch prints its file on
# the next line, unindented ("file: C:\\...\\Patches\\X.xml"): without `file: ` a token naming the patch file was missed.
CONT_RE = re.compile(r"^(\s|at |file: |\(Filename|--- |Rethrow|\[0x|\[Ref |(Verse|RimWorld|UnityEngine|System|HarmonyLib|Mono)\.\S*[:(])")
ANCHOR = "Bridge token:"


def records(text):
    """-> [(first line number, [lines])]: a message line plus the continuation lines under it."""
    out = []
    for n, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        if out and CONT_RE.match(line):
            out[-1][1].append(line)
        else:
            out.append((n, [line]))
    return out


def judge(text, tokens, warnings=False, anchor=ANCHOR, never=()):
    """-> (exit code, lines). Pure: `text` is the whole Player.log. A record (a message and its stack trace) fails when
    any of its lines is an error line (with `warnings`, a warning line too) and any of its lines names a token, as a
    literal substring: RUT_PaleMoss also hits RUT_PaleMossLarge, a false FAIL at worst, never a false PASS."""
    if anchor and anchor not in text:
        return UNMEASURED, ["UNMEASURED: the log has no %r yet: the load has not finished" % anchor]
    hits, recs = [], records(text)
    for n, lines in recs:
        named = [t for t in never if any(t in x for x in lines)]
        if named:
            hits.append("FAIL line %d names %s, which may never appear: %s" % (n, ", ".join(named),
                                                                              " | ".join(x.strip() for x in lines)[:240]))
    mask = re.compile("|".join(re.escape(t) for t in sorted(tokens, key=len, reverse=True)))

    def bad(line):
        line = NONE_RE.sub(" ", IDENT_RE.sub(" ", mask.sub(" ", line)))
        return ERROR_RE.search(line) or (warnings and WARN_RE.search(line))

    for n, lines in recs if tokens else ():
        named = [t for t in tokens if any(t in x for x in lines)]
        if named and any(bad(x) for x in lines):
            hits.append("FAIL line %d names %s: %s" % (n, ", ".join(named), " | ".join(x.strip() for x in lines)[:240]))
    if hits:
        return FAIL, hits[:40] + (["... %d more" % (len(hits) - 40)] if len(hits) > 40 else [])
    return PASS, (["PASS no %s line names %s" % ("error or warning" if warnings else "error", ", ".join(tokens))] if tokens
                  else []) + (["PASS no line names %s" % ", ".join(never)] if never else [])


def game_started():
    """The running RimWorld's start, epoch seconds to the millisecond; None when none or two run, or it cannot be read."""
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(["powershell.exe", "-NoProfile", "-Command",
                            "Get-Process RimWorldWin64 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object "
                            "{ $_.StartTime.ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.fffZ') }"],
                           capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
        lines = [x.strip() for x in r.stdout.splitlines() if x.strip()]
        if len(lines) != 1:
            return None
        return datetime.datetime.strptime(lines[0], "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ").replace(
            tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc).timestamp()
    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired):
        return None


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--absent", action="append", default=[], metavar="TOKEN")
    ap.add_argument("--never", action="append", default=[], metavar="TOKEN",
                    help="any line naming this fails, error word or not (a Log.Warning has no marker in Player.log)")
    ap.add_argument("--warnings", action="store_true", help="a warning line naming a token fails too")
    ap.add_argument("--log", default=None, help="another log (default: game_paths.PLAYER_LOG); skips the game check")
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    tokens = [t for t in (x.strip() for x in a.absent) if t]
    never = [t for t in (x.strip() for x in a.never) if t]
    if not tokens and not never:
        print("UNMEASURED: no token to look for")
        return UNMEASURED
    path = a.log
    if path is None:
        sys.path.insert(0, HERE)
        from game_paths import PLAYER_LOG as path
        started = game_started()
        if started is None:
            print("UNMEASURED: no running game")
            return UNMEASURED
        try:
            if os.path.getmtime(path) <= started:
                print("UNMEASURED: %s was last written before the running game started" % path)
                return UNMEASURED
        except OSError as e:
            print("UNMEASURED: %s" % e)
            return UNMEASURED
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            text = f.read()
    except OSError as e:
        print("UNMEASURED: %s" % e)
        return UNMEASURED
    if a.log is None and game_started() != started:
        print("UNMEASURED: the running game changed while the log was read")
        return UNMEASURED
    code, lines = judge(text, tokens, a.warnings, never=never)
    print("\n".join(lines))
    print({PASS: "VERDICT PASS", FAIL: "VERDICT FAIL", UNMEASURED: "VERDICT UNMEASURED"}[code])
    return code


def safe_main(argv=None):
    """main(), where nothing may escape: an uncaught exception exits 1, which the runner would record as a FAIL."""
    try:
        return main(argv)
    except SystemExit:
        raise
    except BaseException as e:
        sys.stdout.write("UNMEASURED: " + ascii("%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, str(e)[:200])) + "\n")
        return UNMEASURED


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(safe_main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""HORRORS_RAIDING_FACTION_1 live proof: the Assailant horrors reach the nightside and nowhere else.

    python.exe src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/prove_night_horrors_live.py A2 < /dev/null
    python.exe src/RimUtinni/UtinniPatches/prove_night_horrors_live.py A3 < /dev/null

Runs under WINDOWS python: RimBridge binds Windows loopback. Needs a loaded game whose world has land on both sides of
the terminator (the Ash'karr world does; a low-coverage quicktest world may not, and then the clause FAILS, saying so).

  A2  on a freshly generated NIGHTSIDE player map (tile arc from the substellar point > nightsideBandMinArc + 5):
      at least one RUT_HorrorHive lair is on the map (the self-gating GenStep ran); the lair's RUT_HorrorSinkhole is a
      working door: RUT_HorrorSinkholeProbe.Descend (jawa/static_call) goes down it the player's way and the pocket map
      it opens is RUT_HorrorTunnels holding at least one hive, crysalis and mite larder and exactly one CaveExit (the
      probe then destroys that pocket map); and RUT_HorrorRaid, forced, fires and leaves pawns of the RUT_Horrors
      faction on the map.
  A3  on a freshly generated DAYSIDE player map (arc < terminatorBandMinArc - 5): no lair structure or crysalis of
      ours is on the map, and RUT_HorrorRaid, forced, reports canFireNow=false (dry run, nothing fires).

The arc uses the shipped geometry def (WeatherGeometryDefs_Ashkarr.xml) and the same formula as
RM_WeatherKernel.ArcDegrees, over the live world's own tile table (jawa/world_tile_export: tile indices belong to the
world that wrote them). Each run founds one player settlement, generates its map, and drops the map again at the end.
Exit 0 = the clause holds, 1 = it does not (or could not be measured)."""
import csv
import json
import math
import os
import random
import sys
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
REPO = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "..", ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, "src", "RimMandrake", "Utils"))
GEOM = os.path.join(REPO, "src", "RimUtinni", "AshkarrWeatherSuite", "Defs", "WeatherGeometryDefs", "WeatherGeometryDefs_Ashkarr.xml")
LAIR = ["RUT_HorrorHive", "RUT_HorrorDen", "RUT_HorrorBurrow", "RUT_HorrorSinkhole", "RUT_HorrorMiteLarder",
        "RUT_HorrorCrysalis_Visceral", "RUT_HorrorCrysalis_Prowler", "RUT_HorrorCrysalis_Harvester", "RUT_HorrorCrysalis_Bulwark"]
FORMS = ["RM_Visceral", "RUT_HorrorBulwark", "RUT_HorrorHarvester", "RUT_HorrorProwler", "RUT_HorrorBroodLord"]
WATER = ("ocean", "lake", "sea", "water", "ice sheet")


class Game:
    def __init__(self):
        import rimbridge_client as rb
        host, port, token = rb.resolve_endpoint()
        self.s = rb.RimBridge(host=host, port=port, token=token, timeout=280.0)
        self.s.connect()

    def call(self, t, **p):
        r = self.s.call(t, p) or {}
        if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("content"):
            try:
                r = json.loads(r["content"][0]["text"])
            except ValueError:
                pass
        return r


def geometry():
    g = ET.parse(GEOM).getroot().find(".//*[substellarLat]")
    return {k: float(g.findtext(k)) for k in ("substellarLat", "substellarLon", "terminatorBandMinArc", "nightsideBandMinArc")}


def arc(lat, lon, lat0, lon0):
    r = math.radians
    c = math.sin(r(lat0)) * math.sin(r(lat)) + math.cos(r(lat0)) * math.cos(r(lat)) * math.cos(r(lon - lon0))
    return math.degrees(math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, c))))


def candidates(g, geo, night):
    exp = g.call("jawa/world_tile_export")
    path = exp.get("path") or exp.get("pathWritten") or ""
    if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
        return None, "world_tile_export wrote no readable file: %s" % str(exp)[:300]
    out = []
    with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for row in csv.DictReader(fh):
            b = (row.get("biome") or "").lower()
            if not b or any(w in b for w in WATER):
                continue
            a = arc(float(row["lat"]), float(row["long"]), geo["substellarLat"], geo["substellarLon"])
            if (night and a > geo["nightsideBandMinArc"] + 5) or (not night and a < geo["terminatorBandMinArc"] - 5):
                out.append((int(row["tile"]), round(a, 1), row.get("biome")))
    random.shuffle(out)
    return out, "%d %s land tiles in %s" % (len(out), "nightside" if night else "dayside", path)


def make_map(g, tiles):
    for tile, a, biome in tiles[:25]:
        f = g.call("jawa/colony_found", tile=tile, name="HorrorProbe")
        if not f.get("success"):
            continue
        m = g.call("jawa/world_tile_map_generate", tile=tile)
        if m.get("success") and m.get("mapId") is not None:
            g.call("jawa/set_current_map", mapId=m["mapId"])
            return {"tile": tile, "arc": a, "biome": biome, "mapId": m["mapId"], "mapIndex": m.get("mapIndex")}
    return None


def count(g, defs, pawns=False):
    r = g.call("jawa/list_things", defName=",".join(defs), includePawns=pawns, limit=500)
    things = r.get("things") or r.get("results") or []
    return things


def drop(g, m):
    info = g.call("jawa/map_info")
    if m and info.get("tile") == m["tile"] and m.get("mapIndex") is not None:
        g.call("jawa/map_drop", mapIndex=m["mapIndex"], notifyPlayer=False)


def run(clause):
    geo = geometry()
    g = Game()
    if g.call("rimworld/get_game_info").get("status") != "game_loaded":
        print("FAIL %s: no game loaded" % clause)
        return 1
    night = clause == "A2"
    tiles, note = candidates(g, geo, night)
    print(note)
    if not tiles:
        print("FAIL %s: no candidate tile on this world" % clause)
        return 1
    m = make_map(g, tiles)
    if not m:
        print("FAIL %s: could not found+generate a map on any of %d candidate tiles" % (clause, min(25, len(tiles))))
        return 1
    print("map:", m)
    ok = False
    try:
        lair = count(g, LAIR)
        hives = [t for t in lair if t.get("def") == "RUT_HorrorHive"]
        if night:
            r = g.call("jawa/static_call", type="RimMandrake.Utinni.UtinniPatches.RUT_HorrorSinkholeProbe", method="Descend", args="go")
            below = str((r or {}).get("result", "")) or "no result: %r" % (r,)
            kv = dict(x.split("=", 1) for x in below.split()[1:] if "=" in x)
            num = lambda k: int(kv.get(k, "-1")) if kv.get(k, "").lstrip("-").isdigit() else -1
            door = (below.startswith("descended ") and kv.get("pocket") == "True" and kv.get("generator") == "RUT_HorrorTunnels"
                    and num("hives") >= 1 and num("crysalises") >= 1 and num("larders") >= 1 and num("exits") == 1)
            print("sinkhole descent: %s -> %s" % (below, "door works" if door else "DOOR BROKEN"))
            fire = g.call("jawa/fire_incident", incidentDef="RUT_HorrorRaid", forced=True)
            time.sleep(1)
            facs = g.call("jawa/list_factions", includeHidden=True, defName="RUT_Horrors")
            forms = [t for t in count(g, FORMS, pawns=True) if "Horror" in str(t.get("faction", "")) or "Assailant" in str(t.get("faction", ""))]
            print("lair things %d (hives %d); raid fired=%s canFireNow=%s blockedByDialog=%s; faction rows %s; Horror-faction forms on map %d"
                  % (len(lair), len(hives), fire.get("fired"), fire.get("canFireNow"), fire.get("blockedByDialog"), str(facs)[:200], len(forms)))
            ok = door and len(hives) >= 1 and fire.get("canFireNow") is True and fire.get("success") is True and len(forms) >= 1
        else:
            dry = g.call("jawa/fire_incident", incidentDef="RUT_HorrorRaid", forced=True, dryRun=True)
            print("lair things %d; dry-run canFireNow=%s" % (len(lair), dry.get("canFireNow")))
            ok = len(lair) == 0 and dry.get("canFireNow") is False
    finally:
        drop(g, m)
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + clause)
    return 0 if ok else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) != 2 or sys.argv[1] not in ("A2", "A3"):
        print(__doc__)
        sys.exit(1)
    sys.exit(run(sys.argv[1]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""modcheck -- the scripted mod-functionality validator (pre-playtest).

    python.exe src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py run <mod> [<mod>...] [--debug]
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py status
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py declare <mod> minor --why "..."
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py rename-key <old> <new> --why "..."
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py forget-key <key> --why "..."
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py validate <mod> [--owner-said "..."]
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py review <mod> --owner-said "..."
    python3     src/RimMandrake/Utils/modcheck/cli.py record <mod> --result <json> [--tier T]

`record` (2026-10-02) records a functional script's LIVE result (e.g.
FlowWorks/northstar/validation_v2.py) through status.record_run WITHOUT
touching ModsConfig.xml -- it refuses a stale result (mod hash moved), a run
whose live mod set is not the declared tier, and an aborted run (record.py).

`run` drives a live bridge session and needs `python.exe` (Windows) for the
same WSL-loopback reason every other bridge driver does
(rimbridge_client.py). `status` and `declare` touch only
`infrastructure/state/modcheck_status.json` and run fine under plain
`python3`.

`rename-key` and `forget-key` are the two verbs `modcheck_status.json` owed
the naming migration (MEASURED 2026-09-17: `FluidCanals` sat GREEN under its
dead pre-rename name while the mod ships as `FlowWorks`) -- the only
sanctioned way to move or drop a key, since hand-editing that file is
forbidden.

`validate` and `review` are the two OWNER-AUTHORISED verbs added 2026-09-15
(design/RimMandrake/north_star_validation_spec.md): `validate` turns a mod's
agent-drafted `## north star` checklist into a binding bar, `review` records
that he has read a run's sheet with his own eyes -- required once, before a
mod's first GREEN. Both take his verbatim `--owner-said` and neither re-derives
his judgement; `validate` with no `--owner-said` prints the bar and writes
nothing, so the lines can be read to him first.
"""
import argparse
import os
import sys

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
if _HERE not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _HERE)
_UTILS = os.path.dirname(_HERE)
if _UTILS not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _UTILS)


def main(argv=None):
    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else list(argv)
    if argv[:1] == ["metrics"]:     # its own argparse (metrics.py --help); listed below for discoverability
        import metrics
        return metrics.main(argv[1:])
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
                                 formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p_run = sub.add_parser("run")
    p_run.add_argument("mods", nargs="+",
                       help="mod folder name(s), e.g. Pits")
    p_run.add_argument("--item", action="append", default=[],
                       help="ITEM_ID: TARGETED run of the chains that item maps to (its rows cite it, or its "
                            "ledger text names a chain/row), recorded against it; refused if nothing maps. "
                            "MOD=ITEM_ID: only the ledger item a run is recorded against (default "
                            "MODCHECK_<MOD>_RUN_1)")
    p_run.add_argument("--chains", default="",
                       help="TARGETED: comma-separated chain names to run (one mod)")
    p_run.add_argument("--rows", default="",
                       help="TARGETED: comma-separated row ids; each row's chain runs as a PREFIX and stops after its "
                            "last requested row, the tail recorded NOT_RUN (one mod)")
    p_run.add_argument("--preview", action="store_true",
                       help="TARGETED: print the per-chain plan (requested -> prerequisites -> executed -> skipped) "
                            "and stop: no mod-list swap, no game")
    p_run.add_argument("--full", action="store_true",
                       help="the whole suite: a scheduled sweep, at most daily (owner 2026-10-25). A run with no "
                            "--chains/--rows/--item ITEM_ID is refused without it")
    # focused_testing_plan option B (all opt-in; without them a run behaves exactly as before)
    p_run.add_argument("--reuse", choices=("off", "report", "on"), default=None,
                       help="external-driver rows with no result at the current mod hash: 'report' (the default when "
                            "unset) tags a result whose runtime+test manifest and DLL still match as reusable@<file> "
                            "and leaves the row UNMEASURED; 'on' takes its status as reused@<file> (never fresh_green); "
                            "'off' does not look (sets MODCHECK_REUSE, modcheck/reuse.py)")
    p_run.add_argument("--drivers", choices=("on", "off"), default=None,
                       help="'on': before the chains, run the suite's external live drivers (suite.live_drivers, e.g. "
                            "FlowWorks northstar/thirst_live.py) whose chains are selected, so their rows are measured at "
                            "this mod hash; the SteveDesktop worker passes it (sets MODCHECK_RUN_DRIVERS, modcheck/drivers.py)")
    p_run.add_argument("--purpose", choices=("fix", "guard", "sweep", "sensitivity", "flake", "commission"),
                       default=None,
                       help="why this run happens (plan 2026-10-25 section 3): fix/guard let the known-good gate skip a "
                            "chain whose recorded PASS still holds; sweep/sensitivity/flake/commission run everything "
                            "and only report would_skip. Default: sweep with --full, guard otherwise "
                            "(sets MODCHECK_PURPOSE, modcheck/gate.py)")
    p_run.add_argument("--gate", choices=("on", "shadow", "off"), default=None,
                       help="the known-good gate: 'on' (default) skips per --purpose, 'shadow' never skips but "
                            "records would_skip, 'off' computes nothing (sets MODCHECK_GATE)")
    p_run.add_argument("--canary", action="store_true",
                       help="run the vanilla canary (Steel spawn/read-back/destroy, a live colonist, Playing) before "
                            "the first chain; red -> every chain records one UNMEASURED HARNESS row, no body runs")
    p_run.add_argument("--validity", action="store_true",
                       help="arm the validity checks (menu drop, colonist count 0, hostile arrival): a FAIL they "
                            "explain becomes UNMEASURED/invalid with the FAIL kept as a lead, no finding")
    p_run.add_argument("--changed", default=None, metavar="RANGE|WORKTREE",
                       help="print the chains a change (git range plus uncommitted files; WORKTREE = uncommitted "
                            "only) SUGGESTS, and stop: nothing runs from a suggestion (one mod)")
    p_run.add_argument("--seat", default=None,
                       help="ledger seat for the run's verify/findings when RIMFLOW_SEAT/AGENT_SEAT do not reach "
                            "this process (Windows python.exe); with none the run is still recorded, ledger skipped")
    p_run.add_argument("--debug", action="store_true")
    p_run.add_argument("--situational", action="store_true",
                       help="wrap every chain in the situational envelope: bland map, python-enforced "
                            "tick budget, detector sweeps, evidence+screenshot on any surprise")
    p_run.add_argument("--policy", choices=["abort", "record"], default="abort",
                       help="what a surprise does: abort the component (UNMEASURED) or just record it")
    p_run.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true",
                       help="exercise the orchestration with no game, no "
                            "subprocess side effects (selftest-shaped)")

    p_status = sub.add_parser("status")
    p_status.add_argument("mod", nargs="?")

    p_decl = sub.add_parser("declare")
    p_decl.add_argument("mod")
    p_decl.add_argument("severity", choices=["minor"])
    p_decl.add_argument("--why", required=True)

    p_ren = sub.add_parser("rename-key", help="move a registry entry from an old "
                                              "mod key to its new name")
    p_ren.add_argument("old")
    p_ren.add_argument("new")
    p_ren.add_argument("--why", required=True)

    p_forget = sub.add_parser("forget-key", help="delete a registry entry outright "
                                                 "-- for an orphaned key with no "
                                                 "successor worth preserving")
    p_forget.add_argument("key")
    p_forget.add_argument("--why", required=True)

    p_val = sub.add_parser("validate", help="record the owner's validation of a "
                                            "mod's `## north star` checklist")
    p_val.add_argument("mod")
    p_val.add_argument("--owner-said",
                       help="his verbatim words. Required to WRITE; omit to "
                            "print the lines that would bind and change nothing")

    p_rev = sub.add_parser("review", help="record that the owner reviewed a "

    p_rev.add_argument("--owner-said")
    p_rev.add_argument("--per-ruling", help="with --why: a Conductor instruction "

    p_rev.add_argument("--why", help="the Conductor's text; alone it grants nothing")
    p_rev.add_argument("--run-id", help="defaults to the mod's last recorded run")

    p_rec = sub.add_parser("record", help="record a functional script's live result "
                                          "(no ModsConfig swap) -- refuses stale/off-tier runs")
    p_rec.add_argument("mod")

    p_rec.add_argument("--tier", default=None,
                       help="modset_builder tier the run must have been on "

    p_rec.add_argument("--extensions", default=None,
                       help="step 4's result JSON (northstar/extension_proof.py --live), for a mod that "
