#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""selftest_peaceful_landing.py -- GRAVSHIP_PEACEFUL_SETTLEMENT_LANDING_1 (offline half).

Owner, 2026-10-02: "We need a way for gravship to land properly in settlement and not be seen as attacking."

A buyer-pit site (the Hutt slave pit first) is a trading post. Vanilla 1.6 decides "attack or visit" from data on the
site's SitePartDefs, in four places (read from the decompiled 1.6 Assembly-CSharp; anchors below):

  GravshipUtility.ArriveNewMap            attack iff parent is Settlement, or a Site whose parts ALL say
                                          considerEnteringAsAttack, and the parent's faction is someone else's
  CaravanArrivalAction_VisitSite.DoEnter  AffectRelationsOnAttacked iff ANY part says considerEnteringAsAttack
  TransportersArrivalAction_VisitSite     attack iff faction is someone else's and the MAIN part says it
  Site.PostMapGenerate                    detection-raid countdown unless a part disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart
                                          or the map was spawned by a gravship landing
  Site.GravShipCanLandOn                  MainSitePartDef.gravShipsCanLandOn and no map yet

This test ports those predicates, evaluates them on every SitePartDef that carries RM_BuyerPitSiteExtension, checks the
quest node only ever hands such a site to a faction that is not hostile, and plants breaks that must go red. When the
decompile is on disk its source lines are matched against the ported expressions, so a game update that changes them
fails here instead of passing on a stale port.

Not covered (prior art, GravTide Docs/vanilla-traps.md): a full faction SETTLEMENT has no peaceful path in vanilla --
ArriveNewMap always attacks one, and a loaded settlement map with no hostile on it is destroyed by
SettlementDefeatUtility.CheckDefeated. The Hutt test site is a Site, so neither applies.

    python3 src/RimMandrake/KeelHoist/selftest_peaceful_landing.py
    python3 src/RimMandrake/KeelHoist/selftest_peaceful_landing.py --live   # A1: the RUNNING game loaded the fields;
                                       one read-only jawa/get_defs; exit 0 holds, 1 the game says otherwise, 2 UNMEASURED
"""
import copy
import glob
import os
import re
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SRC = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", ".."))
PIT_CS = os.path.join(HERE, "Source", "RM_PitBuyer.cs")
EXT = "RimMandrake.KeelHoist.RM_BuyerPitSiteExtension"
DECOMP = os.environ.get("RM_DECOMP_1_6", "/mnt/d/ClaudeWork/rimmandrake/SOORRAK_LOOP/full")
ANCHORS = [   # (file under the decompile, text that must appear verbatim) -- the expressions ported below
    ("RimWorld/GravshipUtility.cs", "(orGenerateMap.Parent is Settlement || (orGenerateMap.Parent is Site site2 && "
     "site2.parts.All((SitePart part) => part.def.considerEnteringAsAttack))) && orGenerateMap.Parent.Faction != null "
     "&& orGenerateMap.Parent.Faction != Faction.OfPlayer"),
    ("RimWorld.Planet/CaravanArrivalAction_VisitSite.cs",
     "if (site.parts.Any((SitePart part) => part.def.considerEnteringAsAttack))"),
    ("RimWorld.Planet/TransportersArrivalAction_VisitSite.cs",
     "if (site.Faction != null && site.Faction != Faction.OfPlayer && site.MainSitePartDef.considerEnteringAsAttack)"),
    ("RimWorld.Planet/Site.cs", "if (!parts.Any((SitePart p) => p.def.disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart) && "
     "!map.wasSpawnedViaGravShipLanding)"),
    ("RimWorld.Planet/Site.cs", "if (MainSitePartDef.gravShipsCanLandOn)"),
    ("RimWorld/SitePartDef.cs", "public bool considerEnteringAsAttack = true;"),
    ("RimWorld/SitePartDef.cs", "public bool disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart;"),
    ("RimWorld/SitePartDef.cs", "public bool gravShipsCanLandOn;"),
]
DEFAULTS = {"considerEnteringAsAttack": True, "disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart": False, "gravShipsCanLandOn": False}
FAILS = []


def check(name, cond, detail=""):
    print("%s  %s %s" % ("ok  " if cond else "FAIL", name, "" if cond else detail))
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(name)


def _bool(node, field):
    el = node.find(field)
    if el is None or el.text is None:
        return DEFAULTS[field]
    t = el.text.strip().lower()
    if t not in ("true", "false"):
        raise ValueError("%s/%s is not a bool: %r" % (node.findtext("defName"), field, el.text))
    return t == "true"


def part_fields(node):
    return {f: _bool(node, f) for f in DEFAULTS}


def buyer_pit_parts():
    """-> {defName: (path, SitePartDef element)} for every SitePartDef in src/ carrying the buyer-pit extension."""
    out = {}
    for path in glob.glob(os.path.join(SRC, "**", "*.xml"), recursive=True):
        try:
            root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
        except ET.ParseError:
            continue
        for d in root.iter("SitePartDef"):
            if any(li.get("Class") == EXT for li in d.iter("li")):
                out[d.findtext("defName")] = (path, d)
    return out


# ---- vanilla 1.6 predicates, ported (parts = list of field dicts; parts[0] is the main part) ----
def gravship_entry_is_attack(parts, parent_is_settlement, faction, player="player"):
    hit = parent_is_settlement or all(p["considerEnteringAsAttack"] for p in parts)
    return hit and faction is not None and faction != player


def caravan_entry_is_attack(parts):
    return any(p["considerEnteringAsAttack"] for p in parts)


def transporters_entry_is_attack(parts, faction, player="player"):
    return faction is not None and faction != player and parts[0]["considerEnteringAsAttack"]


def detection_countdown_starts(parts, via_gravship_landing):
    return not any(p["disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart"] for p in parts) and not via_gravship_landing


def gravship_can_land(parts, has_map=False):
    return parts[0]["gravShipsCanLandOn"] and not has_map


def peaceful_findings(parts):
    """Every way the site would be treated as hostile on entry; [] is a trading post."""
    f = []
    if not gravship_can_land(parts):
        f.append("gravship cannot land")
    if gravship_entry_is_attack(parts, False, "keepers"):
        f.append("gravship landing is an attack")
    if caravan_entry_is_attack(parts):
        f.append("caravan entry is an attack")
    if transporters_entry_is_attack(parts, "keepers"):
        f.append("transport pods are an attack")
    for via in (True, False):
        if detection_countdown_starts(parts, via):
            f.append("detection raid countdown starts (%s)" % ("gravship" if via else "caravan"))
    return f


def faction_findings(cs):
    """The quest node must hand the site only to a faction that is not hostile to the player."""
    m = re.search(r"private static Faction FactionFor\(SitePartDef def\)\s*\{(.*?)\n        \}", cs, re.S)
    if not m:
        return ["FactionFor not found"]
    body, f = m.group(1), []
    if "!f.HostileTo(Faction.OfPlayer)" not in body:
        f.append("FactionFor may pick a hostile faction")
    if "SiteMaker.MakeSite(def, tile, faction)" not in cs:
        f.append("site is not made with FactionFor's faction")
    return f


def live(timeout=60):
    """A1: the running game's RUT_HuttSlavePit carries the shipped values (a MayRequire-gated def can silently not load)."""
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(SRC, "RimMandrake", "Utils"))
    import live_def_check as L
    want = {"considerEnteringAsAttack": False, "disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart": True, "gravShipsCanLandOn": True}
    reply, why = L._bridge("jawa/get_defs", {"defs": "SitePartDef/RUT_HuttSlavePit", "fields": ",".join(want)}, timeout)
    if reply is None:
        print("UNMEASURED: " + why)
        return 2
    recs = [d for d in (reply.get("defs") or []) if isinstance(d, dict)] if isinstance(reply, dict) else []
    if len(recs) != 1 or not isinstance(recs[0].get("found"), bool):
        print("UNMEASURED: not one get_defs record: %r" % (reply,))
        return 2
    d = recs[0]
    if d["found"] is not True:
        running = L.call_running_mods(timeout)
        if running is None or "mandrake.rm.keelhoist" not in running:
            print("UNMEASURED: RUT_HuttSlavePit not loaded and mandrake.rm.keelhoist is not in the running load (%s)"
                  % ("unread" if running is None else "%d mods" % len(running)))
            return 2
        print("FAIL: mandrake.rm.keelhoist is running but SitePartDef/RUT_HuttSlavePit did not resolve")
        return 1
    if not isinstance(d.get("fields"), dict):
        print("UNMEASURED: record has no fields map: %r" % (d,))
        return 2
    got = {k: str(d["fields"].get(k)).strip().lower() for k in want}
    bad = {k: got[k] for k, v in want.items() if got[k] != str(v).lower()}
    print(("FAIL: " if bad else "PASS: ") + "RUT_HuttSlavePit live fields %r" % got)
    return 1 if bad else 0


def main():
    # anchors: the port is only as good as its match to the game's code
    if os.path.isdir(DECOMP):
        for rel, text in ANCHORS:
            p = os.path.join(DECOMP, rel)
            body = open(p, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").read() if os.path.exists(p) else ""
            check("decompile anchor %s: %s" % (rel, text[:48]), text in body, "not found in " + p)
    else:
        print("note  decompile not on disk (%s): anchors UNMEASURED, ported predicates trusted as committed" % DECOMP)

    # the predicates themselves, on vanilla defaults (a SitePartDef that says nothing is a raid target)
    dflt = [dict(DEFAULTS)]
    check("sanity: a default site part is an attack every way and gets a raid countdown by caravan",
          gravship_entry_is_attack(dflt, False, "x") and caravan_entry_is_attack(dflt)
          and transporters_entry_is_attack(dflt, "x") and detection_countdown_starts(dflt, False))
    check("sanity: a Settlement is an attack even when every part says no",
          gravship_entry_is_attack([dict(DEFAULTS, considerEnteringAsAttack=False)], True, "x"))
    check("sanity: own or factionless site is never an attack by gravship",
          not gravship_entry_is_attack(dflt, False, "player") and not gravship_entry_is_attack(dflt, False, None))

    parts = buyer_pit_parts()
    check("sanity: RUT_HuttSlavePit is found among buyer-pit site parts", "RUT_HuttSlavePit" in parts, sorted(parts))
    for name, (path, node) in sorted(parts.items()):
        fl = peaceful_findings([part_fields(node)])
        check("%s (%s): landing, caravan and pods are visits, no detection raid" % (name, os.path.relpath(path, SRC)),
              fl == [], fl)
        # planted breaks, on a copy (never the shipped file)
        for field, bad, must in (("considerEnteringAsAttack", "true", "gravship landing is an attack"),
                                 ("disallowsAutomaticDetectionTimerStart", "false", "detection raid countdown starts (caravan)"),
                                 ("gravShipsCanLandOn", "false", "gravship cannot land")):
            n2 = copy.deepcopy(node)
            el = n2.find(field)
            if el is None:
                el = ET.SubElement(n2, field)
            el.text = bad
            got = peaceful_findings([part_fields(n2)])
            check("break %s: %s=%s -> %s" % (name, field, bad, must), must in got, got)
        n3 = copy.deepcopy(node)
        n3.remove(n3.find("considerEnteringAsAttack"))
        check("break %s: considerEnteringAsAttack removed (vanilla default true) -> attack" % name,
              "gravship landing is an attack" in peaceful_findings([part_fields(n3)]))
        # a second, default part on the same site: gravship needs ALL to say attack, caravan needs ANY
        two = [part_fields(node), dict(DEFAULTS)]
        check("%s + a default part: gravship stays a visit, caravan turns attack (vanilla All vs Any)" % name,
              not gravship_entry_is_attack(two, False, "keepers") and caravan_entry_is_attack(two))

    cs = open(PIT_CS, encoding="utf-8").read()
    check("quest node gives the site only a non-hostile faction", faction_findings(cs) == [], faction_findings(cs))
    check("break: FactionFor drops the hostility filter -> red",
          "FactionFor may pick a hostile faction" in faction_findings(cs.replace(" && !f.HostileTo(Faction.OfPlayer)", "")))

    print("\n%s: %d failure(s)" % ("FAIL" if FAILS else "PASS", len(FAILS)))
    return 1 if FAILS else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(live() if "--live" in sys.argv[1:] else main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""live_kit_art.py - live clause A2 of GELATINOUSSLIME_KIT_ART_1: a Slime map draws no tortoise and no dandelion.

    python3 src/RimMandrake/GelatinousSlime/live_kit_art.py             # WSL: stages a Slime map, re-runs under python.exe
    python3 src/RimMandrake/GelatinousSlime/live_kit_art.py --current   # read the CURRENT map only (must be Slime)
    python.exe ...\\live_kit_art.py --inner --out <json> [--current]    # the bridge half (Windows side)

Staging (default): a FRESH scratch vanilla quicktest world, a 2-ring land patch re-tiled to RM_GelatinousSlime with the
Slime's measured tile values (design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/the_slime.md §0: temp median 13.4 C, elevation median 3 m,
flat, dry), centre mutators stripped, colony_found + world_tile_map_generate, then the map made current. Recipe:
Utils/modcheck/biome_site.py, as LeaningScrub/northstar/wildlife_mapgen_live.py uses it. Never Ash'karr, never a world a
player receives (CLAUDE.md worldgen ban); nothing is saved. Before 2026-11-03 this read whatever map was current, and the
live tier left a Rot map up: two runs measured nothing.

On that map (read only: jawa/map_info, jawa/thing_graphic, jawa/thing_explain):
  * every thing (one thing_graphic rect read, complete list required) has no graphicPath, resolvedPath or variant path
    naming Tortoise or Dandelion (defName included), and no RM_ non-pawn thing draws BadTex;
  * at least one kit plant (slime grass, bellows, thumbstalk or readerbloom) is present, so the read is not blind;
  * every pawn on the map (thing_graphic cannot see pawn art: Thing.Graphic is BadTexture for EVERY pawn) has
    thing_explain appearance rows, each texPath held by a running pack and none naming Tortoise or Dandelion.
Exit 0 holds, 1 a stand-in is drawn, 2 UNMEASURED (no bridge, wrong load, wrong map, truncated read, nothing of ours).
Callers hold the bridge lock; this never takes it.
"""
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import types

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
UTILS = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(HERE, "..", "Utils"))
MODCHECK = os.path.join(UTILS, "modcheck")
SCRATCH = "/mnt/d/ClaudeWork/rimmandrake/scratch/slime_kit_art"
TIMEOUT = 530
FORBIDDEN = ("tortoise", "dandelion")
KIT_PLANTS = {"RM_Plant_SlimeGrass", "RM_Plant_Bellows", "RM_Plant_Thumbstalk", "RM_Plant_Readerbloom"}
BIOME = "RM_GelatinousSlime"
SPEC = types.SimpleNamespace(       # the fields biome_site.choose_tile / retile read
    BIOME=BIOME, LAT_MAX=45.0, MAP_SIZE=120,
    TILE={"temperature": 13.4, "rainfall": 0.0, "elevation": 3.0, "hilliness": "Flat", "swampiness": 0.0})


def strings(o):
    if isinstance(o, str):
        yield o
    elif isinstance(o, dict):
        for v in o.values():
            yield from strings(v)
    elif isinstance(o, list):
        for v in o:
            yield from strings(v)


def is_pawn(t):
    """thing_graphic's thingClass names a Pawn (Verse.Pawn or a subclass named ...Pawn)."""
    return str(t.get("thingClass") or "").split(".")[-1].endswith("Pawn")


def judge(things, explain):
    """(fails, kit, explained pawn ids, unread pawns) from a complete thing_graphic list; explain(id) -> thing_explain.

    A pawn is NOT judged by thing_graphic's badTex: that tool reads Thing.Graphic, which for every Pawn is the ThingDef's
    null graphicData, i.e. UI/Misc/BadTexture whatever the art (live, 2026-11-03: all four pawns on a Slime map). Pawns
    draw through PawnRenderer from the life-stage graphic, so each pawn of ours (and any pawn whose defName names a
    stand-in) is judged by thing_explain's appearance rows: every row's texPath held by at least one running pack (the
    ContentFinder lookup the renderer makes; held by none = the renderer draws BadTex) and no path naming a stand-in."""
    fails = []
    for t in things:
        hits = [s for s in strings({k: t.get(k) for k in ("defName", "graphicPath", "resolvedPath", "variantPath",
                                                           "variantPaths", "textureName")})
                if any(w in s.lower() for w in FORBIDDEN)]
        if hits:
            fails.append(f"{t.get('defName')} {t.get('id')} draws {hits[0]}")
        if str(t.get("defName", "")).startswith("RM_") and t.get("badTex") and not is_pawn(t):
            fails.append(f"{t.get('defName')} {t.get('id')} draws BadTex")
    kit = sorted({t.get("defName") for t in things} & KIT_PLANTS)
    pawns = [t for t in things if is_pawn(t) or t.get("defName") == "RM_Gelatid"]
    blind = []
    for t in pawns:
        pid, name = t.get("id"), t.get("defName")
        ex = explain(pid) or {}
        app = ex.get("appearance") or {}
        rows = app.get("paths") if isinstance(app, dict) else None
        if ex.get("success") is False or not rows:   # an unread appearance of OURS never counts as clean
            if not str(name or "").startswith("RM_"):
                continue   # a colonist or vanilla visitor: its defName was already screened above
            blind.append(f"{name} {pid} appearance unread: {str(ex)[:150]}")
            continue
        for r in rows:
            tp = str(r.get("texPath") or "")
            if any(w in tp.lower() for w in FORBIDDEN):
                fails.append(f"{name} {pid} appearance names {tp}")
            elif not r.get("packsHoldingPath"):
                fails.append(f"{name} {pid} {r.get('role')} path {tp or '(none)'} is held by no running pack: draws BadTex")
    return fails, kit, [t.get("id") for t in pawns], blind


def verdict(things, fails, kit, gels, blind=()):
    lines = [f"map things read {len(things)}; kit plants present {kit}; pawns explained {len(gels)}"]
    lines += ["FAIL " + f for f in fails]
    if fails:
        return 1, lines
    if blind:
        return 2, lines + ["UNMEASURED: " + b for b in blind]
    if not kit:
        return 2, lines + ["UNMEASURED: no kit plant on the map; the read cannot speak for the kit"]
    return 0, lines + ["HOLDS"]


def stage(s, rec, work):
    import biome_site as B
    NS = B.pyre()
    mods, retired = B.running_retired(s.call)
    lack = B.missing_dlc(mods)
    if retired or lack:
        raise B.SiteError("UNMEASURED: wrong load (retired %s, DLC missing %s)" % (retired, lack))
    rec["world"] = NS.fresh_quicktest_world(s)
    rec["colonyTile"] = s.call("jawa/map_info").get("tile")
    rec["pick"] = B.choose_tile(s, SPEC, work, rec["colonyTile"])
    centre = rec["pick"]["centre"]
    rec["retiled"] = B.retile(s, SPEC, rec["pick"]["patch"])
    NS.strip_mutators(s, centre)
    g = NS.generate(s, centre, SPEC.MAP_SIZE)
    rec["mapId"] = g["mapId"]
    s.call("jawa/set_current_map", mapId=g["mapId"])


def inner(out_path, current):
    for p in (MODCHECK, UTILS):
        if p not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, p)
    from northstar_driver.session import FastSession
    rec = {"item": "GELATINOUSSLIME_KIT_ART_1", "clause": "A2", "staged": not current,
           "utc": time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())}
    rc, lines = 2, ["UNMEASURED: did not reach the read"]
    try:
        with FastSession(strict=False, focus=False) as s:   # never focus the game (live-tier rule)
            if not current:
                stage(s, rec, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(out_path), "slime_kit_art_site"))
            mi = s.call("jawa/map_info")
            rec["map"] = {k: mi.get(k) for k in ("mapId", "mapBiome", "tile", "sizeX", "sizeZ")}
            if mi.get("mapBiome") != BIOME or (rec.get("mapId") is not None and mi.get("mapId") != rec["mapId"]):
                raise RuntimeError("UNMEASURED: current map %s biome %s is not the %s map %s" % (
                    mi.get("mapId"), mi.get("mapBiome"), BIOME, rec.get("mapId")))
            g = s.call("jawa/thing_graphic", rect="0,0,1000,1000", limit=100000)
            if not g.get("success") or not g.get("isCompleteList"):
                raise RuntimeError("UNMEASURED: thing_graphic success=%s complete=%s" % (
                    g.get("success"), g.get("isCompleteList")))
            things = g.get("things") or []
            fails, kit, gels, blind = judge(things, lambda gid: s.call("jawa/thing_explain", id=gid))
            rc, lines = verdict(things, fails, kit, gels, blind)
            rec.update({"things": len(things), "kit": kit, "pawns": len(gels), "fails": fails, "blind": blind})
    except Exception as ex:   # every failure is UNMEASURED with its reason on disk, never a silent pass
        msg = str(ex)[:400]
        if rc != 1:
            rc, lines = 2, [msg if msg.startswith("UNMEASURED") else "UNMEASURED: %s: %s" % (type(ex).__name__, msg)]
    rec["rc"], rec["lines"] = rc, lines
    with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(rec, fh, indent=1, sort_keys=True, default=str)
    print("\n".join(lines))
    return rc


def win(path):
    out = subprocess.run(["wslpath", "-w", path], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20).stdout.strip()
    if not out:
        raise SystemExit("wslpath gave nothing for %s" % path)
    return out


def outer(current):
    os.makedirs(SCRATCH, exist_ok=True)
    out = os.path.join(SCRATCH, "a2_%d_%d.json" % (os.getpid(), time.time_ns()))
    argv = ["python.exe", win(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "--inner", "--out", win(out)] + (["--current"] if current else [])
    print("$ " + " ".join(argv), flush=True)
    try:
        rc = subprocess.run(argv, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=TIMEOUT).returncode
    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as ex:
        print("UNMEASURED: bridge half did not finish: %s" % ex)
        return 2
    if not os.path.exists(out):
        print("UNMEASURED: the bridge half wrote no %s (exit %d)" % (out, rc))
        return 2
    with open(out, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        rec = json.load(fh)
    print("evidence: %s" % out)
    return rec.get("rc", 2) if rc in (0, 1, 2) and rc == rec.get("rc") else 2


def main(argv):
    current = "--current" in argv
    if "--inner" in argv:
        out = argv[argv.index("--out") + 1] if "--out" in argv else os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "slime_kit_art_a2.json")
        return inner(out, current)
    return outer(current)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""LEANINGSCRUB_SWEETLINE_SHED_LIVE_1 live clause A1: a mature sweetline tree sheds its felt once its timer has passed.

The item's repro, standalone (no suite, no site): on a Playing map it lays Soil over a 13x13 pad off the map centre,
clears its plants/items/filth, plants ONE RM_SweetlineTree at growth 1, reads the tree's inspect timer line, jumps the
clock +5.5 days (past the 5-day timer and its <=5-day first-shed stagger; jawa/time_set_ticks, timeException=true),
steps 2100 real ticks (one Long tick: Plant.TickLong -> CompTickLong), then reads the felt (RM_SweetlineWool, stacks
summed) round the tree, the tree's inspect line again and the log for 'Exception ticking'. The tree and the felt are
destroyed after (the soil stays: a disposable quicktest map).
  exit 0  the tree stands, >= woolCount (5) more felt within the pad, the timer line reset to "falls in" (it ran), no
          'Exception ticking' line in the log
  exit 1  any of that fails; the line printed says which half broke (the timer line still 'ready to fall' = the
          comp never ran its shed; reset but no felt = the felt went somewhere the count does not see; tree gone = it
          died across the jump)
  exit 2  no map / bridge down / the tree did not stand or showed no station line before the jump: UNMEASURED
History: LIVE 2026-10-07 two runs shed 0 (tree then carried the bark-warden harvest seam, cut 2026-10-23); the suite row
sweetline.station_sheds_wool PASSED 2026-10-23 (FOUNDRY scrub_ns2.json at 18669c79a5c8). This re-proves it on the build
of today.
Usage: python3 src/RimMandrake/LeaningScrub/sweetline_shed_probe.py
"""
import os
import re
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
MODCHECK = os.path.join(HERE, "..", "Utils", "modcheck")
sys.path.insert(0, MODCHECK)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(MODCHECK, ".."))

TREE, FELT, SOIL = "RM_SweetlineTree", "RM_SweetlineWool", "Soil"
WOOL_COUNT = 5                  # RM_SweetlineTree.xml woolCount
JUMP = int(5.5 * 60000)         # past woolIntervalDays 5 and the first-shed stagger Rand.Range(0, 5 days)
STEP = 2100                     # one Long tick (2000) and a margin
HALF = 6                        # 13x13 pad; GenPlace Near lands within a few cells of the trunk
TIMER = re.compile(r"Loose .*(falls in|ready to fall)")


def judge(before, after, moved, standing, lines_after, errors):
    """-> (ok, reasons). The verdict alone, so the selftest can prove it rejects each broken half."""
    bad = []
    text = " ".join(lines_after or [])
    if not standing:
        bad.append("tree gone after the wait (died across the jump)")
    if moved is None or moved < STEP - 100:
        bad.append("clock moved %s < %d after the jump: no Long tick guaranteed" % (moved, STEP - 100))
    shed = (after or 0) - (before or 0)
    if shed < WOOL_COUNT:
        bad.append("shed %d felt (want >= %d)" % (shed, WOOL_COUNT))
    if standing:
        if "ready to fall" in text:
            bad.append("timer still 'ready to fall': CompTickLong never ran its shed")
        elif "falls in" not in text:
            bad.append("no timer line after the wait: %r" % (lines_after,))
    if errors:
        bad.append("'Exception ticking' in the log: %s" % (errors[0][:300],))
    return not bad, bad


def _felt(c, rect):
    r = c.call("jawa/list_things", {"defName": FELT, "rect": rect, "limit": 500})
    if not isinstance(r, dict) or r.get("success") is False:
        return None
    return sum(int(w.get("stackCount") or 1) for w in (r.get("things") or []))


def _tree(c, x, z):
    r = c.call("jawa/list_things", {"defName": TREE, "rect": "%d,%d,1,1" % (x, z), "limit": 5})
    rows = (r or {}).get("things") or [] if isinstance(r, dict) else []
    return rows[0]["id"] if rows else None


def _inspect(c, tid):
    r = c.call("jawa/inspect_string", {"thingIds": tid})
    rows = (r or {}).get("things") or [] if isinstance(r, dict) else []
    return list(rows[0].get("inspect") or []) if rows and not rows[0].get("error") else []


def _tick_errors(c):
    """(total repeats, newest text) of 'Exception ticking' error lines in the log buffer (it is never drained, and an
    already-capped Verse.Log is blind to new lines: instrument_traps)."""
    lg = c.call("jawa/drain_log", {"limit": 500, "errorsOnly": True, "contains": "Exception ticking"})
    rows = (lg or {}).get("messages") or [] if isinstance(lg, dict) else []
    return sum(int(m.get("repeats") or 1) for m in rows), (str(rows[-1].get("text")) if rows else None)


def _ticks(c):
    try:
        return (c.call("rimworld/get_game_info", {}) or {}).get("ticksGame")
    except Exception:                                           # noqa: BLE001
        return None


class _Session(object):
    def __init__(self, client):
        self.c = client

    def call(self, tool, **p):
        return self.c.call(tool, p)


def main():
    import clockgate  # noqa: E402
    import helpers as H  # noqa: E402
    import rimbridge_client as rb  # noqa: E402
    h, p, tok = rb.resolve_endpoint()
    c = rb.RimBridge(host=h, port=p, token=tok, timeout=120.0)
    try:
        c.connect()
    except Exception as e:                                      # noqa: BLE001
        print("UNMEASURED bridge unreachable: %s" % e)
        return 2
    probe = c.call("jawa/get_terrain_batch", {"rects": "0,0,1,1"})
    size = (probe or {}).get("mapSize") if isinstance(probe, dict) else None
    if not size:
        print("UNMEASURED no map loaded: %r" % (probe,))
        return 2
    x, z = int(size["x"]) // 2 + 30, int(size["z"]) // 2 + 30   # off the colony's centre
    pad = "%d,%d,%d,%d" % (x - HALF, z - HALF, 2 * HALF + 1, 2 * HALF + 1)
    c.call("jawa/destroy_batch", {"rects": pad, "categories": "Plant,Item,Filth"})
    c.call("jawa/set_terrain_batch", {"ops": "%s:%s" % (SOIL, pad), "layer": "top"})
    c.call("jawa/set_plants", {"ops": "%s:%d,%d,1,1" % (TREE, x, z), "growth": 1.0})
    tid = _tree(c, x, z)
    if not tid:
        print("UNMEASURED the sweetline tree did not stand at %d,%d after set_plants" % (x, z))
        return 2
    try:
        lines0 = _inspect(c, tid)
        if not TIMER.search(" ".join(lines0)):
            print("UNMEASURED no station timer line before the jump (stations off? not mature?): %r" % (lines0,))
            return 2
        before = _felt(c, pad)
        cur = _ticks(c)
        if before is None or cur is None:
            print("UNMEASURED felt count or clock unreadable before the jump")
            return 2
        err0, _ = _tick_errors(c)                               # jawa/drain_log never drains: count, then compare
        r = c.call("jawa/time_set_ticks", {"ticks": int(cur + JUMP), "timeException": True,
                                           "why": "LEANINGSCRUB_SWEETLINE_SHED_LIVE_1 probe: past the 5-day shed timer"})
        if not (isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("success")):
            print("UNMEASURED time_set_ticks refused: %r" % (r,))
            return 2
        start = now = _ticks(c)
        if start is None:
            print("UNMEASURED clock unreadable after the jump")
            return 2
        s = _Session(c)
        for _ in range(8):                                      # bounded: a stalled clock is the harness, not the tree
            if now is None or now - start >= STEP:
                break
            try:
                clockgate.advance_chunk(s, min(STEP - (now - start), 2000), time_exception=True)
            except Exception as e:                              # noqa: BLE001 - a vitals stop is not the tree's verdict
                print("UNMEASURED the clock was stopped after the jump: %s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, str(e)[:300]))
                return 2
            now = _ticks(c)
        moved = None if now is None else now - start
        if moved is None or moved < STEP - 100:
            print("UNMEASURED the clock moved %s of %d ticks after the jump (stalled or unreadable)" % (moved, STEP))
            return 2
        after = _felt(c, pad)
        standing = _tree(c, x, z) == tid
        lines1 = _inspect(c, tid) if standing else ["<tree gone>"]
        err1, last = _tick_errors(c)
        errors = [last or "?"] if (err1 or 0) > (err0 or 0) else []
        print("tree %s at %d,%d; felt before=%s after=%s; clock +%s after the +%d jump; inspect before %r after %r; "
              "Exception ticking lines=%d" % (tid, x, z, before, after, moved, JUMP, lines0, lines1, len(errors)))
        ok, bad = judge(before, after, moved, standing, lines1, errors)
        for b in bad:
            print("FAIL  " + b)
        return 0 if ok else 1
    finally:
        c.call("jawa/destroy_batch", {"rects": pad, "categories": "Plant,Item"})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""northstar_full.py -- Graffiti's FULL-LIST rung in one command (GRAFFITI_NORTHSTAR_GREEN_FULL_1).

WSL python3, repo root as cwd, the game freshly launched on the owner's full list (FULL.LATEST) and the bridge
held by the caller. It never launches, stops or swaps anything, and never touches ModsConfig.xml:

  python3 src/RimMandrake/Graffiti/northstar_full.py [--list <ModsConfig>] [--no-quicktest] [--no-judge]
  python3 src/RimMandrake/Graffiti/northstar_full.py --check <results.json>      # offline verdict only

  1 a FRESH quicktest map (bridgetools/prove_quicktest_world.py, python.exe) -- never the minimal session's map;
  2 northstar_driver `run --config full` (python.exe): pre-flight refuses unless the RUNNING list
    (jawa/running_mods = RunningModsListForReading) equals --list in ids and order; the site is the suite's own;
    foreign SacredGraffiti / GraffitiImperial marks land in doc["compat"], never in Graffiti's bars;
    doc["full_list_differences"] lists pool members, cleaning mods and camera mods;
  3 judge_cli.py (the visual half, claude -p);
  4 the verdict below, then the run is recorded in modcheck status with config `full`.

Exit 0 = every clause holds (GREEN on the full list); 1 = ran, not green; 2 = could not run a step.

--tier small (PROOF_TIERS_WIDEN_SMALL_LIST_FIRST_ALWAYS, owner 2026-11-02: "small mod lists should always be the way to
test until a final verification pass on the whole huge mod list"): the same suite on WHATEVER game is up, as long as it
holds Graffiti and its dependencies (northstar_driver `needs-mods --mod Graffiti`, exit 2 when it does not). The run is
`--config current`; the verdict drops only the full-list clauses (config `full`, pre-flight running_list, the
full_list_differences section, a compat row per foreign member that a small list does not load). Every Graffiti bar,
the judge, partial/refused and compat-apart stay. The default `--tier full` is the FINAL verification (GREEN-FULL).

The verdict (full_rung_verdict) holds only when ALL of: the doc is Graffiti's and config is `full`; pre-flight
`running_list` PASS; the run was not refused and is not partial; it was judged; every row in bars[] (each north-star
bar and each functional row) is PASS and every bar of Graffiti's VALIDATED walk (read from the walk, never from the
doc) is present and PASS; compat rows are reported apart (none in bars[], one per foreign member in compat[]); and
the differences section has its lists, at least one full-only id, and no unclassified (not installed) id.
The results file must be new: an existing --out refuses, so an old GREEN can never be re-read as this run's.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE)))
DRIVER = os.path.join(ROOT, "src", "RimMandrake", "Utils", "northstar_driver")
PLAN = "src/RimMandrake/Graffiti/northstar_plan.py"
MOD = "Graffiti"


def authoritative_expected():
    """Graffiti's bar ids from its VALIDATED walk, read here -- never from the document being judged."""
    sys.path.insert(0, DRIVER)
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(DRIVER))
    import cli
    return cli.expected_bars(MOD)


def compat_ids_required():
    """The compat row every foreign member must leave (its status is irrelevant to Graffiti's verdict)."""
    for d in (HERE, os.path.dirname(DRIVER)):
        if d not in sys.path:
            sys.path.insert(0, d)
    import validation
    return {"spree_wall.compat_%s_marks" % pid.rsplit(".", 1)[-1] for pid in validation.FOREIGN_DEFS}


def full_rung_verdict(doc, expected=None, compat_required=None, tier="full"):
    """(ok, [reasons it is not]) for a judged results doc. `expected` / `compat_required` default to the
    authoritative sources (the walk; validation.FOREIGN_DEFS); tests pass their own. tier "small" judges a
    `--config current` run on any list holding Graffiti: the full-list-only clauses are not asked."""
    full = tier == "full"
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(DRIVER))
    from northstar_driver import bars as B
    from northstar_driver import PASS
    why = []
    if expected is None:
        expected, src = authoritative_expected()
        if not expected:
            why.append("no authoritative expected bars (%s)" % src)
    if compat_required is None:
        compat_required = compat_ids_required() if full else ()
    if doc.get("mod") != MOD:
        why.append("results are for %r, not %s" % (doc.get("mod"), MOD))
    want = "full" if full else "current"
    if doc.get("config") != want:
        why.append("config is %r, not %r" % (doc.get("config"), want))
    pre = {c.get("name"): c for c in doc.get("preflight") or []}
    rl = pre.get("running_list")
    if full and (not rl or rl.get("status") != PASS):
        why.append("pre-flight running_list %s" % ("absent" if not rl else "%s: %s" % (rl.get("status"),
                                                                                      str(rl.get("evidence"))[:200])))
    if doc.get("refused"):
        why.append("refused: %s" % str(doc["refused"])[:200])
    if doc.get("partial", True):
        why.append("partial (or unmarked) results")
    if not doc.get("judge"):
        why.append("not judged (judge_cli.py never ran on it)")
    rows = doc.get("bars") or []
    bad = [(r.get("id"), r.get("status")) for r in rows if r.get("status") != PASS]
    if bad:
        why.append("%d row(s) not PASS: %s" % (len(bad), bad[:12]))
    if expected and (not rows or not B.all_green(rows, expected)):
        have = {r.get("id") for r in rows if r.get("status") == PASS}
        why.append("authoritative bars missing or not PASS: %s" % [e for e in expected if e not in have][:12])
    if any(r.get("compat") or str(r.get("id", "")).split(".")[-1].startswith("compat_") for r in rows):
        why.append("a compat row sits in bars[] (must be reported apart)")
    compat = doc.get("compat")
    if not isinstance(compat, list):
        why.append("no compat section")
    else:
        miss = sorted(set(compat_required) - {r.get("id") for r in compat if isinstance(r, dict)})
        if miss:
            why.append("compat rows missing: %s" % miss)
    d = doc.get("full_list_differences")
    if not full:
        pass
    elif not isinstance(d, dict) or d.get("error"):
        why.append("full_list_differences missing or broken: %s" % (str(d)[:200],))
    else:
        bad = [k for k in ("pool_members", "cleaning", "camera", "full_only", "not_installed")
               if not isinstance(d.get(k), list)]
        if bad:
            why.append("full_list_differences lacks list(s): %s" % bad)
        elif not d["full_only"]:
            why.append("full_list_differences saw no full-only mod (a full list always has some): blind scan")
        elif d["not_installed"]:
            why.append("full_list_differences could not classify %d full-only id(s) (not installed): %s"
                       % (len(d["not_installed"]), d["not_installed"][:8]))
    return not why, why


def _run(argv, timeout):
    """(rc, output). A timeout or a failed launch is rc 2 with what output there was -- never an exception."""
    try:
        p = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
                           encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as ex:
        part = ex.stdout or ""
        part = part.decode("utf-8", "replace") if isinstance(part, bytes) else part
        return 2, "TIMEOUT after %d s\n%s" % (timeout, part)
    except OSError as ex:
        return 2, "could not start %s: %s" % (argv[0], ex)
    return p.returncode, (p.stdout or "") + (p.stderr or "")


def win_path(p):
    """A path python.exe can open: repo-relative stays relative (cwd is the repo); an absolute WSL path goes
    through `wslpath -w`."""
    if not os.path.isabs(p):
        return p
    rc, out = _run(["wslpath", "-w", p], 30)
    if rc != 0 or not out.strip():
        raise SystemExit("cannot convert %s for python.exe: %s" % (p, out.strip()))
    return out.strip()


def _record(doc, out, ok):
    sys.path.insert(0, DRIVER)
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(DRIVER))
    import cli
    mod_dir, now = cli.mod_hash_now(MOD)
    doc = dict(doc, all_green=bool(ok))
    _entry, msg = cli.record_result(doc, MOD, out, doc.get("mod_hash") or now, mod_dir)
    return msg


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)

            det = dict(det, mock=st)
            st = "SKIP"
        rows.append({"id": rid, "status": st, "class": cls, "detail": det})
        print("%-26s %-10s %-8s %s" % (rid, st, cls, json.dumps(det, default=str)[:300]), flush=True)
        save()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers (every reply reaches V.PRE through the guard)
    def dproof(method, arg, answer=False):
        """One RM_DrawbridgeProofs read. A refused static_call (the class not loaded), a REFUSED answer or a reply with no
        key=value is a HARNESS fault of the open scope, unless `answer=True` ('LEAF none' is a measurement)."""
        return _static(DPROOF, method, arg, answer)

    def sproof(method, arg, answer=False):
        return _static(SPROOF, method, ";".join(pid_num(t) for t in str(arg).split(";")), answer)

    def _static(ty, method, arg, answer):
        r = B.call("jawa/static_call", type=ty, method=method, args=arg) or {}
        txt = str(r.get("result") or r.get("message") or r.get("error") or "")
        V.require(not txt.startswith("REFUSED"), "%s accepted its args" % method, txt[:200], cls="HARNESS")
        kv = parse(txt) if r.get("success") is True and not txt.startswith("REFUSED") else {}
        if not answer:
            V.require(kv, "%s answered" % method, txt[:200], cls="HARNESS")
        return kv, txt

    def typed(ty, method, args):
        """A production static read with typed args ('current|x,z'): the result text, or None when it could not be asked."""
        r = B.call("jawa/static_call", type=ty, method=method, args=args) or {}
        if r.get("success") is not True:
            V.require(False, "%s.%s answered" % (ty.rsplit(".", 1)[-1], method), str(r)[:200], cls="HARNESS")
            return None
        return str(r.get("result"))

    def counters():
        out_ = {}
        for ty, f in COUNTERS:
            r = B.call("jawa/mod_settings_field", typeName=ty, action="get", field=f) or {}
            try:
                out_[f] = int(r.get("value"))
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                out_[f] = None
                V.require(False, "counter %s read" % f, str(r)[:160], cls="HARNESS")
        return out_

    def delta(c0, c1, f):
        return None if c0.get(f) is None or c1.get(f) is None else c1[f] - c0[f]

    @contextlib.contextmanager
    def setting(field, value):
        """An RM_DrawbridgeSettings field set and read back for the block; the prior value goes back whatever the block did."""
        r0 = B.call("jawa/mod_settings_field", typeName=DBS, action="get", field=field) or {}
        r = B.call("jawa/mod_settings_field", typeName=DBS, action="set", field=field, value=str(value)) or {}
        V.require(str(r.get("valueAfter")) == str(value) or _float_eq(r.get("valueAfter"), value), "%s set to %s" % (field, value), r)
        try:
            yield
        finally:
            if r0.get("value") is not None:
                B.call("jawa/mod_settings_field", typeName=DBS, action="set", field=field, value=str(r0["value"]), _answer=True)

    def dig(c, n=DEEP):
        return B.call("jawa/flowworks_excavation_drive", x=c[0], z=c[1], deepenLevels=n, setFill=-1) or {}

    def spawn(c, kind="Colonist", faction="player", draft=False):
        r = B.call("jawa/spawn_pawn", kindDef=kind, x=c[0], z=c[1], faction=faction, count=1) or {}
        pid = ((r.get("pawns") or [{}])[0]).get("id")
        if pid and draft:
            B.call("jawa/set_draft", pawnId=pid, drafted=True)
        return pid

    def walls(cells):
        if cells:
            B.call("jawa/spawn_batch", ops=";".join("Wall:%d,%d" % c for c in cells), stuff="BlocksGranite")

    def pawns():
        return {p.get("id"): p for p in (B.call("jawa/list_pawns", limit=400, includeHealth=True) or {}).get("pawns") or []}

    def at(p):
        return (p.get("x"), p.get("z")) if p else (None, None)

    def ticks(n):
        r = B.call("rimworld/step_game_ticks", ticks=n, pauseFirst=True, timeoutMs=max(60000, n * 40)) or {}
        V.require(r.get("success") is not False, "the clock moved %d ticks" % n, r, cls="HARNESS")
        return r

    def build(scene, a_, b_, tier, hinge="A"):
        kv, txt = dproof("ProofMakeDrawbridge", "%s;%s;%s;%s;winch" % (xz(a_), xz(b_), tier, hinge))
        V.require(kv.get("ok") == "True", "%s drawbridge built" % scene, txt)
        return kv, txt

    def leaf(c):
        kv, txt = dproof("ProofLeaf", xz(c))
        return kv, txt

    def power(c, on):
        kv, txt = dproof("ProofWinchPower", "%s;%s" % (xz(c), "on" if on else "off"))
        V.require(kv.get("powered") == str(bool(on)), "winch power %s" % ("on" if on else "off"), txt)
        return kv

    fac_cache = []

    def faction():
        """A hostile humanlike faction def, read from spawn_pawn's refusal of faction '?' (it lists `available`; nothing
        spawns). raid_trench_proof's recipe. Not found: a fault of the open scope (SITE), 'Pirate' tried anyway."""
        if not fac_cache:
            probe = B.call("jawa/spawn_pawn", kindDef="Mercenary_Gunner", x=0, z=0, faction="?", count=1, _answer=True) or {}
            avail = (probe.get("details") or {}).get("available") or []
            fac = next((f_["def"] for f_ in avail if f_.get("hostile") and str(f_.get("def")).startswith("Pirate")),
                       next((f_["def"] for f_ in avail if f_.get("hostile") and f_.get("def") not in ("Entities", "Mechanoid", "Insect")),
                            None))
            if fac is None:
                V.require(False, "a hostile humanlike faction to spawn", str(probe)[:200])
                return "Pirate"
            fac_cache.append(fac)
        return fac_cache[0]

    def assault(cells, kind="Mercenary_Gunner", sappers=False, breachers=False, mining=None):
        fac = faction()
        ids = [spawn(c, kind=kind, faction=fac) for c in cells]
        ids = [i for i in ids if i]
        if mining is not None and not a.mock:
            for i in ids:           # set BEFORE the lord: LordToil_AssaultColonySappers picks its sappers at UpdateAllDuties
                # raw 20: a xenotype's aptitude can pull the effective level far down (live: raw 10 read effective 2)
                B.call("jawa/set_pawn_skill", pawn=i, skill="Mining", level=mining, _answer=True)   # refused: mining disabled by backstory
                has = (B.call("jawa/static_call", type="RimWorld.SappersUtility", method="HasBuildingDestroyerWeapon",
                              args=i, _answer=True) or {}).get("result")
                if str(has) != "True":    # GrenadeDestructive can roll molotovs, which are no building destroyer
                    B.call("jawa/pawn_gear", pawn=i, action="clear", clearWhat="equipment")
                    B.call("jawa/pawn_gear", pawn=i, action="equip", **{"def": "Weapon_GrenadeFrag"})
        if ids:
            kw = {}
            if sappers:
                kw["sappers"] = True        # LordJob_AssaultColony(sappers) -> LordToil_AssaultColonySappers -> DutyDef Sapper
            if breachers:
                kw["breachers"] = True      # -> LordToil_AssaultColonyBreaching -> DutyDef Breaching
            B.call("jawa/lord_assault_spawn", pawns=",".join(str(i) for i in ids), **kw)
        return ids

    ox, oz = (int(v) for v in a.origin.split(","))
    P = lambda dx, dz: (ox + dx, oz + dz)        # noqa: E731
    xz = lambda c: "%d,%d" % c                   # noqa: E731

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ preflight
    if a.fresh_map and not a.mock:
        B.call("rimworld/go_to_main_menu")
        B.call("rimworld/start_debug_game_ready", readiness="mapData", pauseIfNeeded=True, timeoutMs=280000)
    ok = True if a.mock else V._wait_playing(B, leave_s=0)[0]
    if not ok:
        for rid in only:
            row(rid, "UNMEASURED", {"why": "no game in Playing"}, cls="HARNESS")
        return 2
    # the owed C# first: one question, answered or not. Missing, nothing is staged and every row names what is owed.
    probe = B.call("jawa/static_call", type=DPROOF, method="ProofLeaf", args="-1,-1", _answer=True) or {}
    if probe.get("success") is not True:
        res["owedWhy"] = str(probe.get("error") or probe.get("message") or probe)[:300]
        for rid in only:
            row(rid, "UNMEASURED", {"why": "%s is not in the loaded FlowWorks (%s): deploy a FlowWorks built with it"
                                           % (DPROOF, res["owedWhy"][:120]), "owedProofs": sorted(OWED_PROOFS)}, cls="HARNESS")
        res["finished"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
        save()
        print("drawbridge proof: %s missing -> every row UNMEASURED/HARNESS -> %s" % (DPROOF, out))
        return 2
    if not a.mock:
        rect = (max(ox - 4, 1), max(oz - 2, 1), 50, 90)
        res["site_calm"] = V.site_calm(B)   # TESTENV_PREFLIGHT_HARDEN_TRISPIKE_AT_ARM: map-gen hostiles/hives stop safe_advance at arm
        B.call("jawa/kill_hostiles")
        B.call("jawa/static_call", type="RimMandrake.FlowWorks.RM_NorthstarProofs", method="ProofResetRect",
               args="%d;%d;%d;%d" % rect)
        # 2026-11-03 (DRAWBRIDGE_WINCH_DIAGNOSE_UNLINKED_REBUILT): a full-list quicktest map carried 5000 RM_HugeTrunkBlocker
        # cells, and prepare_site cannot clear them (Huge Things re-plans a blocker while its giant stands) -> SITE UNMEASURED.
        res["hugePlantsCleared"] = V.clear_huge_plants(B)
        site_rows = []
        with V.scope("site"):
            V.prepare_site(B, rect, site_rows, "drawbridge_site")
        bad = [r for r in site_rows if r.get("status") not in (None, "PASS")]
        if bad:
            for rid in only:
                row(rid, "UNMEASURED", {"why": "site not prepared", "rect": rect, "site": bad[:3]}, cls="SITE")
            return 2
        B.call("rimworld/set_god_mode", enabled=True)

    ctx = dict(faction=faction, a=a, B=B, P=P, xz=xz, row=row, dproof=dproof, sproof=sproof, typed=typed, counters=counters, delta=delta,
               setting=setting, dig=dig, spawn=spawn, walls=walls, pawns=pawns, at=at, ticks=ticks, build=build, leaf=leaf,
               power=power, assault=assault, ox=ox, oz=oz, res=res, save=save)
    for rid in ROW_IDS:                 # SAVE_MIDRAISE is last in ROW_IDS: its load replaces the map
        if rid in only:
            print("== row %s" % rid, flush=True)
            with V.scope(rid):
                SCENES[rid](ctx)
    res["finished"] = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S")
    save()
    if a.mock:
        bad = [r["id"] for r in rows if r["detail"].get("mock") != "PASS"]
        print("MOCK: drawbridge proof: %d rows, mock verdicts not PASS: %s -> %s" % (len(rows), bad or "none", out))
        return 1 if any(r["detail"].get("mock") == "FAIL" for r in rows) else (2 if bad else 0)
    fails = [r for r in rows if r["status"] == "FAIL"]
    unm = [r for r in rows if r["status"] != "PASS"]
    print("drawbridge proof: %d rows, %d FAIL, %d not PASS -> %s" % (len(rows), len(fails), len(unm), out))
    return 1 if fails else (2 if unm else 0)


def _float_eq(x, y):
    try:
        return abs(float(x) - float(y)) < 1e-6
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False


def _c(ctx, *ks):
    return [ctx[k] for k in ks]


def plot_vanish_ids(pawns, o, keep=()):
    """(ids to vanish, ids kept) for a raid variant's sweep of the origin plot (o = its x,z corner, 50x90, 2-cell margin).
    Every living pawn standing in the plot goes, except `keep`: the previous variant's island colonists, whose own teardown
    already destroyed their winch (so no leaf can crash on them) and who may be the map's last colonists. Vanishing them
    left zero colonists and the vitals governor stopped the run on colony_loss (testq J20261026T153314Z-bbef21)."""
    keep = set(k for k in keep if k)
    gone, kept = [], []
    for i, p in pawns.items():
        px, pz = p.get("x"), p.get("z")
        if (px is None or pz is None or p.get("dead") or not (o[0] - 2 <= px < o[0] + 52)
                or not (o[1] - 2 <= pz < o[1] + 92)):
            continue
        (kept if i in keep else gone).append(i)
    return gone, kept


# ====================================================================== the rows
def raise_path(ctx):
    """PROVE ProofPath (production path finder) for a colonist from bank A to bank B before and right after a raise.
    EXPECT before: found, >= 6 decked squares; after (10 ticks): no decked square on the path, RaisedAt true, ToggleCount and
    RepathCount each rose. LIES: a path cached before the toggle (1.6 batched jobs) read as fresh; a walker that never held
    a path cannot be re-pathed, so RepathCount must rise for a pawn that was ordered across first."""
    B, P, xz, row, sproof, dproof, typed, ticks, spawn = _c(ctx, "B", "P", "xz", "row", "sproof", "dproof", "typed", "ticks", "spawn")
    for i in range(1, 7):
        ctx["dig"](P(i, 6))
    ctx["walls"]([P(x, z) for x in range(-2, 10) for z in (5, 7)])
    ctx["build"]("B", P(0, 6), P(7, 6), "steel")
    ctx["power"](P(3, 6), True)
    walker = spawn(P(-1, 6), draft=True)
    kv0, t0 = sproof("ProofPath", "%s;%s" % (walker, xz(P(8, 6))))
    V.require(kv0.get("found") == "True" and num(kv0, "decked", 0) >= 6, "lowered: the deck is the path", t0)
    c0 = ctx["counters"]()
    # holds a path now. The walker is meant to be mid-walk, so the tool's success=false ("0/1 standing on ...") is the expected
    # answer, not a refusal (live 2026-10-21 it UNMEASURED the row); the bar is that the order was taken
    ordr = B.call("jawa/order_pawn", _answer=True, pawnId=walker, x=P(8, 6)[0], z=P(8, 6)[1], waitTicks=1, draft=True)
    V.require(all((p or {}).get("orderAccepted") for p in (ordr.get("pawns") or [{}])), "walker took the order", ordr, cls="HARNESS")
    dproof("ProofDevSet", "%s;raise" % xz(P(3, 6)))
    ticks(10)
    raised = typed(DB, "RaisedAt", "current|%s" % xz(P(3, 6)))
    kv1, t1 = sproof("ProofPath", "%s;%s" % (walker, xz(P(8, 6))), answer=True)
    c1 = ctx["counters"]()
    tog, rep = ctx["delta"](c0, c1, "ToggleCount"), ctx["delta"](c0, c1, "RepathCount")
    V.require(raised is not None and tog is not None and rep is not None, "raise state and counters read", [raised, tog, rep],
              cls="HARNESS")
    good = raised == "True" and (kv1.get("found") == "False" or num(kv1, "decked", 1) == 0) and (tog or 0) >= 1 and (rep or 0) >= 1
    row("RAISE_PATH", "PASS" if good else "FAIL", {"before": t0, "after": t1, "raisedAt": raised, "toggles": tog, "repaths": rep})


def raise_tips_riders(ctx):
    """PROVE six hostile riders on a 3-wide steel leaf, the hinge bank walled to ONE free square (ProofTipPreview reads it),
    raised by ProofDevSet; positions from list_pawns 10 ticks later.
    EXPECT TippedCount +land and FellCount +fall (the preview's split); that many riders on the hinge bank (x <= 0), the rest on dug
    leaf squares, all six still hostile. LIES: a free square the tip rule cannot use (behind the anchor) leaves 0 landers and reads FAIL: the
    preview's free=1 is the precondition, so a site the mod rightly refuses is SITE, not MOD."""
    P, xz, row, dproof, ticks, spawn = _c(ctx, "P", "xz", "row", "dproof", "ticks", "spawn")
    for z in (24, 25, 26):
        for i in range(1, 5):
            ctx["dig"](P(i, z))
    kvb, _tb = ctx["build"]("E", P(0, 24), P(5, 26), "steel")
    ctx["power"](P(2, 25), True)
    # never wall over the winch house (live 2026-10-21: the bank walls replaced it, leaving winch=False powered=False and a
    # frozen leaf that tipped nobody: SITE, not the tip rule)
    winch = {tuple(int(v) for v in w.split(",")) for w in str(kvb.get("winchAt") or "").split("|") if "," in w}
    bank = [P(x, z) for x in range(-4, 0) for z in range(22, 29) if (x, z) != (-1, 25) and P(x, z) not in winch]
    ctx["walls"](bank + [P(x, z) for x in range(0, 6) for z in (23, 27)])
    riders = [spawn(P(i, z), kind="Mercenary_Gunner", faction=_hostile(ctx)) for i, z in ((1, 24), (1, 25), (1, 26), (2, 24),
                                                                                         (2, 25), (2, 26))]
    V.require(all(riders), "six riders spawned", riders)
    kvp, tp = dproof("ProofTipPreview", xz(P(2, 25)))
    # live 2026-10-21: the mod's preview reads free=4 land=4 fall=2 here (the hinge bank's own deck-end squares x=0 count as
    # landing ground beside the walled-in (-1,25)), so the bar follows the preview's land/fall split instead of a fixed 1/5
    V.require(num(kvp, "riders") == 6 and num(kvp, "free", 0) >= 1, "preview: six riders, a free bank square", tp)
    land, fall = num(kvp, "land", -1), num(kvp, "fall", -1)
    c0 = ctx["counters"]()
    _dv, tdev = dproof("ProofDevSet", "%s;raise" % xz(P(2, 25)))
    ticks(10)
    _kl, tleaf = ctx["leaf"](P(2, 25))
    ps = ctx["pawns"]()
    c1 = ctx["counters"]()
    tipped, fell = ctx["delta"](c0, c1, "TippedCount"), ctx["delta"](c0, c1, "FellCount")
    V.require(all(r in ps for r in riders if r), "every rider in the read", [r for r in riders if r not in ps], cls="HARNESS")
    cells = [ctx["at"](ps.get(r)) for r in riders]
    on_bank = sum(1 for c in cells if c[0] is not None and c[0] <= P(0, 0)[0])
    in_hole = sum(1 for c in cells if c[0] is not None and P(1, 0)[0] <= c[0] <= P(4, 0)[0] and P(0, 24)[1] <= c[1] <= P(0, 26)[1])
    still = sum(1 for r in riders if (ps.get(r) or {}).get("hostile"))
    good = land >= 1 and tipped == land and fell == fall and on_bank == land and in_hole == fall and still == 6
    row("RAISE_TIPS_RIDERS", "PASS" if good else "FAIL",
        {"preview": tp, "devSet": tdev, "leafAfter": tleaf, "tipped": tipped, "fell": fell, "onBank": on_bank, "inHole": in_hole,
         "stillHostile": still, "cells": cells})


def _hostile(ctx):
    return ctx["faction"]()


def raise_spares_underpass(ctx):
    """PROVE a colonist put UNDER the deck (floor band, RM_SuspensionProofs.ProofPutUnder) and a drafted rider on it; raise.
    EXPECT the under-pawn's cell and hediffs unchanged and ProofBand still reads it below; the rider tipped to bank A.
    LIES: a pawn never put under (ProofPutUnder under=False) is untouched trivially: that is a SITE precondition."""
    P, xz, row, dproof, sproof, ticks, spawn = _c(ctx, "P", "xz", "row", "dproof", "sproof", "ticks", "spawn")
    for i in range(1, 5):
        ctx["dig"](P(i, 32))
    ctx["build"]("F", P(0, 32), P(5, 32), "steel")
    ctx["power"](P(2, 32), True)
    under = spawn(P(1, 32), draft=True)
    put, tput = sproof("ProofPutUnder", "%s;%s" % (under, xz(P(2, 32))))
    V.require(put.get("under") == "True", "pawn stands under the deck", tput)
    rider = spawn(P(3, 32), draft=True)
    ps0 = ctx["pawns"]()
    c0 = ctx["counters"]()
    dproof("ProofDevSet", "%s;raise" % xz(P(2, 32)))
    ctx["ticks"](10)
    ps1 = ctx["pawns"]()
    c1 = ctx["counters"]()
    kvb, tb = sproof("ProofBand", under, answer=True)
    V.require(kvb, "ProofBand answered (an empty read would pass 'view != deck' vacuously)", tb, cls="HARNESS")
    u0, u1 = ps0.get(under) or {}, ps1.get(under) or {}
    V.require(_health(u0) is not None and _health(u1) is not None, "pawn health read", "no health block", cls="HARNESS")
    same = ctx["at"](u0) == ctx["at"](u1) and len(_health(u1) or []) == len(_health(u0) or [])
    rider_at = ctx["at"](ps1.get(rider))
    tipped = ctx["delta"](c0, c1, "TippedCount")
    good = same and kvb.get("view") != "deck" and tipped == 1 and rider_at[0] is not None and rider_at[0] <= P(0, 0)[0]
    row("RAISE_SPARES_UNDERPASS", "PASS" if good else "FAIL",
        {"underBefore": ctx["at"](u0), "underAfter": ctx["at"](u1), "band": tb, "riderAt": rider_at, "tipped": tipped})


def lower_only_from_winch(ctx):
    """PROVE the production WorkGiver asked per pawn (ProofWorkJob), a colonist on the winch bank A and one on the far bank B.
    EXPECT lowered leaf + raise order: far-bank pawn gets a job (raise from either side); raised leaf + lower order: far-bank
    pawn gets none, winch-bank pawn gets one. LIES: the far pawn refused for reach alone would also read 'none' (detail
    keeps why=); a winch pawn that gets no lower job at all (no order seen) would make the far 'none' vacuous, so the winch
    pawn's job is part of the bar."""
    P, xz, row, dproof, spawn = _c(ctx, "P", "xz", "row", "dproof", "spawn")
    for i in range(1, 5):
        ctx["dig"](P(i, 0))
    # a corridor walled edge to edge (z=-1/z=1 x=-2..9, capped at x=-3/x=10): the far bank reaches the winch side ONLY over the leaf
    ctx["walls"]([P(x, z) for x in range(-2, 10) for z in (-1, 1)] + [P(-3, 0), P(10, 0)])
    ctx["build"]("A", P(0, 0), P(5, 0), "timber")
    # HARNESS (live 2026-10-22): the 1.6 pathfinder's grid data catch up with walls/depth/deck changes only when the map
    # TICKS. Staged and read while paused, FindPathNow walked the far pawn straight along the trench floor (found=True
    # cells=10) through walls it could not yet see; 10 ticks later the same read was found=False. Tick after every
    # walkability change before any path or job read.
    ctx["ticks"](10)
    w = spawn(P(-2, 0))
    f = spawn(P(7, 0))
    dproof("ProofOrder", "%s;raise" % xz(P(2, 0)))
    fr, tfr = dproof("ProofWorkJob", "%s;%s" % (pid_num(f), xz(P(2, 0))))
    dproof("ProofDevSet", "%s;raise;instant" % xz(P(2, 0)))
    ctx["ticks"](10)
    kl, tl = ctx["leaf"](P(2, 0))
    V.require(kl.get("target") == "raised" and num(kl, "progress", -1) == num(kl, "full", -2), "leaf staged raised", tl)
    # precondition (SITE, never a mod FAIL): with the leaf raised the far-bank pawn has no path to the winch side, else the real
    # scanner may rightly hand it the lower job by walking round and the 'none' below proves nothing
    # both cells the winch (P(-1,0)) is worked from: (-2,0) behind it AND (0,0), the hinge-bank lip. Live 2026-10-21 only
    # (-2,0) was asked; it read found=False while the production WorkGiver still found the winch reachable. RULED OUT
    # (WINCH_REACH_DIAGNOSE_CANREACH_FIBS, 2026-10-21): the far pawn does NOT reach the lip by the trench floor - A* refuses
    # that route too (lip found=False). The yes comes from pawn.CanReach = vanilla regions (walls, no depth) AND the depth-only
    # pocket grid (depth, no walls): the walls join the banks round the trench's ends for the pocket grid, and the regions walk
    # the trench floor, so each projection says yes on its own route and the AND is not the joint graph. A MOD finding.
    kvp, tp = ctx["sproof"]("ProofPath", "%s;%s" % (f, xz(P(-2, 0))), answer=True)

def _hostile_locks(ctx):
    P, xz, row, dproof, typed, ticks, spawn = _c(ctx, "P", "xz", "row", "dproof", "typed", "ticks", "spawn")
    B = ctx["B"]
    for i in range(1, 5):
        ctx["dig"](P(i, 44))
    for c in ((10, 44), (11, 44), (10, 45), (11, 45)):
        ctx["dig"](P(*c))
    ctx["build"]("H", P(0, 44), P(5, 44), "steel")
    ctx["power"](P(2, 44), True)
    with V.scope("HOSTILE_LOCKS_a") as sa:
        ctx["assault"]([P(25, 44)])
        free0 = typed(DB, "FreeHostileCount", "current|true")
        V.require(free0 not in (None, "0"), "a free hostile locks the map", free0)
        dproof("ProofOrder", "%s;raise;now" % xz(P(2, 44)))
        ticks(500)
        k1, t1 = ctx["leaf"](P(2, 44))
        V.require(k1.get("target") == "raised" and k1.get("hold") == "False", "raised under lock, not held", t1)
        B.call("jawa/kill_hostiles")
        ticks(70)
        k2, t2 = ctx["leaf"](P(2, 44))
        V.require(k2.get("auto") == "True" and k2.get("target") == "lowered", "peace: auto-lower under way", t2)
        ctx["assault"]([P(25, 44)])
        ticks(70)
        k3, t3 = ctx["leaf"](P(2, 44))
        cancelled = k3.get("auto") == "False" and k3.get("target") == "raised"
    with V.scope("HOSTILE_LOCKS_b") as sb:
        B.call("jawa/kill_hostiles")
        trapped = spawn(P(10, 44), kind="Mercenary_Gunner", faction=_hostile(ctx))
        ticks(5)
        it = typed(TRAP, "IsTrapped", pid_num(trapped)) if trapped else None
        V.require(it == "True", "the hostile is trapped in the pit", it)
        free1 = typed(DB, "FreeHostileCount", "current|true")
        locked = typed(DB, "Locked", "current")
        trapped_ok = free1 == "0" and locked == "False"
    V.adopt(sa, sb)
    good = cancelled and trapped_ok
    row("HOSTILE_LOCKS", "PASS" if good else "FAIL",
        {"freeBefore": free0, "raisedLocked": t1, "autoLowering": t2, "afterRaid": t3, "trappedFree": free1, "locked": locked})

def _raid_variant(ctx, rid, sappers, dx=30):
    B, P, xz, dproof, ticks, spawn = _c(ctx, "B", "P", "xz", "dproof", "ticks", "spawn")
    c = P(dx, 70)       # the sapper variant stages 90 cells west of the assault island so one run holds both without sharing ground
    B.call("jawa/kill_hostiles")        # an earlier row's raiders must not join this one's fight
    # SITE (live 2026-10-22): the preflight prepares only the origin rect; the sapper island (dx=-60) sat on unprepared ground and
    # its steel bridge was refused ("must end on solid, undug ground"). Each variant prepares its own island + approach.
    rect = (c[0] - 8, c[1] - 8, 40, 17)
    if not ctx["a"].mock:
        # SITE (live 2026-10-22, full run): the earlier rows' bridges and winches stand in the origin plot, reachable, and the
        # assault gunners trashed them instead of facing the moat. Clear every building in the plot before this island is built.
        o = P(-4, -2)
        # HARNESS (BENCH belt 2026-10-22): the PM run's RAID_UP stopped in this prep's reveal on 'hurt: Cut/Head' with no
        # hostile on the map. Destroying the earlier rows' winches CRASHES any leaf still raised (WINCH_LOST_CRASHES is the
        # mod doing its job) onto whoever stands in the plot. The earlier rows' pawns leave the plot before its buildings go.
        # HARNESS (testq J20261026T153314Z-bbef21, SteveDesktop 2026-10-26): the sapper variant's sweep vanished the assault
        # variant's two island colonists, the last colonists on the fresh map; the vitals governor's colony_loss stopped
        # safe_advance in this prep (rc 1), the driver died mid-row and modcheck's canary read 'no live colonist'. It raced the
        # 60-tick census, so the same run had passed. The previous variant's island colonists stay (plot_vanish_ids).
        gone, kept = plot_vanish_ids(ctx["pawns"](), o, ctx.get("raid_island_colonists") or ())
        for i in gone:
            B.call("jawa/pawn_force_incapacitate", pawn=i, action="vanish")
        V.SITE_NOTES.append({"id": "raid_%s_plot_pawns_vanished" % rid, "detail": gone, "kept": kept})
        B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,50,90" % o, categories="Building")
        B.call("jawa/static_call", type="RimMandrake.FlowWorks.RM_NorthstarProofs", method="ProofResetRect",
               args="%d;%d;%d;%d" % rect)
        site_rows = []
        V.prepare_site(B, rect, site_rows, "raid_%s_site" % rid)
        bad = [r for r in site_rows if r.get("status") not in (None, "PASS")]
        V.require(not bad, "%s island site prepared" % rid, bad[:3], cls="SITE")
    ring = [(x, z) for x in range(c[0] - 6, c[0] + 7) for z in range(c[1] - 6, c[1] + 7) if max(abs(x - c[0]), abs(z - c[1])) >= 5]
    for cell in ring:
        ctx["dig"](cell, 4)
    ctx["build"]("K", (c[0] + 4, c[1]), (c[0] + 7, c[1]), "steel")
    ctx["power"]((c[0] + 5, c[1]), True)
    B.call("jawa/spawn_batch", ops="Sandbags:%d,%d" % (c[0] + 14, c[1] + 4), stuff="BlocksGranite")
    # the island colonists: closed granite box (x c-3..c, z c-2..c+2), pawns inside, NOT drafted
    box = [(x, z) for x in range(c[0] - 3, c[0] + 1) for z in range(c[1] - 2, c[1] + 3)
           if x in (c[0] - 3, c[0]) or z in (c[1] - 2, c[1] + 2)]
    ctx["walls"](box)
    inside = [spawn((c[0] - 2 + k, c[1]), draft=False) for k in range(2)]
    ctx["raid_island_colonists"] = [i for i in inside if i]
    # an island with no colonist would vanish the map's last ones below: that is colony_loss, not a raid reading
    V.require(ctx["a"].mock or ctx["raid_island_colonists"], "%s island colonists spawned" % rid, inside, cls="HARNESS")
    if not ctx["a"].mock:
        # SITE (live 2026-10-22): with the island hidden, the gunners walked 60+ cells to the start colonists and chased a wild
        # animal (enemyTarget Human / RM_Ssurr), so 'nobody enters the trench' measured the map, not the duty. Every pawn that
        # is not this island's colonist leaves the map (a disposable fresh map; later rows spawn their own pawns).
        for i, p in ctx["pawns"]().items():
            if i not in inside and not p.get("dead") and not p.get("hostile"):
                B.call("jawa/pawn_force_incapacitate", pawn=i, action="vanish")
    ticks(10)       # the 1.6 pathfinder sees the dug ring, the walls and the raised leaf only after the map ticks
    dproof("ProofDevSet", "%s;raise;instant" % xz((c[0] + 5, c[1])))
    c0 = ctx["counters"]()
    spawns = [(c[0] + 25, c[1] + k) for k in range(4)]
    if sappers:
        # HARNESS (live 2026-10-22): LordToil_AssaultColonySappers gives the Sapper duty only to IsGoodSapper pawns (kindDef
        # canBeSapper + a building-destroyer weapon + Mining >= 4), else Escort, and with none at all EVERY pawn gets plain
        # AssaultColony. Mercenary_Gunner has no canBeSapper, so the old 'sapper' variant was an assault in disguise and the
        # winch giver (Sapper/Breaching duties only) never ran: WinchJobs 0 while ProofDecision showed the moat uncrossable.
        ids = ctx["assault"](spawns, kind="Grenadier_Destructive", sappers=True, mining=20)
        good = [i for i in ids if ctx["a"].mock or str((B.call("jawa/static_call", type="RimWorld.SappersUtility",
                                                                method="IsGoodSapper", args=i, _answer=True) or {}).get("result")) == "True"]
        V.require(ctx["a"].mock or good, "at least one raider IsGoodSapper (gets the Sapper duty)", good, cls="SITE")
    else:
        ids = ctx["assault"](spawns, sappers=False)
    V.require(len(ids) == 4, "four raiders spawned in an assault", ids)
    plank_to = None
    if not sappers:
        # a plank in the pack, as the real raid hands one out; the duty (not a forced job) decides what to do with it
        g = B.call("jawa/pawn_gear", pawn=ids[0], action="inventory", **{"def": "RM_RaidPlank"}) or {}
        V.require(g.get("success") is not False, "a raider carries a plank", g, cls="HARNESS")
        plank_to = ids[0]
    # contamination: any other colonist (the start colonists, other scenes') near the raiders' start is a legal target
    ps0 = ctx["pawns"]()
    others = sorted(i for i, p in ps0.items() if p.get("kind") == "Colonist" and i not in inside and not p.get("dead")
                    and p.get("x") is not None and max(abs(p["x"] - spawns[0][0]), abs(p["z"] - spawns[0][1])) <= 45)
    # (the offline mock stages every scene on one map, so the other scenes' colonists would always trip this)
    V.require(ctx["a"].mock or not others, "no colonist outside the box within 45 cells of the raiders", others, cls="SITE")
    samples, came_near, reached, jobs_seen, trench_seen, winch_seen = [], set(), set(), {}, set(), set()
    wait_no_target, probed, t = 0, 0, 0
    decisions = {}
    winch_cell = (c[0] + 3, c[1])
    while t < ctx["a"].raid_ticks:
        ticks(250)
        t += 250
        ps = ctx["pawns"]()
        snap = []
        for i in ids:
            p = ps.get(i) or {}
            x, z = p.get("x"), p.get("z")
            # _answer: a raider that has left the map (the lord gave up) is refused as "not spawned" -- a reading, not a fault
            pr = B.call("jawa/attack_target_probe", pawn=i, maxDist=60, _answer=True) or {}
            job, jt, tgt = pr.get("curJob"), pr.get("curJobTargetA"), pr.get("enemyTarget")
            if pr.get("success") is not False and "curJob" in pr:
                probed += 1
            jobs_seen[job] = jobs_seen.get(job, 0) + 1
            if job in TRENCH_JOBS:
                trench_seen.add(i)
            if job in WINCH_ATTACK_JOBS and isinstance(jt, dict) and (jt.get("x"), jt.get("z")) == winch_cell:
                winch_seen.add(i)
            if job == "Wait_Combat" and not tgt and not pr.get("picked"):
                wait_no_target += 1
            snap.append((i, x, z, p.get("dead"), p.get("downed"), job, jt, tgt))
            if t <= 500 and not ctx["a"].mock:
                # what the mod's givers would decide for this raider now (the job alone cannot say WHY the winch giver passed)
                dec = (B.call("jawa/static_call", type="RimMandrake.FlowWorks.RM_RaiderTrench", method="ProofDecision", args=i, _answer=True)
                       or {}).get("result")
                near_w = (B.call("jawa/static_call", type="RimMandrake.FlowWorks.Pits.RM_DrawbridgeRaid",
                                 method="NearestRaisedWinch", args=i, _answer=True) or {}).get("result")
                decisions.setdefault(i, []).append((t, dec, near_w))
            if x is None:
                continue
            d = max(abs(x - c[0]), abs(z - c[1]))
            if d <= 15:
                came_near.add(i)
            if d <= 6 or (abs(x - (c[0] + 14)) <= 1 and abs(z - (c[1] + 4)) <= 1):
                reached.add(i)
        samples.append({"t": t, "raiders": snap})
    c1 = ctx["counters"]()
    V.require(probed > 0, "the job probe answered (jawa/attack_target_probe curJob)", jobs_seen, cls="HARNESS")
    V.require(len(came_near) >= 2, "two raiders came within 15 squares", sorted(came_near))
    ended = ctx["delta"](c0, c1, "HostileJobsEnded")

    else:

    no_loop = ended is not None and ended <= 3 * len(ids)

        ticks(10)       # (its colonists stay: the next variant's prepare_site walks one in, then sends every stranger off)
    return {"ok": bool(progress and no_loop), "variant": rid, "winchJobs": winch_jobs, "planksLaid": planks, "plankCarrier": plank_to,

def one_drag_package(ctx):
    """DRAWBRIDGE_BUILD_ONE_DRAG_DOES_IT_ALL (owner 2026-10-25 "Drawbridges: A: one drag"). PROVE the production steel
    drawbridge button (steel: its powered winch drives alone, a timber one needs a pawn at the crank), ONE drag from bank B's anchor square to bank A's over a 4-square moat (ProofOneDrag: ProofDesignate,
    god so the parts are built at once; no winch is placed by hand), then the gizmo's order (ProofOrder now) and the drive,
    the winch's power forced on (ProofWinchPower).
    EXPECT one leaf hinged on the bank the drag STARTED on (hingeAt = the east anchor square), its winch house
    built on its planned square and linked, one gate; lowered: the production path crosses the deck; raised by the drive:
    the path no longer crosses it; lowered again: it crosses. LIES: a winch linked by adjacency alone also reads linked
    (ProofOneDrag counts only a winch ON plannedWinch); a hinge on the colony bank by luck would match a start on A, so the
    drag starts on the east bank; a path read while paused is stale (1.6 grid catches up on ticks), so tick after each change."""
    P, xz, row, dproof, sproof, spawn, ticks = _c(ctx, "P", "xz", "row", "dproof", "sproof", "spawn", "ticks")
    z = 76
    for i in range(1, 5):
        ctx["dig"](P(i, z))
    # the moat's sides walled (x=1..4 only: the anchor columns x=0/x=5 stay free for the winch on either side)
    # live run6 2026-10-25: with only those 4-cell walls the walker's 12-cell path went AROUND them (decked=0 lowered), so
    # an outer ring at z-2/z+2 from x=-4..10 closes the anchor columns' side cells: the short way over is the deck alone
    # (x=4..6 left open at z-2: a wall beside the winch's planned square P(5,z-1) left it unlinked, linked=0, same run)
    ctx["walls"]([P(x, zz) for x in range(1, 5) for zz in (z - 1, z + 1)]
                 + [P(x, z + 2) for x in range(-4, 11)] + [P(x, z - 2) for x in range(-4, 11) if not 4 <= x <= 6])
    kv, txt = dproof("ProofOneDrag", "%s;%s;steel" % (xz(P(5, z)), xz(P(0, z))))
    V.require(kv.get("ok") == "True", "the one drag placed a drawbridge", txt)
    placed = (kv.get("leaves") == "1" and kv.get("hingeAt") == xz(P(5, z)) and kv.get("winches") == "1" and kv.get("linked") == "1"
              and num(kv, "gates", 0) >= 1)
    if placed:
        ctx["power"](P(2, z), True)
    ticks(10)
    walker = spawn(P(8, z), draft=True)
    down0, td0 = sproof("ProofPath", "%s;%s" % (walker, xz(P(-3, z))), answer=True)
    dproof("ProofOrder", "%s;raise;now" % xz(P(2, z)))
    k0, tk0 = ctx["leaf"](P(2, z))
    full = num(k0, "full", 0) or 0
    V.require(full > 0, "the leaf's full raise time read", tk0, cls="HARNESS")
    ticks(full + 30)
    kup, tup = ctx["leaf"](P(2, z))
    up, tu = sproof("ProofPath", "%s;%s" % (walker, xz(P(-3, z))), answer=True)
    dproof("ProofOrder", "%s;lower;now" % xz(P(2, z)))
    ticks(full + 30)
    kdn, tdn = ctx["leaf"](P(2, z))
    down1, td1 = sproof("ProofPath", "%s;%s" % (walker, xz(P(-3, z))), answer=True)
    crosses = lambda k: k.get("found") == "True" and num(k, "decked", 0) >= 4  # noqa: E731
    raised = kup.get("target") == "raised" and num(kup, "progress", -1) == num(kup, "full", -2)
    lowered = kdn.get("target") == "lowered" and num(kdn, "progress", -1) == 0
    blocked = up.get("found") == "False" or num(up, "decked", 1) == 0
    # DRAWBRIDGE_WINCH_DIAGNOSE_UNLINKED_REBUILT (live run6 2026-10-25: a drawbridge rebuilt on the SAME squares read winches=1
    # linked=0 and never raised): tear the package down (anchors, deck, winch, gate; the moat stays dug) and drag it again at
    # once, well inside the 600-tick prune, so the torn-down record is still listed. EXPECT the rebuilt leaf linked to its
    # winch and raised by it. LIES: a leaf read on the same squares could be the stale one, so the raise is read after the
    # order on the rebuilt package's own centre square.
    B = ctx["B"]
    B.call("jawa/destroy_batch", rects="%d,%d,6,2" % P(0, z - 1), categories="Building")
    ticks(10)
    kv2, txt2 = dproof("ProofOneDrag", "%s;%s;steel" % (xz(P(5, z)), xz(P(0, z))))
    relinked = kv2.get("ok") == "True" and kv2.get("winches") == "1" and kv2.get("linked") == "1"
    if relinked:
        ctx["power"](P(2, z), True)
    ticks(10)
    dproof("ProofOrder", "%s;raise;now" % xz(P(2, z)))
    ticks(full + 30)
    kre, tre = ctx["leaf"](P(2, z))
    reraised = kre.get("target") == "raised" and num(kre, "progress", -1) == num(kre, "full", -2) and kre.get("winch") == "True"
    good = placed and crosses(down0) and raised and blocked and lowered and crosses(down1) and relinked and reraised
    row("ONE_DRAG_PACKAGE", "PASS" if good else "FAIL", {"drag": txt, "downPath": td0, "raised": tup, "upPath": tu, "lowered": tdn,
                                                         "downAgain": td1, "rebuiltDrag": txt2, "rebuiltRaised": tre})
