# ====================================================================== offline stand-in
class FakeBridge(object):
    """A small drawbridge world model answering in the shapes the live tools and the OWED proofs are specified to: leaves
    with progress, winches with power, pawns with cells and health, the counters. It knows nothing about the game; a mock
    verdict proves the script's control flow and its MOD/SITE/HARNESS split only. `faults` inject one wrong behaviour each:
      no_proofs        RM_DrawbridgeProofs is not loaded (an old deploy): every row UNMEASURED/HARNESS, none FAIL
      noclock          step_game_ticks refuses: every row that waits on the clock is UNMEASURED/HARNESS
      no_free          the tip preview reads free=0 (no landing square: the site is not the scene): RAISE_TIPS_RIDERS UNMEASURED/SITE
      tip_all_fall     MOD: riders all fall though a bank square is free      -> RAISE_TIPS_RIDERS FAIL
      no_repath        MOD: a toggle re-paths nobody                           -> RAISE_PATH FAIL
      underpass_tipped MOD: the pawn under the deck is moved by the raise     -> RAISE_SPARES_UNDERPASS FAIL
      lower_from_far   MOD: the far-bank pawn gets a lower job                 -> LOWER_ONLY_FROM_WINCH FAIL
      tip_colony_bank  MOD: both leaves tip to bank A                          -> TWO_LEAF_TIPS_OWN_HINGE FAIL
      trapped_locks    MOD: a trapped hostile counts as free                   -> HOSTILE_LOCKS FAIL
      freeze_ignored   MOD: unpowered steel keeps moving                       -> STEEL_UNPOWERED_FREEZES FAIL
      no_crash         MOD: a destroyed winch leaves the leaf up               -> WINCH_LOST_CRASHES FAIL
      despawn_stale    MOD: a winch despawned without destroying keeps its link -> WINCH_DESPAWN_CRASHES FAIL
      raid_loop        MOD: raider jobs are ended over and over, no progress   -> RAID_UP FAIL
      far_reaches_winch the far bank has a path round to the winch (SITE)     -> LOWER_ONLY_FROM_WINCH UNMEASURED/SITE
      far_raiders      the raiders never come near (SITE)                      -> RAID_UP UNMEASURED/SITE
      dup_plank        MOD: the interrupted carrier's plank is laid as well    -> RAID_PLANK FAIL
      replay_tip       MOD: the load replays the tip                           -> SAVE_MIDRAISE FAIL
      drag_unlinked    MOD: the drag's winch house does not link to its leaf   -> ONE_DRAG_PACKAGE FAIL
      four_refused     MOD: a 4-lane drawbridge drag is refused (1 to 3 kept)  -> ONE_DRAG_FOUR_WIDE FAIL
      wide_flat        MOD: a 4-lane leaf lifts as fast as a 1-lane one         -> ONE_DRAG_FOUR_WIDE FAIL"""
    FAULTS = ("far_reaches_winch", "no_proofs", "noclock", "no_free", "tip_all_fall", "no_repath", "underpass_tipped", "lower_from_far",
              "tip_colony_bank", "trapped_locks", "freeze_ignored", "no_crash", "despawn_stale", "raid_loop", "far_raiders", "dup_plank",
              "replay_tip", "drag_unlinked", "four_refused", "wide_flat", "rebuild_unlinked")

    def __init__(self, faults=()):
        self.f = set(faults)
        self.nid = 1000
        self.pawns = {}          # id -> dict(x, z, hostile, under, trapped, hediffs, lord)
        self.leaves = []         # dict(z0, z1, first, last (x), hinge 'A'|'B', ax, bx, tier, progress, full, target, hold, auto,
        #                              pending, tip, winch (x,z) or None, powered, frozen)
        self.cnt = {f: 0 for _, f in COUNTERS}
        self.walls = set()
        self.dug = set()
        self.speed = 1.0
        self.ledger = {}
        self.carrying = {}
        self.saves = {}

    # ---- helpers
    def _leaf_at(self, x, z):
        for l in self.leaves:
            if l["z0"] <= z <= l["z1"] and l["first"] <= x <= l["last"]:
                return l
        return None

    def _full(self, tier, n, w=1):
        load = w / 3.0 if w > 3 and "wide_flat" not in self.f else 1.0   # RM_DrawbridgeMath.WinchLoad
        return int((120 if tier == "steel" else 240 * n) * load / self.speed + 0.5)

    def _free_hostiles(self):
        return sum(1 for p in self.pawns.values() if p["hostile"] and not p.get("dead")
                   and (not p.get("trapped") or "trapped_locks" in self.f))

    def _tip(self, l):
        riders = [i for i, p in self.pawns.items() if l["z0"] <= p["z"] <= l["z1"] and l["first"] <= p["x"] <= l["last"]
                  and (not p.get("under") or "underpass_tipped" in self.f) and not p.get("dead")]
        bank_x = l["ax"] if (l["hinge"] == "A" or "tip_colony_bank" in self.f) else l["bx"]
        step = -1 if bank_x == l["ax"] else 1
        free = [(bank_x + step * k, z) for k in range(0, 4) for z in range(l["z0"] - 1, l["z1"] + 2)]
        free = [c for c in free if c not in self.walls and c != l["winch"] and c[0] != l["ax"] and c[0] != l["bx"]]
        if "tip_all_fall" in self.f:
            free = []
        for i in sorted(riders, key=lambda i: abs(self.pawns[i]["x"] - bank_x)):
            p = self.pawns[i]
            if free:
                p["x"], p["z"] = free.pop(0)
                p["under"] = False
                self.cnt["TippedCount"] += 1
            else:
                p["hediffs"].append("Bruise")
                self.cnt["FellCount"] += 1

    def _toggle(self, l):
        self.cnt["ToggleCount"] += 1
        if "no_repath" not in self.f:
            self.cnt["RepathCount"] += sum(1 for p in self.pawns.values() if p.get("pathing"))
        for p in self.pawns.values():
            p["pathing"] = False

    def _step(self, l, n):
        for _ in range(n // 5):
            free = self._free_hostiles()
            if l["auto"] and free:
                l["target"], l["auto"] = "raised", False
            elif (not free and not l["hold"] and l["target"] == "raised" and l["progress"] == l["full"] and not l["auto"]
                  and l["pending"] != "raise"):
                l["target"], l["auto"] = "lowered", True
            l["frozen"] = l["tier"] == "steel" and not (l["winch"] and l["powered"]) and "freeze_ignored" not in self.f
            want = l["full"] if l["target"] == "raised" else 0
            if l["progress"] == want:
                if want == 0:
                    l["auto"] = False
                continue
            moves = (l["tier"] == "steel" and (l["powered"] or "freeze_ignored" in self.f)) or l.get("hands")
            if l["frozen"] or not moves:
                continue
            before = l["progress"]
            l["progress"] = min(want, before + 5) if want > before else max(want, before - 5)
            if before == 0 and l["progress"] > 0:
                if not l["tip"]:
                    self._tip(l)
                    l["tip"] = True
                self._toggle(l)
            if l["progress"] == 0:
                l["tip"] = False
                self._toggle(l)

    # ---- the bridge
    def call(self, tool, **kw):
        if tool == "jawa/static_call":
            ty, m, arg = kw.get("type"), kw.get("method"), kw.get("args") or ""
            if ty == DPROOF and "no_proofs" in self.f:
                return {"success": False, "error": "Type not found: " + ty}
            return {"success": True, "result": self.static(ty, m, arg)}
        if tool == "rimworld/step_game_ticks":
            if "noclock" in self.f:
                return {"success": False, "message": "clock refused"}
            n = int(kw.get("ticks") or 0)
            for l in self.leaves:
                self._step(l, n)
            self._raid(n)
            return {"success": True, "ticksAdvanced": n}
        if tool == "jawa/flowworks_excavation_drive":
            self.dug.add((kw.get("x"), kw.get("z")))
            return {"success": True}
        if tool == "jawa/spawn_batch":
            for op in str(kw.get("ops") or "").split(";"):
                if op.startswith("Wall:"):
                    x, z = op[5:].split(",")[:2]
                    self.walls.add((int(x), int(z)))

        if tool == "jawa/spawn_pawn":
            if kw.get("faction") == "?":

                                   trapped=(x, z) in self.dug and self._leaf_at(x, z) is None, lord=False, pathing=False)

        if tool == "jawa/attack_target_probe":
            p = self.pawns.get(kw.get("pawn"))
            if not p or p.get("dead"):
                return {"success": False, "error": "no pawn"}
            return {"success": True, "pawn": kw.get("pawn"), "picked": None, "enemyTarget": None,
                    "curJob": p.get("job", "Wait_Combat" if p.get("lord") else None), "curJobTargetA": p.get("jobTarget")}
        if tool == "jawa/kill_hostiles":
            for p in self.pawns.values():
                if p["hostile"]:
                    p["dead"] = True
            return {"success": True}
        if tool == "jawa/set_draft":
            return {"success": True, "drafted": kw.get("drafted") is True}
        if tool == "jawa/order_pawn":
            p = self.pawns.get(kw.get("pawnId"))
            if p:
                p["pathing"] = True
            # the live shape (JawaBenchTerrainTools order_pawn): success only when every pawn ARRIVED within waitTicks; a walker

            return {"success": False, "arrivedCount": 0, "pawns": [{"id": kw.get("pawnId"), "orderAccepted": bool(p),
                                                                     "end": {"x": p and p["x"], "z": p and p["z"]}}]}
        if tool == "jawa/list_pawns":

                                   **({"health": {"hediffs": [{"def": h} for h in p["hediffs"]]}} if kw.get("includeHealth") else {}))

                self.leaves = [l for l in self.leaves if l not in gone]
                self._razed = getattr(self, "_razed", set()) | {(l["ax"], l["z0"]) for l in gone}
                return {"success": True, "destroyed": len(gone)}

                               and l["first"] <= p["x"] <= l["last"]]

                        p["hediffs"].append("Crush")

                    self.cnt["CrashCount"] += 1

            self.saves[kw.get("saveName")] = copy.deepcopy((self.leaves, self.pawns))

    def _raid(self, n):
        raiders = [p for p in self.pawns.values() if p["hostile"] and p.get("lord") and not p.get("dead")]
        if not raiders or "far_raiders" in self.f or not hasattr(self, "_island"):
            return
        for p in raiders:
            p["x"] = p["x"] - min(n // 25, max(0, p["x"] - (self._island + 7)))
        if "raid_loop" in self.f:
            self.cnt["HostileJobsEnded"] += 5 * len(raiders)
        elif any(p["x"] <= self._island + 7 for p in raiders):
            for p in raiders:
                if p.get("sapper"):
                    p["job"], p["jobTarget"] = "AttackStatic", {"x": self._island + 3, "z": self._islandz}
                    self.cnt["WinchJobs"] += 1
                else:
                    p["job"], p["jobTarget"] = "RM_RaiderSetLadder", None

    def static(self, ty, m, arg):
        if ty == DB:
            if m == "RaisedAt":
                x, z = (int(v) for v in arg.split("|")[1].split(","))
                l = self._leaf_at(x, z)
                return str(bool(l and l["progress"] > 0))
            if m == "FreeHostileCount":
                return str(self._free_hostiles())
            if m == "Locked":
                return str(self._free_hostiles() > 0)
        if ty == TRAP and m == "IsTrapped":
            p = self.pawns.get("Human" + arg) or {}
            return str(bool(p.get("trapped")))
        if ty == SPROOF:
            if m == "ProofPath":
                pid, dest = arg.split(";")
                l = self._leaf_at(*(int(v) for v in dest.split(","))) or next(
                    (q for q in self.leaves if q["z0"] == int(dest.split(",")[1])), None)
                if l and l["progress"] > 0 and "far_reaches_winch" not in self.f:
                    return "PATH found=False cells=0 decked=0"
                return "PATH found=True cells=9 decked=%d" % (l["last"] - l["first"] + 1 if l else 0)
            if m == "ProofPutUnder":
                pid, c = arg.split(";")
                p = self.pawns.get("Human" + pid)
                x, z = (int(v) for v in c.split(","))
                if p:
                    p.update(x=x, z=z, under=True)
                return "PUTUNDER under=True"
            if m == "ProofBand":
                p = self.pawns.get("Human" + arg) or {}
                return "BAND under=%s onDeck=%s view=%s" % (p.get("under"), not p.get("under"), "floor" if p.get("under") else "deck")
        if ty == DPROOF:
            return self.dproof(m, arg)
        return "OK"

    def dproof(self, m, arg):
        a = arg.split(";")
        cell = lambda s: tuple(int(v) for v in s.split(","))  # noqa: E731
        if m == "ProofMakeDrawbridge":
            (x1, z1), (x2, z2), tier = cell(a[0]), cell(a[1]), a[2]
            n = abs(x2 - x1) - 1
            mx = 4 if tier == "timber" else 8
            spans = [(x1 + 1, x2 - 1, "A")] if n <= mx else [(x1 + 1, x1 + n // 2, "A"), (x1 + n // 2 + 1, x2 - 1, "B")]
            winches = []
            for f_, l_, h in spans:
                w = (x1 - 1, z1) if h == "A" else (x2 + 1, z1)
                winches.append(w)
                self.leaves.append(dict(z0=min(z1, z2), z1=max(z1, z2), first=f_, last=l_, hinge=h, ax=x1, bx=x2, tier=tier,
                                        progress=0, full=self._full(tier, l_ - f_ + 1, abs(z2 - z1) + 1), target="lowered", hold=False, auto=False,
                                        pending="none", tip=False, winch=w, powered=False, frozen=False, w=abs(z2 - z1) + 1))
            if x2 - x1 == 3 and tier == "steel":
                self._islandz = min(z1, z2)
                self._island = x1 - 4             # scene K: the island's centre is 4 west of the first anchor
            return "DRAW ok=True leaves=%d tier=%s hinges=%s winchAt=%s reason=-" % (
                len(spans), tier, ",".join(h for _, _, h in spans), "|".join("%d,%d" % w for w in winches))
        if m == "ProofOneDrag":
            (x1, z1), (x2, z2), tier = cell(a[0]), cell(a[1]), a[2]
            lo, hi = min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2)
            lanes = abs(z2 - z1) + 1

            if lanes > widest:

                        "reason=A_steel_drawbridge_is_1_to_%d_squares_wide." % widest)
            hinge = "A" if x1 == lo else "B"   # the leaf hinges on the bank the drag started on (x1,z1)
            w = (x1, z1 + 1)
            self.leaves.append(dict(z0=min(z1, z2), z1=max(z1, z2), first=lo + 1, last=hi - 1, hinge=hinge, ax=lo, bx=hi, tier=tier,
                                    progress=0, full=self._full(tier, hi - lo - 1, lanes), target="lowered", hold=False, auto=False,
                                    pending="none", tip=False, winch=w, powered=False, frozen=False, w=lanes))
            return "ONEDRAG ok=True leaves=1 hinges=%s hingeAt=%d,%d winches=1 linked=%d winchAt=%d,%d gates=%d reason=-" % (
                hinge, x1, z1, 0 if "drag_unlinked" in self.f or ("rebuild_unlinked" in self.f and (lo, min(z1, z2)) in
                                       getattr(self, "_razed", set())) else 1, w[0], w[1], lanes)
        if m == "ProofLeaf":
            x, z = cell(a[0])
            l = self._leaf_at(x, z)
            if l is None:
                return "LEAF none"
            n = l["last"] - l["first"] + 1
            return ("LEAF leaf=1/1 progress=%d full=%d target=%s raised=%d/%d frozen=%s winch=%s powered=%s hold=%s auto=%s "
                    "pending=%s tip=%s hinge=%s version=1" % (l["progress"], l["full"], l["target"], n if l["progress"] else 0, n,
                                                              l["frozen"], l["winch"] is not None, l["powered"], l["hold"],
                                                              l["auto"], l["pending"], l["tip"], l["hinge"]))
        l = self._leaf_at(*cell(a[0])) if a and "," in a[0] and m not in ("ProofWorkJob", "ProofGivePlank", "ProofInterrupt") else None
        if m == "ProofDevSet":
            if l is None:
                return "REFUSED: not a leaf"
            raise_ = a[1] == "raise"
            l.update(target="raised" if raise_ else "lowered", hold=raise_, pending="none")
            l["full"] = self._full(l["tier"], l["last"] - l["first"] + 1, l.get("w", 1))
            if len(a) > 2 and a[2] == "instant":
                if raise_ and l["progress"] == 0 and not l["tip"]:
                    self._tip(l)
                    l["tip"] = True
                l["progress"] = l["full"] if raise_ else 0
                self._toggle(l)
            return "DEVSET target=%s progress=%d" % (l["target"], l["progress"])
        if m == "ProofOrder":
            if l is None:
                return "REFUSED: not a leaf"
            raise_ = a[1] == "raise"
            locked = self._free_hostiles() > 0
            l["hold"] = raise_ and not locked
            l["pending"] = a[1]
            l["auto"] = False
            if len(a) > 2 and a[2] == "now":
                l["target"] = "raised" if raise_ else "lowered"
                l["pending"] = "none"
            return "ORDER pending=%s hold=%s locked=%s target=%s" % (l["pending"], l["hold"], locked, l["target"])
        if m == "ProofWorkJob":
            p = self.pawns.get("Human" + a[0]) or {}
            l = self._leaf_at(*cell(a[1]))
            if l is None:
                return "REFUSED: not a leaf"
            raise_ = l["pending"] == "raise"
            winch_side = (p.get("x", 0) <= l["ax"]) == (l["hinge"] == "A")
            job = raise_ or winch_side or "lower_from_far" in self.f
            return "WORK job=%s spot=%s raise=%s why=%s" % (job, "winch" if winch_side else ("far" if job else "none"), raise_,
                                                           "-" if job else "lower_only_from_the_winch_bank")
        if m == "ProofWinchPower":
            if l is None:
                return "REFUSED: not a leaf"
            l["powered"] = a[1] == "on" and l["winch"] is not None
            return "POWER powered=%s" % l["powered"]
        if m == "ProofWinchDespawn":
            w = cell(a[0])
            hit = [q for q in self.leaves if q["winch"] == w]
            if "despawn_stale" not in self.f:
                for q in hit:
                    q["winch"] = None
                    if q["progress"] > 0:
                        victims = [p for p in self.pawns.values() if p.get("under") and q["z0"] <= p["z"] <= q["z1"]
                                   and q["first"] <= p["x"] <= q["last"]]
                        for p in victims:
                            p["hediffs"].append("Crush")
                        self.cnt["CrashHits"] += len(victims)
                        self.cnt["CrashCount"] += 1
                        q.update(progress=0, target="lowered", tip=False, auto=False, hold=False)
            return "DESPAWN ok=%s linkedBefore=%s linkedAfter=%s" % (bool(hit), bool(hit), bool(hit) and "despawn_stale" in self.f)
        if m == "ProofTipPreview":
            if l is None:
                return "REFUSED: not a leaf"
            riders = sum(1 for p in self.pawns.values() if l["z0"] <= p["z"] <= l["z1"] and l["first"] <= p["x"] <= l["last"])
            free = 0 if "no_free" in self.f else 1
            return "PREVIEW riders=%d land=%d fall=%d free=%d" % (riders, min(free, riders), max(0, riders - free), free)
        if m == "ProofGivePlank":
            gap = (a[1], a[2])
            self.carrying[a[0]] = gap
            self.ledger.setdefault(gap, {"crossings": 0, "reserved": 0})
            self.ledger[gap]["reserved"] = 1
            return "GIVE ok=True job=RM_LayRaidPlank plank=RM_RaidPlank%s reserved=True" % a[0]
        if m == "ProofInterrupt":
            gap = self.carrying.pop(a[0], None)
            if gap and "dup_plank" in self.f:
                self.ledger[gap]["crossings"] += 1
                self.cnt["PlanksLaid"] += 1
            return "INT ended=True dropped=%s" % bool(gap)
        if m == "ProofPlankLedger":
            gap = (a[0], a[1])
            for pid, g in list(self.carrying.items()):
                if g == gap:
                    self.ledger[gap]["crossings"] += 1
                    self.cnt["PlanksLaid"] += 1
                    del self.carrying[pid]
            d = self.ledger.get(gap) or {"crossings": 0, "reserved": 0}
            return "PLEDGER crossings=%d laidCells=%d reserved=%d" % (d["crossings"], 4 * d["crossings"], d["reserved"])
        return "REFUSED: unknown %s" % m

    sys.exit(main())

"""DEEPFIRE_FAMILY_SETTINGS_SAVE_LOAD_1 (L1): live Verse Scribe round trip of the keyed Cuisine family toggles through the
REAL settings file, by jawa/static_call of RimMandrake.LuminousPigment.RM_LuminousFamilySettingsProbe.RoundTrip().
  A1: a disabled family is written by KEY (familyDisabledKeys, no positional list) and is disabled again after the file is
      read back (LoadedModManager.ReadModSettings) with memory reset to all-on.
  A2: a file in the pre-keyed shape (positional <familyEnabled> list, no keys) loads with the right family off and is
      re-written as that key with no positional list.
The probe puts the pre-test file and toggles back and reports `restored`; a run that fails to restore is a FAIL.
python.exe, bridge held, LuminousPigment deployed from this sha; any game state (main menu is enough).
argv: A1 | A2 | all (default). Exit 0 = every asked clause PASS and restored."""
import sys, os, json
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "..", "Utils"))
import rimbridge_client as rb
want = (sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "all").upper()
clauses = ["A1", "A2"] if want == "ALL" else [want]
h, p, t = rb.resolve_endpoint(); S = rb.RimBridge(host=h, port=p, token=t, timeout=120.0); S.connect()
r = S.call("jawa/static_call", {"type": "RimMandrake.LuminousPigment.RM_LuminousFamilySettingsProbe", "method": "RoundTrip"}) or {}
outer = json.loads(r["content"][0]["text"]) if isinstance(r, dict) and r.get("content") else r
if not outer.get("success"):
    print("FAIL: UNMEASURED: static_call refused: %s" % json.dumps(outer)[:600]); sys.exit(1)
try:
    res = json.loads(outer.get("result") or "")
except ValueError:
    print("FAIL: UNMEASURED: probe result is not JSON: %r" % (outer.get("result") or "")[:600]); sys.exit(1)
print(json.dumps(res, indent=1))
ok = res.get("restored") == "True" and all(res.get(c) == "PASS" for c in clauses)
print("%s %s restored=%s" % ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL", " ".join("%s=%s" % (c, res.get(c)) for c in clauses), res.get("restored")))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""run_expectations.py - the ONE runner for expectations_manifest.py manifests.

MASS_VALIDATION_LADDER_1: "One manifest format, one runner; no bespoke V&V
scripts per item." Every build item's manifest
(`infrastructure/state/expectations/<ITEM_ID>.expectations.json`) is consumed
by this one script - nobody writes another one-off checker.

TWO MODES
=========
--fixture <path.json>   Offline. `path.json` is a hand-authored
                        {"ThingDef::RSW_Cindermare": {...fields...}, ...}
                        stand-in for what a live deep-serialized `jawa/get_defs`
                        batch read would return. Zero bridge dependency - this
                        is how CI/selftest and a human iterating on a manifest
                        run it before any game is involved.

--live                  Calls the real bridge (`RimBridge` from
                        rimbridge_client.py) via `jawa/get_defs`, grouped by
                        defType for one batch call per type, `deep=true` on
                        every call. The deep-serialize upgrade shipped
                        2026-09-04 and was live-proved 2026-09-13
                        (MASS_VALIDATION_LADDER_1) - both SCALAR and DEEP
                        checks run for real; there is no more
                        SKIPPED-PENDING-UPGRADE path in --live mode. `fields`
                        per call is the union of every scalar path plus every
                        deep check's top-level field name for that defType.

--l2 --plan-only        Offline. Parses every manifest's "l2" section
                        (expectations_l2.py) and prints the one batch's spawn
                        plan on a 250x250 map. Exit 1 on an unparsable manifest,
                        a grid that does not fit, or no manifest carrying l2.
--l2 --live             The L2 behaviour gauntlet: EVERY matched manifest's l2
                        spawns on ONE map in one sitting - spawn, readback,
                        screenshot (magenta count), step ticks, readback, one
                        log read - zero restarts (map id + clock checked).

USAGE
    python3 run_expectations.py --l2 --glob "infrastructure/state/expectations/*.expectations.json" --plan-only
    python.exe run_expectations.py --l2 --glob "..." --live
    python3 run_expectations.py --manifest infrastructure/state/expectations/FOO_1.expectations.json --fixture testdata/foo_fixture.json
    python3 run_expectations.py --glob "infrastructure/state/expectations/*.expectations.json" --live
    python.exe run_expectations.py --glob "..." --live   # --live needs Windows python (WSL has no bridge route)

Exit 0 = every check PASS (both modes now resolve SCALAR and DEEP checks for
real; SKIPPED-PENDING-UPGRADE can no longer occur in either mode).
Exit 1 = at least one FAIL, MISSING-DEF, or PATH-ERROR. A manifest that fails
to parse is ALSO exit 1 - never silently excluded from the run.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import glob as globmod
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE))
import expectations_manifest as em  # noqa: E402
import expectations_l2 as l2  # noqa: E402


def _load_fixture(path: str) -> dict:
    """{"ThingDef::RSW_Cindermare": {...}} -> {(defType, defName): {...}}."""
    raw = json.loads(Path(path).read_text())
    out = {}
    for k, v in raw.items():
        if "::" not in k:
            raise em.ManifestError("fixture key %r must be 'DefType::defName'" % k)
        defType, defName = k.split("::", 1)
        out[(defType, defName)] = v
    return out


def _top_field(path: str) -> str:
    """'wildness' -> 'wildness'; 'stages[0].label' -> 'stages'. get_defs'
    `fields` arg names top-level def fields only - a deep check's dotted/
    bracketed path is walked locally (expectations_manifest.walk_path)
    against whatever DeepSerializeValue handed back for that top field."""
    return path.split(".", 1)[0].split("[", 1)[0]


def _live_defs(manifest: em.Manifest) -> dict:
    """One jawa/get_defs batch call per defType named in ANY check (scalar
    or deep), `deep=true` on every call. The deep-serialize upgrade
    (MASS_VALIDATION_LADDER_1) is deployed and live-proved as of 2026-09-13
    - deep=true is byte-identical to deep=false for plain scalar fields, so
    there is no reason left to make two calls or to special-case scalar
    checks."""
    from rimbridge_client import RimBridge, resolve_endpoint  # local import: only needed live

    by_type: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    fields_by_type: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
    for c in manifest.checks:
        by_type.setdefault(c.defType, set()).add(c.defName)
        fields_by_type.setdefault(c.defType, set()).add(_top_field(c.path))

    out: dict = {}
    if not by_type:
        return out
    host, port, token = resolve_endpoint()
    with RimBridge(host=host, port=port, token=token) as bridge:
        for defType, names in by_type.items():
            # jawa/get_defs takes `defs` as ';'-separated 'DefType/defName' pairs
            # and returns {"defs": [{"defName":..., "found":..., "fields": {...}}, ...]}
            # - NOT a bare {defName: fields} response, and NOT under a "rows" key
            # either (a prior version of this comment said "rows" - checked against
            # a live call 2026-09-18 and corrected; this path had never actually
            # been exercised live before, only against --fixture data, so the wrong
            # key silently returned zero rows every time instead of failing loud).
            defs_arg = ";".join("%s/%s" % (defType, n) for n in sorted(names))
            fields_arg = ",".join(sorted(fields_by_type[defType]))
            resp = bridge.call("jawa/get_defs",
                                {"defs": defs_arg, "fields": fields_arg, "deep": True})
            rows = resp.get("defs", []) if isinstance(resp, dict) else []
            for row in rows:
                if row.get("found") and row.get("defName") in names:
                    out[(defType, row["defName"])] = row.get("fields", {})
    return out


def run_one(manifest_path: str, live_defs_source, *, allow_deep: bool) -> tuple[int, int]:
    try:
        manifest = em.load_manifest(manifest_path)
    except em.ManifestError as exc:
        print("MANIFEST-ERROR %s: %s" % (manifest_path, exc))
        return (0, 1)

    live_defs = live_defs_source(manifest)
    results = em.evaluate(manifest, live_defs, allow_deep=allow_deep)
    counts = em.summarize(results)
    print("== %s (%s) ==" % (manifest.item, manifest_path))
    fails = 0
    for r in results:
        line = "  %-24s %s::%s#%s" % (r.status, r.check.defType, r.check.defName, r.check.path)
        if r.status == "FAIL":
            line += "  -- %s" % r.detail
            fails += 1
        elif r.status in ("MISSING-DEF", "PATH-ERROR"):
            line += "  -- %s" % r.detail
            fails += 1
        print(line)
    print("  summary: %s" % counts)
    return (len(results), fails)


def run_l2(paths: list[str], *, live: bool) -> int:
    """One L2 batch over every manifest that carries an l2 section."""
    if not paths:
        print("no manifests matched")
        return 1
    manifests, bad = [], 0
    for p in paths:
        try:
            manifests.append(em.load_manifest(p))
        except em.ManifestError as exc:
            print("MANIFEST-ERROR %s: %s" % (p, exc))
            bad += 1
    batch = [m for m in manifests if m.l2]
    print("L2 batch: %d of %d manifests carry an l2 section; ticks %d"
          % (len(batch), len(manifests), l2.batch_ticks(batch)))
    if not batch:
        print("nothing to run: no manifest has an l2 section")
        return 1
    if not live:
        try:
            plan = l2.plan_batch(batch, (250, 250))
        except ValueError as exc:
            print("PLAN-ERROR %s" % exc)
            return 1
        for p in plan:
            print("  plan %-28s %-5s %-28s x%d @%d,%d" % (p.item, p.kind, p.defName, p.count, p.x, p.z))
        print("  rect %s" % (l2.batch_rect(plan),))
        print("\nPLAN: %d spawns, %d manifest(s) unparsable" % (len(plan), bad))
        return 1 if bad else 0
    rows = l2.run_l2_live(batch)
    for r in rows:
        print("  %-17s %-28s %s%s" % (r.status, r.scope, r.subject, ("  -- " + r.detail) if r.detail else ""))
    failing = [r for r in rows if not r.ok]
    print("\nL2 TOTAL: %d rows, %d not PASS, %d manifest(s) unparsable" % (len(rows), len(failing), bad))
    return 1 if (failing or bad) else 0


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,
                                  formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("--manifest", help="one manifest file")
    ap.add_argument("--glob", help="glob of manifest files, e.g. infrastructure/state/expectations/*.expectations.json")
    ap.add_argument("--fixture", help="offline JSON stand-in for live_defs (see module docstring)")
    ap.add_argument("--live", action="store_true", help="call the real bridge (needs python.exe on WSL)")
    ap.add_argument("--l2", action="store_true", help="the L2 behaviour batch instead of the L1 def checks")
    ap.add_argument("--plan-only", action="store_true", help="with --l2: parse and plan offline, touch no game")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)

    if not args.manifest and not args.glob:
        ap.error("pass --manifest or --glob")
    if args.l2:
        if args.plan_only == args.live or args.fixture:
            ap.error("--l2 takes exactly one of --plan-only or --live (no --fixture)")
        paths = [args.manifest] if args.manifest else sorted(globmod.glob(args.glob))
        return run_l2(paths, live=args.live)
    if args.plan_only:
        ap.error("--plan-only goes with --l2")
    if bool(args.fixture) == bool(args.live):
        ap.error("pass exactly one of --fixture or --live")

    paths = [args.manifest] if args.manifest else sorted(globmod.glob(args.glob))
    if not paths:
        print("no manifests matched")
        return 1

    if args.fixture:
        fixture_defs = _load_fixture(args.fixture)
        source = lambda _m: fixture_defs  # noqa: E731
        allow_deep = True  # a fixture CAN carry deep data - it's a stand-in for post-upgrade live
    else:
        source = _live_defs
        allow_deep = True  # get_defs deep=true is deployed and live-proved (2026-09-13)

    total = 0
    total_fail = 0
    manifest_errors = 0
    for p in paths:
        n, f = run_one(p, source, allow_deep=allow_deep)
        if n == 0 and f == 1:
            manifest_errors += 1
        total += n
        total_fail += f

    print("\nTOTAL: %d checks, %d failing, %d manifest(s) unparsable" %
          (total, total_fail, manifest_errors))
    return 1 if (total_fail or manifest_errors) else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
